+# Theorem 1.8: current proof entrypoint
+
+The complete scientific endpoint for Garnier–Heng–Licata–Yacobi,
+[arXiv:2509.21915v3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21915v3), Theorem 1.8, now
+has [root mathematical acceptance](docs/theorem18/landmarks/milestone5-root-acceptance.json)
+in the separate [`deligne/`](deligne/README.md) package after both independent
+GPT-6.1 Sol/high reviews and the successful [final local verification](deligne/evidence/theorem18-local-final/verification.json).
+All 159 commands, including a real clean/rebuild and 64 fresh exact-module
+kernel replays, passed. The audit covers 1,391 project and 475 new supplier
+declarations, with standard axioms only and zero physical duplicates.
+Clean GitHub CI remains pending; its later result is recorded separately.
+
+The endpoint is
+[`ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.theorem_1_8`](deligne/ArtinDeligne/Theorem18.lean).
+For arbitrary `I`, `M : CoxeterMatrix I` with `[Finite M.Group]`, every
+`J : Set I` and every actual complement basepoint, it combines:
+
+- Both complete actual-map normalizer exact-sequence diagrams, including
+  the normalized and positive-traversal conventions.
+- The original relative complement as a K(`Artin.pureNormalizerImage M J`,1).
+- Its original normalizer orbit space as a K(`Artin.normalizerQuotient M J`,1).
+
+[`theorem_1_8_all_basepoints`](deligne/ArtinDeligne/Theorem18.lean) also
+exposes the quotient conclusion at every orbit point;
+`corollary_6_14` is the corresponding named corollary. Empty/full subsets,
+rank zero, reducible and noncrystallographic finite types are included.
+
+Read the [package guide](deligne/README.md) for rebuild commands and the
+[final mathematical report](docs/theorem18/landmarks/milestone5-final-report.md)
+for the actual proof architecture, predicate semantics, paper correspondence,
+source reuse and verification limits. The [proof-source ledger](docs/provenance/GITHUB-PROOF-SOURCES.md)
+retains the earlier accepted cohorts; the two new supplier inventories are
+[weights](deligne/vendor/provenance-weights.json) and
+[cell extensions](deligne/vendor/provenance-carriers.json).
+
+The older root README and milestone reports are preserved historical
+snapshots. Their earlier “not yet proved” statuses describe their recorded
+checkpoints; this entrypoint identifies the new full scientific endpoint
+without retroactively changing those records.

+module
+
+public import ArtinDeligne.ParametricExtension
+public import ArtinDeligne.ParametricFaceGluing
+public import ArtinDeligneVendor.Topology.Realization.SimplexFaceGluing
+public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin
+
+/-! Coherent maps in actual finite geometric simplices, constructed from
+contractible monotone carriers. The finite-face predicate may include being a
+chain in any partial order; no global linear extension is needed. -/
+@[expose] public section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+attribute [local instance] Classical.decEq Classical.propDecidable
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Convexity Topology
+open scoped unitInterval
+
+universe u v
+variable {P : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace Y]
+
+/-- Zero-coordinate insertion along an inclusion of finite vertex sets. -/
+def carrierFaceInclusion {A B : Finset P} (h : A ⊆ B) : A → B :=
+  fun a ↦ ⟨a.val, h a.property⟩
+
+lemma carrierFaceInclusion_injective {A B : Finset P} (h : A ⊆ B) :
+    Function.Injective (carrierFaceInclusion h) := by
+  intro a b hab
+  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : B ↦ z.val) hab)
+
+lemma carrierFaceInclusion_comp {A B C : Finset P} (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hBC : B ⊆ C) :
+    carrierFaceInclusion hBC ∘ carrierFaceInclusion hAB =
+      carrierFaceInclusion (hAB.trans hBC) := rfl
+
+/-- Equal points of two geometric faces have an actual common preimage in
+ their intersection. No intersection compatibility is assumed. -/
+lemma carrierFace_intersection_preimage {A B C : Finset P}
+    (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C)
+    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
+    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
+    ∃ z : StdSimplex ℝ (↥(A ∩ B : Finset P)),
+      z.map (carrierFaceInclusion Finset.inter_subset_left) = x ∧
+      z.map (carrierFaceInclusion Finset.inter_subset_right) = y := by
+  classical
+  have hxrange : x ∈ Set.range (StdSimplex.map
+      (carrierFaceInclusion (Finset.inter_subset_left : A ∩ B ⊆ A))) := by
+    apply (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_iff _ x).mpr
+    intro a ha
+    have haB : a.val ∉ B := by
+      intro h
+      exact ha ⟨⟨a.val, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨a.property, h⟩⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
+    have hn : carrierFaceInclusion hAC a ∉ Set.range (carrierFaceInclusion hBC) := by
+      rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
+      exact haB ((congrArg (fun z : C ↦ z.val) hb) ▸ b.property)
+    have hz : (y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)).weights (carrierFaceInclusion hAC a) = 0 :=
+      Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range y.weights _ hn
+    rw [← hxy, StdSimplex.map_apply_injective (carrierFaceInclusion_injective hAC)] at hz
+    exact hz
+  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hxrange
+  refine ⟨z, hz, StdSimplex.simplex_map_injective (carrierFaceInclusion_injective hBC) ?_⟩
+  rw [StdSimplex.map_map, ← hxy, ← hz, StdSimplex.map_map]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The supplied carrier data contain contractibility and monotonicity only,
+not maps, extensions, homotopies, or coherence conclusions. -/
+structure FiniteCarrierData (P : Type u) (Y : Type v) [TopologicalSpace Y] where
+  admissible : Finset P → Prop
+  hereditary : ∀ {A B}, A ⊆ B → admissible B → admissible A
+  carrier : Finset P → Set Y
+  contractible : ∀ F, F.Nonempty → admissible F → ContractibleSpace (carrier F)
+  monotone : ∀ {A B}, A ⊆ B → A.Nonempty → admissible B → carrier A ⊆ carrier B
+
+/-- A finite-cardinality stage of the construction. -/
+structure PartialCarrierFamily (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) (n : ℕ) where
+  map : ∀ F : Finset P, F.Nonempty → D.admissible F → F.card ≤ n →
+    C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y)
+  carried : ∀ F hne hF hn x, map F hne hF hn x ∈ D.carrier F
+  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
+    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (x : StdSimplex ℝ A),
+    map B hB hb hBn (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) = map A hA ha hAn x
+
+namespace PartialCarrierFamily
+
+variable {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} {n : ℕ}
+
+/-- Coherence on smaller faces already gives equality on every actual overlap. -/
+lemma eq_of_map_eq (f : PartialCarrierFamily D n) {A B C : Finset P}
+    (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
+    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n)
+    (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C)
+    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
+    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
+    f.map A hA ha hAn x = f.map B hB hb hBn y := by
+  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := carrierFace_intersection_preimage hAC hBC x y hxy
+  obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := z.support_weights_nonempty
+  have hne : (A ∩ B).Nonempty := ⟨a.val, a.property⟩
+  have had : D.admissible (A ∩ B) := D.hereditary Finset.inter_subset_left ha
+  have hcard : (A ∩ B).card ≤ n := (Finset.card_le_card Finset.inter_subset_left).trans hAn
+  rw [← hzx, ← hzy,
+    f.compatible hne hA had ha hcard hAn Finset.inter_subset_left,
+    f.compatible hne hB had hb hcard hBn Finset.inter_subset_right]
+
+
+/-- Extend one new finite face using only the already constructed lower faces.
+The conclusion retains compatibility with every smaller face, not only facets. -/
+theorem exists_face_extension (f : PartialCarrierFamily D n)
+    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hc : F.card = n + 1) :
+    ∃ g : C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y),
+      (∀ x, g x ∈ D.carrier F) ∧
+      ∀ G (hneG : G.Nonempty) (hG : D.admissible G) (hGn : G.card ≤ n)
+        (hGF : G ⊆ F) (x : StdSimplex ℝ G),
+        g (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)) = f.map G hneG hG hGn x := by
+  classical
+  let _ := D.contractible F hne hF
+  cases n with
+  | zero =>
+    obtain ⟨z, _⟩ := id_nullhomotopic (D.carrier F)
+    refine ⟨ContinuousMap.const _ z.val, fun _ ↦ z.property, ?_⟩
+    intro G hneG hG hGn
+    have := hneG.card_pos
+    omega
+  | succ k =>
+    let e : Fin (k + 2) ≃ F := (F.equivFinOfCardEq hc).symm
+    let A (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Finset P := F.erase (e i).val
+    have hAF (i : Fin (k + 2)) : A i ⊆ F := Finset.erase_subset _ _
+    have hAc (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card = k + 1 := by
+      dsimp [A]
+      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (e i).property, hc]
+      omega
+    have hAn (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card ≤ k + 1 := (hAc i).le
+    have hAe (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).Nonempty :=
+      Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hAc]; omega)
+    have hAd (i : Fin (k + 2)) : D.admissible (A i) := D.hereditary (hAF i) hF
+    let v (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Fin (k + 1) → A i := fun j ↦
+      ⟨(e (i.succAbove j)).val, Finset.mem_erase.mpr
+        ⟨fun he ↦ Fin.succAbove_ne i j (e.injective (Subtype.ext he)),
+          (e (i.succAbove j)).property⟩⟩
+    have hv (i : Fin (k + 2)) : carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i) ∘ v i = e ∘ i.succAbove := rfl
+    let H (i : Fin (k + 2)) : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1)) × I, D.carrier F) :=
+      ⟨fun q ↦ ⟨f.map (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i) (q.1.map (v i)),
+        D.monotone (hAF i) (hAe i) hF (f.carried _ _ _ _ _)⟩,
+        ((f.map (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i)).continuous.comp
+          ((StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ (v i)).comp continuous_fst)).subtype_mk _⟩
+    have hcompat (i j : Fin (k + 2)) (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) (t : I)
+        (hxy : x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove) : H i (x, t) = H j (y, t) := by
+      apply Subtype.ext
+      exact f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) (hAe j) (hAd i) (hAd j) (hAn i) (hAn j)
+        (hAF i) (hAF j) (x.map (v i)) (y.map (v j)) (by
+          simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
+            congrArg (StdSimplex.map e) hxy)
+    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := StdSimplex.exists_simplex_boundary_track k H hcompat
+    let b : C(PUnit.{1} × StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1), D.carrier F) :=
+      ⟨fun q ↦ B (q.2, 0), by fun_prop⟩
+    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_parameterized_simplex_extension (k + 1) b
+    let g : C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y) :=
+      ⟨fun q ↦ (L (PUnit.unit, q.map e.symm)).val, by fun_prop⟩
+    refine ⟨g, fun q ↦ (L (PUnit.unit, q.map e.symm)).property, ?_⟩
+    intro G hneG hG hGn hGF x
+    have hlt : G.card < F.card := by omega
+    have hnsub : ¬F ⊆ G := fun h ↦ (not_lt_of_ge (Finset.card_le_card h)) hlt
+    obtain ⟨a, haF, haG⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hnsub
+    let i : Fin (k + 2) := e.symm ⟨a, haF⟩
+    let q := (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)).map e.symm
+    have hqi : q.weights i = 0 := by
+      rw [show q = x.map (e.symm ∘ carrierFaceInclusion hGF) from
+        (StdSimplex.map_map _ _ _)]
+      apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
+      rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
+      have he := congrArg (fun t ↦ (e t).val) hj
+      exact haG (show a ∈ G from (by simpa [i] using he) ▸ j.property)
+    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q).mpr hqi
+    have hqe : q.map e = x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := by
+      dsimp [q]
+      rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
+      rw [show (fun a : F ↦ e (e.symm a)) = id from funext e.apply_symm_apply,
+        StdSimplex.map_id]
+    have hfz : (z.map (v i)).map (carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i)) =
+        x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := by
+      rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
+      change z.map (e ∘ i.succAbove) = _
+      rw [StdSimplex.map_comp, hz, hqe]
+    have hface : g (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)) =
+        f.map (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i) (z.map (v i)) := by
+      change (L (PUnit.unit, q)).val = _
+      have hbq : (⟨q, i, hqi⟩ : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) =
+          StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z := Subtype.ext hz.symm
+      have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hL PUnit.unit ⟨q, i, hqi⟩)
+      change (L (PUnit.unit, q)).val = _ at h
+      rw [show b (PUnit.unit, ⟨q, i, hqi⟩) = B (⟨q, i, hqi⟩, 0) from rfl,
+        hbq, hB] at h
+      exact h
+    exact hface.trans (f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) hneG (hAd i) hG (hAn i) hGn
+      (hAF i) hGF (z.map (v i)) x hfz)
+
+
+/-- The empty stage contains no nonempty face. -/
+def empty (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) : PartialCarrierFamily D 0 where
+  map _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
+  carried _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
+  compatible hA _ _ _ hAn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hAn) hA.card_pos)
+
+/-- One cardinality step, with every filler obtained from actual HEP. -/
+noncomputable def next (f : PartialCarrierFamily D n) : PartialCarrierFamily D (n + 1) := by
+  classical
+  let g (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) :
+      C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y) :=
+    if h : F.card ≤ n then f.map F hne hF h
+    else (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (by omega)).choose
+  have hg (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F)
+      (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) (h : ¬F.card ≤ n) :=
+    (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (show F.card = n + 1 by omega)).choose_spec
+  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro F hne hF hn x
+    by_cases h : F.card ≤ n
+    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_left h] using f.carried F hne hF h x
+    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right h] using (hg F hne hF hn h).1 x
+  · intro A B hA hB ha hb hAn hBn hAB x
+    by_cases hBsmall : B.card ≤ n
+    · have hAsmall := (Finset.card_le_card hAB).trans hBsmall
+      simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
+        f.compatible hA hB ha hb hAsmall hBsmall hAB x
+    · by_cases hAsmall : A.card ≤ n
+      · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
+          (hg B hB hb hBn hBsmall).2 A hA ha hAsmall hAB x
+      · have heq : A = B := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hAB (by omega)
+        subst B
+        have hi : carrierFaceInclusion hAB = id := rfl
+        rw [hi, StdSimplex.map_id]
+
+lemma next_map_old (f : PartialCarrierFamily D n) (F : Finset P)
+    (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hn : F.card ≤ n) :
+    f.next.map F hne hF (hn.trans (Nat.le_succ n)) = f.map F hne hF hn := by
+  simp only [next, dite_eq_left hn]
+
+/-- Cardinal recursion supplies stages in every dimension. -/
+noncomputable def stages (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) : (n : ℕ) → PartialCarrierFamily D n
+  | 0 => empty D
+  | n + 1 => (stages D n).next
+
+lemma stages_map_stable (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
+    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFm : F.card ≤ m) :
+    (stages D n).map F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn) = (stages D m).map F hne hF hFm := by
+  induction n, hmn using Nat.le_induction with
+  | base => rfl
+  | succ n hmn ih =>
+    exact ((stages D n).next_map_old F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn)).trans ih
+
+end PartialCarrierFamily
+
+
+/-- A coherent all-dimensional family, here a constructed conclusion. -/
+structure CarrierFamily (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) where
+  map : ∀ F : Finset P, F.Nonempty → D.admissible F → C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y)
+  carried : ∀ F hne hF x, map F hne hF x ∈ D.carrier F
+  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (x : StdSimplex ℝ A),
+    map B hB hb (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) = map A hA ha x
+
+/-- Monotone actual contractible carriers admit coherent geometric simplex
+maps in every finite dimension. No coherent family is an input. -/
+noncomputable def FiniteCarrierData.family (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) : CarrierFamily D where
+  map F hne hF := (PartialCarrierFamily.stages D F.card).map F hne hF le_rfl
+  carried F hne hF := (PartialCarrierFamily.stages D F.card).carried F hne hF le_rfl
+  compatible {A B} hA hB ha hb hAB x := by
+    have hn := Finset.card_le_card hAB
+    exact ((PartialCarrierFamily.stages D B.card).compatible hA hB ha hb hn le_rfl hAB x).trans
+      (ContinuousMap.congr_fun (PartialCarrierFamily.stages_map_stable D hn A hA ha le_rfl) x)
+
+
+/-- Finite stages of coherent endpoint-preserving homotopies. -/
+structure PartialCarrierHomotopy (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y)
+    (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) (n : ℕ) where
+  hom : ∀ F : Finset P, (hne : F.Nonempty) → (hF : D.admissible F) → F.card ≤ n →
+    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF)
+  carried : ∀ F hne hF hn t x, hom F hne hF hn (t, x) ∈ D.carrier F
+  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
+    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (t : I) (x : StdSimplex ℝ A),
+    hom B hB hb hBn (t, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) = hom A hA ha hAn (t, x)
+
+namespace PartialCarrierHomotopy
+variable {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} {f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D} {n : ℕ}
+
+lemma eq_of_map_eq (f : PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n) {A B C : Finset P}
+    (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
+    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n)
+    (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C) (t : I)
+    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
+    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
+    f.hom A hA ha hAn (t, x) = f.hom B hB hb hBn (t, y) := by
+  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := carrierFace_intersection_preimage hAC hBC x y hxy
+  obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := z.support_weights_nonempty
+  have hne : (A ∩ B).Nonempty := ⟨a.val, a.property⟩
+  have had : D.admissible (A ∩ B) := D.hereditary Finset.inter_subset_left ha
+  have hcard : (A ∩ B).card ≤ n := (Finset.card_le_card Finset.inter_subset_left).trans hAn
+  rw [← hzx, ← hzy,
+    f.compatible hne hA had ha hcard hAn Finset.inter_subset_left,
+    f.compatible hne hB had hb hcard hBn Finset.inter_subset_right]
+
+lemma map_equiv_cancel {A : Type*} {B : Type*} (e : A ≃ B) (x : StdSimplex ℝ B) :
+    (x.map e.symm).map e = x := by
+  rw [StdSimplex.map_map,
+    show (fun a ↦ e (e.symm a)) = id from funext e.apply_symm_apply,
+    StdSimplex.map_id]
+
+/-- A single new homotopy face is filled by actual endpoint-relative HEP. -/
+theorem exists_face_extension (f : PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n)
+    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hc : F.card = n + 1) :
+    ∃ g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF),
+      (∀ t x, g (t, x) ∈ D.carrier F) ∧
+      ∀ G (hneG : G.Nonempty) (hG : D.admissible G) (hGn : G.card ≤ n)
+        (hGF : G ⊆ F) (t : I) (x : StdSimplex ℝ G),
+        g (t, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)) = f.hom G hneG hG hGn (t, x) := by
+  classical
+  let _ := D.contractible F hne hF
+  let a₀ : C(StdSimplex ℝ F, D.carrier F) :=
+    ⟨fun x ↦ ⟨f₀.map F hne hF x, f₀.carried F hne hF x⟩,
+      (f₀.map F hne hF).continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
+  let a₁ : C(StdSimplex ℝ F, D.carrier F) :=
+    ⟨fun x ↦ ⟨f₁.map F hne hF x, f₁.carried F hne hF x⟩,
+      (f₁.map F hne hF).continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
+  cases n with
+  | zero =>
+    obtain ⟨z, ⟨L⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic (D.carrier F)
+    let L₀ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy a₀ (ContinuousMap.const _ z) :=
+      (L.compContinuousMap a₀).cast (by ext; rfl) (by ext; rfl)
+    let L₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy a₁ (ContinuousMap.const _ z) :=
+      (L.compContinuousMap a₁).cast (by ext; rfl) (by ext; rfl)
+    let K := L₀.trans L₁.symm
+    let g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
+      ⟨⟨fun p ↦ (K p).val, by fun_prop⟩,
+        fun x ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (K.apply_zero x),
+        fun x ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (K.apply_one x)⟩
+    refine ⟨g, fun t x ↦ (K (t, x)).property, ?_⟩
+    intro G hneG hG hGn
+    have := hneG.card_pos
+    omega
+  | succ k =>
+    let e : Fin (k + 2) ≃ F := (F.equivFinOfCardEq hc).symm
+    let A (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Finset P := F.erase (e i).val
+    have hAF (i : Fin (k + 2)) : A i ⊆ F := Finset.erase_subset _ _
+    have hAc (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card = k + 1 := by
+      dsimp [A]
+      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (e i).property, hc]
+      omega
+    have hAn (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card ≤ k + 1 := (hAc i).le
+    have hAe (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).Nonempty :=
+      Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hAc]; omega)
+    have hAd (i : Fin (k + 2)) : D.admissible (A i) := D.hereditary (hAF i) hF
+    let v (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Fin (k + 1) → A i := fun j ↦
+      ⟨(e (i.succAbove j)).val, Finset.mem_erase.mpr
+        ⟨fun he ↦ Fin.succAbove_ne i j (e.injective (Subtype.ext he)),
+          (e (i.succAbove j)).property⟩⟩
+    have hv (i : Fin (k + 2)) : carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i) ∘ v i = e ∘ i.succAbove := rfl
+    let H (i : Fin (k + 2)) : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1)) × I, D.carrier F) :=
+      ⟨fun q ↦ ⟨f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i) (q.2, q.1.map (v i)),
+        D.monotone (hAF i) (hAe i) hF (f.carried _ _ _ _ _ _)⟩,
+        ((f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i)).continuous.comp
+          (continuous_snd.prodMk ((StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ (v i)).comp continuous_fst))).subtype_mk _⟩
+    have hcompat (i j : Fin (k + 2)) (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) (t : I)
+        (hxy : x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove) : H i (x, t) = H j (y, t) := by
+      apply Subtype.ext
+      exact f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) (hAe j) (hAd i) (hAd j) (hAn i) (hAn j)
+        (hAF i) (hAF j) t (x.map (v i)) (y.map (v j)) (by
+          simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
+            congrArg (StdSimplex.map e) hxy)
+    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := StdSimplex.exists_simplex_boundary_track k H hcompat
+    let b : C(I × StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1), D.carrier F) :=
+      ⟨fun q ↦ B (q.2, q.1), by fun_prop⟩
+    let g₀ : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 2)), D.carrier F) :=
+      a₀.comp ⟨StdSimplex.map e, StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ e⟩
+    let g₁ : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 2)), D.carrier F) :=
+      a₁.comp ⟨StdSimplex.map e, StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ e⟩
+    have hb₀ (q : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) : b (0, q) = g₀ q.val := by
+      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := q.property
+      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q.val).mpr hi
+      have heq : StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z = q := Subtype.ext hz
+      change B (q, 0) = _
+      rw [← heq, hB]
+      apply Subtype.ext
+      change f.hom _ _ _ _ (0, z.map (v i)) = f₀.map F hne hF ((z.map i.succAbove).map e)
+      rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero]
+      simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
+        (f₀.compatible (hAe i) hne (hAd i) hF (hAF i) (z.map (v i))).symm
+    have hb₁ (q : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) : b (1, q) = g₁ q.val := by
+      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := q.property
+      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q.val).mpr hi
+      have heq : StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z = q := Subtype.ext hz
+      change B (q, 1) = _
+      rw [← heq, hB]
+      apply Subtype.ext
+      change f.hom _ _ _ _ (1, z.map (v i)) = f₁.map F hne hF ((z.map i.succAbove).map e)
+      rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_one]
+      simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
+        (f₁.compatible (hAe i) hne (hAd i) hF (hAF i) (z.map (v i))).symm
+    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_simplex_boundary_homotopy_extension (k + 1) g₀ g₁ b hb₀ hb₁
+    let g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
+      ⟨⟨fun p ↦ (L (p.1, p.2.map e.symm)).val, by fun_prop⟩,
+        fun x ↦ (congrArg Subtype.val (L.apply_zero (x.map e.symm))).trans
+          (congrArg (f₀.map F hne hF) (map_equiv_cancel e x)),
+        fun x ↦ (congrArg Subtype.val (L.apply_one (x.map e.symm))).trans
+          (congrArg (f₁.map F hne hF) (map_equiv_cancel e x))⟩
+    refine ⟨g, fun t x ↦ (L (t, x.map e.symm)).property, ?_⟩
+    intro G hneG hG hGn hGF t x
+    have hlt : G.card < F.card := by omega
+    have hnsub : ¬F ⊆ G := fun h ↦ (not_lt_of_ge (Finset.card_le_card h)) hlt
+    obtain ⟨a, haF, haG⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hnsub
+    let i : Fin (k + 2) := e.symm ⟨a, haF⟩
+    let q := (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)).map e.symm
+    have hqi : q.weights i = 0 := by
+      rw [show q = x.map (e.symm ∘ carrierFaceInclusion hGF) from
+        (StdSimplex.map_map _ _ _)]
+      apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
+      rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
+      have he := congrArg (fun s ↦ (e s).val) hj
+      exact haG (show a ∈ G from (by simpa [i] using he) ▸ j.property)
+    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q).mpr hqi
+    have hqe : q.map e = x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := map_equiv_cancel e _
+    have hfz : (z.map (v i)).map (carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i)) =
+        x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := by
+      rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
+      change z.map (e ∘ i.succAbove) = _
+      rw [StdSimplex.map_comp, hz, hqe]
+    have hface : g (t, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)) =
+        f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i) (t, z.map (v i)) := by
+      change (L (t, q)).val = _
+      have hbq : (⟨q, i, hqi⟩ : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) =
+          StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z := Subtype.ext hz.symm
+      have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hL t ⟨q, i, hqi⟩)
+      change (L (t, q)).val = _ at h
+      rw [show b (t, ⟨q, i, hqi⟩) = B (⟨q, i, hqi⟩, t) from rfl,
+        hbq, hB] at h
+      exact h
+    exact hface.trans (f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) hneG (hAd i) hG (hAn i) hGn
+      (hAF i) hGF t (z.map (v i)) x hfz)
+
+
+/-- No nonempty face occurs at homotopy stage zero. -/
+def empty (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) :
+    PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ 0 where
+  hom _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
+  carried _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
+  compatible hA _ _ _ hAn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hAn) hA.card_pos)
+
+/-- A homotopy stage is extended by the proved relative cylinder filler. -/
+noncomputable def next (f : PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n) :
+    PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ (n + 1) := by
+  classical
+  let g (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) :
+      ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
+    if h : F.card ≤ n then f.hom F hne hF h
+    else (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (by omega)).choose
+  have hg (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F)
+      (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) (h : ¬F.card ≤ n) :=
+    (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (show F.card = n + 1 by omega)).choose_spec
+  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro F hne hF hn t x
+    by_cases h : F.card ≤ n
+    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_left h] using f.carried F hne hF h t x
+    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right h] using (hg F hne hF hn h).1 t x
+  · intro A B hA hB ha hb hAn hBn hAB t x
+    by_cases hBsmall : B.card ≤ n
+    · have hAsmall := (Finset.card_le_card hAB).trans hBsmall
+      simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
+        f.compatible hA hB ha hb hAsmall hBsmall hAB t x
+    · by_cases hAsmall : A.card ≤ n
+      · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
+          (hg B hB hb hBn hBsmall).2 A hA ha hAsmall hAB t x
+      · have heq : A = B := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hAB (by omega)
+        subst B
+        have hi : carrierFaceInclusion hAB = id := rfl
+        rw [hi, StdSimplex.map_id]
+
+lemma next_hom_old (f : PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n) (F : Finset P)
+    (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hn : F.card ≤ n) :
+    f.next.hom F hne hF (hn.trans (Nat.le_succ n)) = f.hom F hne hF hn := by
+  simp only [next, dite_eq_left hn]
+
+/-- All-dimensional homotopy stages are recursively constructed. -/
+noncomputable def stages (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) :
+    (n : ℕ) → PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n
+  | 0 => empty D f₀ f₁
+  | n + 1 => (stages D f₀ f₁ n).next
+
+lemma stages_hom_stable (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D)
+    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
+    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFm : F.card ≤ m) :
+    (stages D f₀ f₁ n).hom F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn) =
+      (stages D f₀ f₁ m).hom F hne hF hFm := by
+  induction n, hmn using Nat.le_induction with
+  | base => rfl
+  | succ n hmn ih =>
+    exact ((stages D f₀ f₁ n).next_hom_old F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn)).trans ih
+
+end PartialCarrierHomotopy
+
+
+/-- Coherent carried homotopies, constructed below from two carried families. -/
+structure CarrierHomotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) where
+  hom : ∀ F : Finset P, (hne : F.Nonempty) → (hF : D.admissible F) →
+    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF)
+  carried : ∀ F hne hF t x, hom F hne hF (t, x) ∈ D.carrier F
+  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (t : I) (x : StdSimplex ℝ A),
+    hom B hB hb (t, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) = hom A hA ha (t, x)
+
+/-- Any two carried coherent families admit an actual coherent homotopy in
+all finite dimensions, retaining the whole original carrier on each face. -/
+noncomputable def CarrierFamily.homotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y}
+    (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) : CarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ where
+  hom F hne hF := (PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages D f₀ f₁ F.card).hom F hne hF le_rfl
+  carried F hne hF := (PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages D f₀ f₁ F.card).carried F hne hF le_rfl
+  compatible {A B} hA hB ha hb hAB t x := by
+    have hn := Finset.card_le_card hAB
+    exact ((PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages D f₀ f₁ B.card).compatible
+      hA hB ha hb hn le_rfl hAB t x).trans
+      (congrArg (fun H ↦ H (t, x))
+        (PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages_hom_stable D f₀ f₁ hn A hA ha le_rfl))
+
+/-- Full-family coherence implies equality at every actual geometric overlap. -/
+lemma CarrierFamily.eq_of_map_eq {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} (f : CarrierFamily D)
+    {A B C : Finset P} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C)
+    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
+    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
+    f.map A hA ha x = f.map B hB hb y := by
+  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := carrierFace_intersection_preimage hAC hBC x y hxy
+  obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := z.support_weights_nonempty
+  have hne : (A ∩ B).Nonempty := ⟨a.val, a.property⟩
+  have had : D.admissible (A ∩ B) := D.hereditary Finset.inter_subset_left ha
+  rw [← hzx, ← hzy,
+    f.compatible hne hA had ha Finset.inter_subset_left,
+    f.compatible hne hB had hb Finset.inter_subset_right]
+
+/-- The overlap may also be tested in the original ambient vertex simplex. -/
+lemma CarrierFamily.eq_of_map_val_eq {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} (f : CarrierFamily D)
+    {A B : Finset P} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
+    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
+    (hxy : x.map Subtype.val = y.map Subtype.val) :
+    f.map A hA ha x = f.map B hB hb y := by
+  apply f.eq_of_map_eq hA hB ha hb (Finset.subset_union_left) (Finset.subset_union_right) x y
+  apply StdSimplex.simplex_map_injective (f := (Subtype.val : (A ∪ B : Finset P) → P))
+    Subtype.val_injective
+  simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, carrierFaceInclusion] using hxy
+
+
+section Parameterized
+universe w
+variable {X : Type w} [TopologicalSpace X]
+
+/-- Literal restriction of a parameter along antitone source domains. -/
+def carrierParameterRestrict {R : Finset P → Set X} (hR : Antitone R)
+    {A B : Finset P} (hAB : A ⊆ B) : R B → R A :=
+  fun x ↦ ⟨x.val, hR hAB x.property⟩
+
+lemma continuous_carrierParameterRestrict {R : Finset P → Set X} (hR : Antitone R)
+    {A B : Finset P} (hAB : A ⊆ B) : Continuous (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB) :=
+  continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
+
+/-- Given endpoint maps on varying actual parameter domains. Coherence here is
+only coherence of the given endpoint maps, not a homotopy or extension premise. -/
+structure ParameterizedCarrierFamily (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y)
+    (R : Finset P → Set X) (hR : Antitone R) where
+  map : ∀ F : Finset P, F.Nonempty → D.admissible F → C(R F × StdSimplex ℝ F, Y)
+  carried : ∀ F hne hF x z, map F hne hF (x, z) ∈ D.carrier F
+  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
+    (x : R B) (z : StdSimplex ℝ A),
+    map B hB hb (x, z.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) =
+      map A hA ha (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB x, z)
+
+/-- Finite stages for the homotopies, with no contractibility requirement on
+any parameter domain. -/
+structure PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y}
+    {R : Finset P → Set X} {hR : Antitone R}
+    (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) (n : ℕ) where
+  hom : ∀ F : Finset P, (hne : F.Nonempty) → (hF : D.admissible F) → F.card ≤ n →
+    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF)
+  carried : ∀ F hne hF hn t x z, hom F hne hF hn (t, (x, z)) ∈ D.carrier F
+  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
+    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
+    (t : I) (x : R B) (z : StdSimplex ℝ A),
+    hom B hB hb hBn (t, (x, z.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB))) =
+      hom A hA ha hAn (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB x, z))
+
+namespace PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy
+variable {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} {R : Finset P → Set X} {hR : Antitone R}
+  {f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR} {n : ℕ}
+
+/-- Actual geometric overlaps in a common parameter domain have equal values
+at every already constructed homotopy stage. -/
+lemma eq_of_map_eq (f : PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ n)
+    {A B C : Finset P} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n)
+    (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C) (t : I) (p : R C)
+    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
+    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
+    f.hom A hA ha hAn (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAC p, x)) =
+      f.hom B hB hb hBn (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hBC p, y)) := by
+  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := carrierFace_intersection_preimage hAC hBC x y hxy
+  obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := z.support_weights_nonempty
+  have hne : (A ∩ B).Nonempty := ⟨a.val, a.property⟩

+/-- No nonempty face occurs at homotopy stage zero. -/
+def empty (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) :
+    PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ 0 where
+  hom _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
+  carried _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
+  compatible hA _ _ _ hAn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hAn) hA.card_pos)
+
+/-- A homotopy stage is extended by the proved relative cylinder filler. -/
+noncomputable def next (f : PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ n) :
+    PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ (n + 1) := by
+  classical
+  let g (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) :
+      ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
+    if h : F.card ≤ n then f.hom F hne hF h
+    else (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (by omega)).choose
+  have hg (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F)
+      (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) (h : ¬F.card ≤ n) :=
+    (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (show F.card = n + 1 by omega)).choose_spec
+  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro F hne hF hn t p x
+    by_cases h : F.card ≤ n
+    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_left h] using f.carried F hne hF h t p x
+    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right h] using (hg F hne hF hn h).1 t p x
+  · intro A B hA hB ha hb hAn hBn hAB t p x
+    by_cases hBsmall : B.card ≤ n
+    · have hAsmall := (Finset.card_le_card hAB).trans hBsmall
+      simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
+        f.compatible hA hB ha hb hAsmall hBsmall hAB t p x
+    · by_cases hAsmall : A.card ≤ n
+      · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
+          (hg B hB hb hBn hBsmall).2 A hA ha hAsmall hAB t p x
+      · have heq : A = B := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hAB (by omega)
+        subst B
+        have hi : carrierFaceInclusion hAB = id := rfl
+        rw [hi, StdSimplex.map_id]
+        rfl
+
+lemma next_hom_old (f : PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ n) (F : Finset P)
+    (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hn : F.card ≤ n) :
+    f.next.hom F hne hF (hn.trans (Nat.le_succ n)) = f.hom F hne hF hn := by
+  simp only [next, dite_eq_left hn]
+
+/-- All-dimensional homotopy stages are recursively constructed. -/
+noncomputable def stages (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) :
+    (n : ℕ) → PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ n
+  | 0 => empty f₀ f₁
+  | n + 1 => (stages f₀ f₁ n).next
+
+lemma stages_hom_stable (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR)
+    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
+    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFm : F.card ≤ m) :
+    (stages f₀ f₁ n).hom F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn) =
+      (stages f₀ f₁ m).hom F hne hF hFm := by
+  induction n, hmn using Nat.le_induction with
+  | base => rfl
+  | succ n hmn ih =>
+    exact ((stages f₀ f₁ n).next_hom_old F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn)).trans ih
+
+end PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy
+
+/-- The result of the varying-parameter construction, containing actual
+homotopies with the given endpoint maps and all face restrictions. -/
+structure ParameterizedCarrierHomotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y}
+    {R : Finset P → Set X} {hR : Antitone R}
+    (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) where
+  hom : ∀ F : Finset P, (hne : F.Nonempty) → (hF : D.admissible F) →
+    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF)
+  carried : ∀ F hne hF t x z, hom F hne hF (t, (x, z)) ∈ D.carrier F
+  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
+    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
+    (t : I) (x : R B) (z : StdSimplex ℝ A),
+    hom B hB hb (t, (x, z.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB))) =
+      hom A hA ha (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB x, z))
+
+/-- Actual all-dimensional parameterized carrier homotopies, with source
+pieces varying antitonically. Neither local compactness nor contractibility
+of the parameter spaces is required. -/
+noncomputable def ParameterizedCarrierFamily.homotopy
+    {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} {R : Finset P → Set X} {hR : Antitone R}
+    (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) : ParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ where
+  hom F hne hF := (PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.stages f₀ f₁ F.card).hom F hne hF le_rfl
+  carried F hne hF := (PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.stages f₀ f₁ F.card).carried F hne hF le_rfl
+  compatible {A B} hA hB ha hb hAB t p x := by
+    have hn := Finset.card_le_card hAB
+    exact ((PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.stages f₀ f₁ B.card).compatible
+      hA hB ha hb hn le_rfl hAB t p x).trans
+      (congrArg (fun H ↦ H (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB p, x)))
+        (PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.stages_hom_stable f₀ f₁ hn A hA ha le_rfl))
+
+end Parameterized
+

+convex combinations in the actual complexified complement. The phase-chamber

+/-- Real signs have priority, except at a zero real evaluation. -/
+noncomputable def canonicalCellChoice (c : ComplexComplement ℓ) : H → Fin 4 := fun h =>
+  if ℓ h c.val.1 = 0 then (if 0 < ℓ h c.val.2 then 2 else 3)
+  else if 0 < ℓ h c.val.1 then 0 else 1

+  classical
+  by_cases hr : ℓ h c.val.1 = 0
+  · by_cases hi : 0 < ℓ h c.val.2 <;>
+      simp [canonicalCellChoice, coordinateHalfSpace, signHalfSpace, hr, hi]
+  · by_cases hp : 0 < ℓ h c.val.1 <;>
+      simp [canonicalCellChoice, coordinateHalfSpace, signHalfSpace, hr, hp]

+theorem centerCombination_mem_complement (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ) (p : ComplexComplement ℓ)
+    (hp : ∀ i, p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i)) (w : ι → ℝ)
+    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
+    centerCombination ℓ c w ∈ complexComplementSet ℓ :=
+  centerCombination_mem_complement_of_active ℓ c p w hw hwone (fun i _ => hp i)
+
+/-- The common point itself can be added as an extra center. -/
+theorem centerCombination_with_commonPoint_mem (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ)
+    (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (hp : ∀ i, p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i))
+    (w : Option ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
+    centerCombination ℓ (fun o : Option ι => o.elim p c) w ∈ complexComplementSet ℓ := by
+  apply centerCombination_mem_complement ℓ _ p _ w hw hwone
+  intro o
+  cases o with
+  | none => exact canonicalCell_self ℓ p
+  | some i => exact hp i
+
+/-- Straight affine return from the common point to any such barycenter
+stays in the actual complexified complement. -/
+theorem lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem_of_active (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ)
+    (p : ComplexComplement ℓ)
+    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1)
+    (hp : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i))
+    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
+    AffineMap.lineMap p.val (centerCombination ℓ c w) t ∈ complexComplementSet ℓ := by
+  let v : Option ι → ℝ := fun o => o.elim (1 - t) (fun i => t * w i)
+  have hv : ∀ o, 0 ≤ v o := by
+    intro o
+    cases o with
+    | none => exact sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2
+    | some i => exact mul_nonneg ht.1 (hw i)
+  have hvone : ∑ o, v o = 1 := by
+    simp only [v, Fintype.sum_option, Option.elim_none, Option.elim_some, ← Finset.mul_sum, hwone, mul_one]
+    ring
+  have hmem : ∀ o : Option ι, v o ≠ 0 →
+      p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (o.elim p c) := by
+    intro o ho
+    cases o with
+    | none => exact canonicalCell_self ℓ p
+    | some i =>
+      apply hp i
+      intro hi
+      apply ho
+      change t * w i = 0
+      rw [hi, mul_zero]
+  have h := centerCombination_mem_complement_of_active ℓ (fun o : Option ι => o.elim p c)
+    p v hv hvone hmem
+  convert h using 1
+  ext <;> simp only [centerCombination, v, Fintype.sum_option, Option.elim_none, Option.elim_some,
+    AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
+    mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
+
+theorem lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ)
+    (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (hp : ∀ i, p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i))
+    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1)
+    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
+    AffineMap.lineMap p.val (centerCombination ℓ c w) t ∈ complexComplementSet ℓ :=
+  lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem_of_active ℓ c p w hw hwone (fun i _ => hp i) ht
+
+noncomputable def centerCombinationPoint (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ) (p : ComplexComplement ℓ)
+    (hp : ∀ i, p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i)) (w : ι → ℝ)
+    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1) : ComplexComplement ℓ :=
+  ⟨centerCombination ℓ c w, centerCombination_mem_complement ℓ c p hp w hw hwone⟩
+
+/-- The actual straight return path, with actual complement endpoints and topology. -/
+noncomputable def centerCombinationReturnPath [ContinuousAdd E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E]
+    (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ) (p : ComplexComplement ℓ)
+    (hp : ∀ i, p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i)) (w : ι → ℝ)
+    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
+    Path p (centerCombinationPoint ℓ c p hp w hw hwone) where
+  toFun t := ⟨AffineMap.lineMap p.val (centerCombination ℓ c w) (t : ℝ),
+    lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem ℓ c p hp w hw hwone t.property⟩
+  continuous_toFun := by
+    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
+    simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]
+    fun_prop
+  source' := by apply Subtype.ext; simp
+  target' := by apply Subtype.ext; simp [centerCombinationPoint]
+
+end ConvexCombinations
+
+section ChamberCarriers
+
+variable [Finite H]
+
+/-- The upper phase chamber prioritizes nonzero imaginary signs, taking
+the lower phase's real sign only where the imaginary evaluation vanishes. -/
+noncomputable def phaseUpperChamber (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) : Chamber ℓ :=
+  faceChamber ℓ p.val.2 (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p)
+
+private theorem halfspace_sign (f : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) {x : E} {s : Bool}
+    (hx : x ∈ signHalfSpace f s) : s = decide (0 < f x) := by
+  cases s
+  · have hn : f x < 0 := hx
+    simp only [decide_eq_false (not_lt_of_ge hn.le)]
+  · have hp : 0 < f x := hx
+    simp only [decide_eq_true hp]
+
+theorem tubeLowerChamber_signs_real (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) {h : H}
+    (hr : ℓ h p.val.1 ≠ 0) : (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p).signs h = decide (0 < ℓ h p.val.1) :=
+  faceChamber_signs_nonzero ℓ p.val.1 (tubeWitness ℓ p) hr
+
+theorem tubeLowerChamber_signs_imag (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) {h : H}
+    (hr : ℓ h p.val.1 = 0) : (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p).signs h = decide (0 < ℓ h p.val.2) := by
+  rw [tubeLowerChamber, faceChamber_signs_zero ℓ p.val.1 (tubeWitness ℓ p) hr]
+  exact halfspace_sign (ℓ h) (mem_tubeWitness ℓ p h hr)
+
+theorem canonicalCell_lower_eq_lower {c p : ComplexComplement ℓ}
+    (hp : p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ c) {h : H} (hr : ℓ h c.val.1 ≠ 0) :
+    (tubeLowerChamber ℓ c).signs h = (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p).signs h := by
+  have hm := canonicalCell_real ℓ hp hr
+  rw [tubeLowerChamber_signs_real ℓ c hr,
+    tubeLowerChamber_signs_real ℓ p (signHalfSpace_nonzero hm)]
+  exact halfspace_sign (ℓ h) hm
+
+theorem canonicalCell_lower_eq_upper {c p : ComplexComplement ℓ}
+    (hp : p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ c) {h : H} (hr : ℓ h c.val.1 = 0) :
+    (tubeLowerChamber ℓ c).signs h = (phaseUpperChamber ℓ p).signs h := by
+  have hm := canonicalCell_imag ℓ hp hr
+  rw [tubeLowerChamber_signs_imag ℓ c hr]
+  change decide (0 < ℓ h c.val.2) = (faceChamber ℓ p.val.2 (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p)).signs h
+  rw [faceChamber_signs_nonzero ℓ p.val.2 _ (signHalfSpace_nonzero hm)]
+  exact halfspace_sign (ℓ h) hm
+
+/-- Canonical-cell centers have their actual lower phase chamber in the
+stated interval at every common point. -/
+theorem canonicalCell_chamberBetween {c p : ComplexComplement ℓ}
+    (hp : p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ c) :
+    ChamberBetween (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p) (tubeLowerChamber ℓ c) (phaseUpperChamber ℓ p) := by
+  intro h hshared
+  by_cases hr : ℓ h c.val.1 = 0
+  · exact (canonicalCell_lower_eq_upper ℓ hp hr).trans hshared.symm
+  · exact canonicalCell_lower_eq_lower ℓ hp hr
+
+private theorem bool_upper_interval {a c d : Bool} (h₁ : a = d → c = a)
+    (h₂ : a = c → d = a) : d = c := by
+  cases a <;> cases c <;> cases d <;> simp_all
+
+/-- An upper bound of the center chamber in the phase interval carries the
+whole actual canonical cell, not merely its chosen center or common point. -/
+theorem canonicalCell_subset_tubeSet {c p : ComplexComplement ℓ}
+    (hp : p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ c) (D : Chamber ℓ)
+    (h₁ : ChamberBetween (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p) (tubeLowerChamber ℓ c) D)
+    (h₂ : ChamberBetween (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p) D (phaseUpperChamber ℓ p)) :
+    canonicalCell ℓ c ⊆ tubeSet D := by
+  intro x hx h hxreal
+  have hr : ℓ h c.val.1 = 0 := by
+    by_contra hn
+    exact signHalfSpace_nonzero (canonicalCell_real ℓ hx hn) hxreal
+  have hcb := canonicalCell_lower_eq_upper ℓ hp hr
+  have hd : D.signs h = (tubeLowerChamber ℓ c).signs h :=
+    bool_upper_interval (h₁ h) (fun hac => h₂ h (hac.trans hcb))
+  rw [hd, tubeLowerChamber_signs_imag ℓ c hr]
+  exact canonicalCell_imag ℓ hx hr
+
+end ChamberCarriers
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+/-!
+# The actual universal-cover partition classifier
+
+The chosen order only enumerates the lifted-cover indices. It puts no new
+topology on the original complement or universal cover. The weight-space
+topology and the classifier are exactly the previously constructed ones.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Theorem18 Asphericity5
+open scoped Topology
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] (J : Set I)
+
+/-- Fix a single common enumeration order for every subsequent cover construction. -/
+noncomputable instance liftedCanonicalIndexLinearOrder :
+    LinearOrder (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) :=
+  IsWellOrder.linearOrder (@WellOrderingRel (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+
+/-- The literal common-intersection weight subspace of the actual lifted cover. -/
+abbrev ActualCoverWeights := CoverWeights (liftedCanonicalSet M J)
+
+/-- Original lifted-partition coefficients classify the actual universal cover. -/
+noncomputable def universalCoverWeightsClassifier :
+    C(ComplementUniversalCover M J, ActualCoverWeights M J) :=
+  numerableCoverClassifier (liftedCanonicalSet M J) (actualLiftedCanonicalPartition M J)
+    (actualLiftedCanonicalPartition_subordinate M J)
+
+@[simp] theorem universalCoverWeightsClassifier_apply
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) :
+    (universalCoverWeightsClassifier M J q).val.weights A =
+      actualLiftedCanonicalPartition M J A q :=
+  partitionWeightsValue_apply (actualLiftedCanonicalPartition M J) q A
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinDeligne.CanonicalCoverWeights
+import ArtinDeligne.SheetIntervals
+import ArtinDeligne.IncomingMeets
+import ArtinDeligne.GarsideTopology
+import ArtinDeligne.CarrierDescent
+
+/-!
+# The actual canonical-cover to Garside map
+
+A nonempty common-intersection face has actual incoming labels inside one
+simple phase interval. Their genuine lattice meet and join therefore bound
+a contractible interval carrier in the original Garside weight space.
+These carriers are monotone, so the proved coherent finite-simplex
+construction descends to a continuous map on the actual cover weights.
+No contraction or comparison map is supplied as a hypothesis.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Ribbon2 Homotopy5 Theorem18 Asphericity5 OAI.HarmonicArtin
+open Topology.NumerableConnectorCover
+attribute [local instance] Classical.decEq Classical.propDecidable
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] (J : Set I)
+
+/-- Actual common-intersection faces retain their common lift. -/
+theorem canonicalNerveFace_commonPoint (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) :
+    ∃ q : ComplementUniversalCover M J, ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hF
+  exact ⟨q, fun A hA => hq A hA⟩
+
+/-- The actual meet/join factor of the labels of any nonempty nerve face
+is simple, as a consequence of geometric sheet incidence. -/
+theorem canonicalPacketMeetJoin_simple (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) :
+    SimpleRibbon M
+      (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)).source
+      (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)).source
+      ((IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)).difference
+        (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+          (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF))) := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := canonicalNerveFace_commonPoint M J F hface
+  have hb : ∀ u ∈ canonicalPacketLabels M J F,
+      sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ u ∧ u ≤ sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q := by
+    intro u hu
+    obtain ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
+    exact canonicalIncomingLabel_phase_bounds M J A q (hq A hAF)
+  exact (IncomingVertex.finiteMeetJoin_simple_interval
+    (canonicalPacketLabels M J F) (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)
+    (sheetLowerVertex M J q) (sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q)
+    (fun u hu => (hb u hu).1) (fun u hu => (hb u hu).2)
+    (sheetPhaseInterval_simple M J q)).2.2.2
+
+/-- The literal Garside subspace carried by the meet/join interval. The
+empty face has no simplex and is assigned the empty set. -/
+def canonicalGarsideCarrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :
+    Set (GarsideWeights M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :=
+  if hF : F.Nonempty then
+    garsideIntervalCarrier M ⟨J⟩
+      (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF))
+      (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF))
+  else ∅
+
+theorem canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    canonicalGarsideCarrier M J F = garsideIntervalCarrier M ⟨J⟩
+      (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF))
+      (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)) := dite_eq_left hF
+
+theorem contractibleSpace_canonicalGarsideCarrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) :
+    ContractibleSpace (canonicalGarsideCarrier M J F) := by
+  rw [canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq M J F hF]
+  exact contractibleSpace_garsideIntervalCarrier M ⟨J⟩ (canonicalPacketMeetJoin_simple M J F hF hface)
+
+theorem canonicalGarsideCarrier_mono {F G : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)}
+    (hFG : F ⊆ G) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    canonicalGarsideCarrier M J F ⊆ canonicalGarsideCarrier M J G := by
+  have hG : G.Nonempty := hF.mono hFG
+  rw [canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq M J F hF, canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq M J G hG]
+  exact garsideIntervalCarrier_mono M ⟨J⟩
+    (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet_antitone (Finset.image_subset_image hFG) _ _)
+    (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin_mono (Finset.image_subset_image hFG) _ _)
+
+/-- Every field is proved from the actual cover and actual ribbon lattice.
+The generic family construction will construct the maps and all coherence. -/
+def canonicalGarsideCarrierData :
+    FiniteCarrierData (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (GarsideWeights M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) where
+  admissible := IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J)
+  hereditary hAB hB := hB.mono hAB
+  carrier := canonicalGarsideCarrier M J
+  contractible := contractibleSpace_canonicalGarsideCarrier M J
+  monotone hAB hA _ := canonicalGarsideCarrier_mono M J hAB hA
+
+/-- The genuine all-dimensional coherent family, constructed through
+contractible interval carriers rather than chosen independently on faces. -/
+def canonicalGarsideFamily : CarrierFamily (canonicalGarsideCarrierData M J) :=
+  (canonicalGarsideCarrierData M J).family
+
+/-- The continuous forward map on the literal actual-cover weight space.
+It uses the single cover-index order fixed in `CanonicalCoverWeights`. -/
+def canonicalGarsideMap :
+    C(ActualCoverWeights M J, GarsideWeights M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :=
+  (canonicalGarsideFamily M J).descend (IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J))
+    (fun {_ _} hAB hB => hB.mono hAB) (fun _ _ h => h)
+
+/-- Any original nerve face containing the support carries the map value.
+No chain premise is needed on this containing face. -/
+theorem canonicalGarsideMap_carried (w : ActualCoverWeights M J)
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    canonicalGarsideMap M J w ∈ canonicalGarsideCarrier M J F :=
+  (canonicalGarsideFamily M J).descend_carried_of_admissible
+    (IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J)) (fun {_ _} hAB hB => hB.mono hAB)
+    (fun _ _ h => h) w F hF hface hw
+
+
+/-- The carried conclusion in literal support coordinates of the existing
+Garside space, with the actual meet and join as its endpoints. -/
+theorem canonicalGarsideMap_support (w : ActualCoverWeights M J)
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    ∀ u ∈ (canonicalGarsideMap M J w).val.weights.support,
+      IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+          (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF) ≤ u ∧
+        u ≤ IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+          (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF) := by
+  have h := canonicalGarsideMap_carried M J w F hF hface hw
+  rw [canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq M J F hF] at h
+  exact h
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+

+import ArtinDeligne.SheetIntervals
+import ArtinDeligne.LiftedTubeComponents
+
+/-!
+# Literal connected-component carriers for canonical packets
+
+Admissible upper labels carry every whole lifted canonical cell in the packet.
+Their actual tube sheets are intersected, and the component containing the
+actual center of any one packet cell is the carrier. Overlap, simple incoming
+joins, and the proved component charts establish contractibility; it is not
+part of the definition. All choices of a packet cell give the same component.
+No linear order on the cover index is selected here.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Theorem18 Chamber3 Asphericity5 Ribbon2 Homotopy5 Topology
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] (J : Set I)
+
+/-- The literal common intersection of a finite packet of lifted canonical cells. -/
+def canonicalPacketOverlapSet (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :
+    Set (ComplementUniversalCover M J) := ⋂ A ∈ F, liftedCanonicalSet M J A
+
+theorem mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) :
+    q ∈ canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F ↔ ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A := by
+  simp only [canonicalPacketOverlapSet, Set.mem_iInter]
+
+/-- All actual simple upper labels that carry every whole packet cell. -/
+def canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :
+    Set (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :=
+  {u | ∀ A ∈ F, canonicalIncomingLabel M J A ≤ u ∧
+    SimpleRibbon M (canonicalIncomingLabel M J A).source u.source
+      ((canonicalIncomingLabel M J A).difference u) ∧
+    liftedCanonicalSet M J A ⊆ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u}
+
+/-- The genuine finite join is admissible whenever the actual packet overlaps. -/
+theorem canonicalPacketJoin_mem_admissible (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
+    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
+    canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F := by
+  classical
+  have hj := canonicalPacketJoin_carrier M J F hF q hq
+  intro A hAF
+  have hle : canonicalIncomingLabel M J A ≤ canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF :=
+    IncomingVertex.le_finiteJoin _ _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩)
+  exact ⟨hle, IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval (sheetPhaseInterval_simple M J q)
+    (canonicalIncomingLabel_phase_bounds M J A q (hq A hAF)).1 hle hj.2.1,
+    hj.2.2.2.2 A hAF⟩
+
+theorem canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper_nonempty (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty) :
+    (canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F).Nonempty := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hover
+  exact ⟨canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF, canonicalPacketJoin_mem_admissible M J F hF q
+    ((mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mp hq)⟩
+
+/-- More packet cells impose more conditions on the actual admissible upper labels. -/
+theorem canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper_antitone {F G : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)}
+    (hFG : F ⊆ G) :
+    canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J G ⊆ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F :=
+  fun _ hu A hA => hu A (hFG hA)
+
+/-- The literal intersection of all admissible actual tube sheets. -/
+def canonicalPacketUpperIntersection (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :
+    Set (ComplementUniversalCover M J) :=
+  ⋂ u ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F, incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u
+
+/-- The actual sheet indices of all admissible upper labels; this family may be infinite. -/
+def canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :
+    Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J) :=
+  incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J '' canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F
+
+theorem canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_eq (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :
+    canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F =
+      liftedTubeIntersection M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F) := by
+  ext q
+  simp only [canonicalPacketUpperIntersection, liftedTubeIntersection, Set.mem_iInter]
+  constructor
+  · rintro h A ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
+    exact h u hu
+  · intro h u hu
+    exact h _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
+
+/-- Every whole packet cell is contained in the intersection defining its carrier. -/
+theorem liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetUpperIntersection
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F) :
+    liftedCanonicalSet M J A ⊆ canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F := by
+  intro q hq
+  apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
+  intro u
+  apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
+  intro hu
+  exact (hu A hA).2.2 hq
+
+theorem canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_mono {F G : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)}
+    (hFG : F ⊆ G) :
+    canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F ⊆ canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J G := by
+  intro q hq
+  simp only [canonicalPacketUpperIntersection, Set.mem_iInter] at hq ⊢
+  intro u hu
+  exact hq u (canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper_antitone M J hFG hu)
+
+/-- Exactly the actual lifted center of a selected packet cell. No new geometric point is chosen. -/
+def canonicalPacketCenter (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    ComplementUniversalCover M J := liftedCanonicalCenter M J hF.choose
+
+theorem canonicalPacketCenter_mem (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    canonicalPacketCenter M J F hF ∈ canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F :=
+  liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetUpperIntersection M J F hF.choose hF.choose_spec
+    (liftedCanonicalCenter_mem M J hF.choose)

+/-- The literal actual connected component. Empty packets are assigned the empty set;
+no contractibility assertion is made for that default. -/
+def canonicalPacketCarrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :
+    Set (ComplementUniversalCover M J) :=
+  if hF : F.Nonempty then
+    connectedComponentIn (canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F) (canonicalPacketCenter M J F hF)
+  else ∅

+    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F =
+      connectedComponentIn (canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F) (canonicalPacketCenter M J F hF) := by
+  simp only [canonicalPacketCarrier, dite_eq_left hF]

+    (hF : F.Nonempty) : canonicalPacketCenter M J F hF ∈ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF]
+  exact mem_connectedComponentIn (canonicalPacketCenter_mem M J F hF)

+theorem canonicalPacketCarrier_subset_incomingSheet

+    (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))
+    (hu : u ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F) :
+    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F ⊆ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u := by
+  intro q hq
+  exact Set.mem_iInter.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp
+    (canonicalPacketCarrier_subset_upperIntersection M J F hF hq) u) hu
+
+/-- Contractibility is proved using the actual chart for a component of a nonempty
+family of genuine tube sheets. Neither total-space contractibility nor a nerve theorem is used. -/
+theorem contractibleSpace_canonicalPacketCarrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty) :
+    ContractibleSpace (canonicalPacketCarrier M J F) := by
+  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF, canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_eq M J F]
+  apply contractibleSpace_liftedTubeIntersectionComponent M J
+    (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F)
+    ((canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper_nonempty M J F hF hover).image _) _
+  rw [← canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_eq M J F]
+  exact canonicalPacketCenter_mem M J F hF
+
+/-- All packet cells lie in the component at any actual common overlap point. -/
+theorem liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetComponent (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
+    (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F) :
+    liftedCanonicalSet M J A ⊆ connectedComponentIn (canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F) q := by
+  have hconn : IsConnected (liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :=
+    isConnected_iff_connectedSpace.mpr inferInstance
+  exact hconn.isPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn (hq A hA)
+    (liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetUpperIntersection M J F A hA)
+
+/-- Every whole packet cell, and thus their union, belongs to the chosen carrier. -/
+theorem liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetCarrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty)
+    (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F) :
+    liftedCanonicalSet M J A ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hover
+  have hq' := (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mp hq
+  have hc := liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetComponent M J F q hq' hF.choose hF.choose_spec
+    (liftedCanonicalCenter_mem M J hF.choose)
+  have he := connectedComponentIn_eq hc
+  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF, canonicalPacketCenter, ← he]
+  exact liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetComponent M J F q hq' A hA
+
+theorem canonicalPacketUnion_subset_carrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty) :
+    (⋃ A ∈ F, liftedCanonicalSet M J A) ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  intro q hq
+  obtain ⟨A, hqA⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hq
+  obtain ⟨hA, hqA⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hqA
+  exact liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetCarrier M J F hF hover A hA hqA
+
+theorem canonicalPacketOverlapSet_subset_carrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty) :
+    canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  intro q hq
+  exact liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetCarrier M J F hF hover hF.choose hF.choose_spec
+    ((mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mp hq hF.choose hF.choose_spec)
+
+/-- Point containment directly from the actual common-point witnesses. -/
+theorem mem_canonicalPacketCarrier_of_common
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
+    q ∈ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  have hmem := (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mpr hq
+  exact canonicalPacketOverlapSet_subset_carrier M J F hF ⟨q, hmem⟩ hmem
+
+/-- Any actual point of any packet cell selects exactly the same component. -/
+theorem canonicalPacketCarrier_eq_component_of_mem_cell
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty)
+    (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F)
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
+    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F = connectedComponentIn (canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F) q := by
+  have hqC := liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetCarrier M J F hF hover A hA hq
+  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF] at hqC ⊢
+  exact connectedComponentIn_eq hqC
+
+/-- Independence of the selected packet cell in the literal component definition. -/

+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty)
+    (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F) :
+    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F = connectedComponentIn (canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F)
+      (liftedCanonicalCenter M J A) :=
+  canonicalPacketCarrier_eq_component_of_mem_cell M J F hF hover A hA _
+    (liftedCanonicalCenter_mem M J A)
+
+/-- Faces of an actual overlapping packet have nested actual carriers. -/
+theorem canonicalPacketCarrier_mono {F G : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)}
+    (hFG : F ⊆ G) (hF : F.Nonempty) (hG : G.Nonempty)
+    (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J G).Nonempty) :
+    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J G := by
+  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF,
+    canonicalPacketCarrier_eq_component_at_center M J G hG hover hF.choose (hFG hF.choose_spec)]
+  exact connectedComponentIn_mono _ (canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_mono M J hFG)
+
+/-- Face compatibility in the form supplied by an actual overlap point. -/
+theorem canonicalPacketCarrier_mono_of_common {F G : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)}
+    (hFG : F ⊆ G) (hF : F.Nonempty) (hG : G.Nonempty)
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ G, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
+    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J G :=
+  canonicalPacketCarrier_mono M J hFG hF hG
+    ⟨q, (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J G q).mpr hq⟩
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
