+import ArtinDeligne.HereditaryWeights
+import ArtinDeligne.AcyclicCarrierFamilies
+
+/-!
+# Descent of actual coherent simplex maps
+
+Point values are evaluated on the literal finite support. Face compatibility
+identifies this value with evaluation on every containing admissible face.
+Continuity uses the proved hereditary-subspace final topology, rather than
+assuming that coordinate continuity determines the infinite realization.
+No new external proof source is used: the coherent family is constructed in
+`AcyclicCarrierFamilies`, and finality is proved in `HereditaryWeights`.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open OAI.HarmonicArtin Convexity Topology
+attribute [local instance] Classical.decEq Classical.propDecidable
+
+variable {P Y : Type*} [PartialOrder P] [TopologicalSpace Y]
+
+/-- Actual barycentric coordinates on any finite carrier containing the support. -/
+noncomputable def weightFaceCoordinates (F : Finset P) (w : OrderWeights P)
+    (hw : w.weights.support ⊆ F) : StdSimplex ℝ F :=
+  ⟨Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (fun p => w.weights p.val), fun p => w.nonneg p.val, by
+    rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by intro; rfl)]
+    change (∑ p : F, w.weights p.val) = 1
+    rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort, ← w.total]
+    symm
+    exact Finset.sum_subset hw (fun p _ hp => Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hp)⟩
+
+@[simp] theorem weightFaceCoordinates_apply (F : Finset P) (w : OrderWeights P)
+    (hw : w.weights.support ⊆ F) (p : F) :
+    (weightFaceCoordinates F w hw).weights p = w.weights p.val := rfl
+
+/-- The corresponding ambient geometric simplex, used only for equality of
+finite coordinates; it does not replace the actual weighted topology. -/
+def orderWeightsSimplex (w : OrderWeights P) : StdSimplex ℝ P :=
+  ⟨w.weights, w.nonneg, w.total⟩
+
+theorem weightFaceCoordinates_map_val (F : Finset P) (w : OrderWeights P)
+    (hw : w.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    (weightFaceCoordinates F w hw).map (fun p : F => p.val) = orderWeightsSimplex w := by
+  ext p
+  by_cases hp : p ∈ F
+  · have he : p = (⟨p, hp⟩ : F).val := rfl
+    rw [he, StdSimplex.map_apply_injective Subtype.val_injective]
+    rfl
+  · have hn : p ∉ Set.range (fun q : F => q.val) := by
+      rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
+      exact hp q.property
+    change Finsupp.mapDomain (fun q : F => q.val) (weightFaceCoordinates F w hw).weights p = w.weights p
+    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ hn]
+    exact (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (fun h => hp (hw h))).symm
+
+/-- These coordinates commute with literal zero-coordinate face inclusions. -/
+theorem weightFaceCoordinates_natural {A B : Finset P} (hAB : A ⊆ B)
+    (w : OrderWeights P) (hA : w.weights.support ⊆ A) :
+    (weightFaceCoordinates A w hA).map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB) =
+      weightFaceCoordinates B w (hA.trans hAB) := by
+  apply StdSimplex.simplex_map_injective (fun a b h => Subtype.ext h)
+    (f := fun p : B => p.val)
+  rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
+  change (weightFaceCoordinates A w hA).map (fun p : A => p.val) = _
+  rw [weightFaceCoordinates_map_val, weightFaceCoordinates_map_val]
+
+theorem continuous_weightFaceCoordinates {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
+    (F : Finset P) (f : C(X, OrderWeights P))
+    (hf : ∀ x, (f x).weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    Continuous (fun x => weightFaceCoordinates F (f x) (hf x)) := by
+  rw [(StdSimplex.isEmbedding_toFun_comp_weights ℝ F).continuous_iff]
+  exact continuous_pi (fun p => (weightEval_continuous p.val).comp f.continuous)
+
+theorem orderWeights_support_isChain (w : OrderWeights P) :
+    IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑w.weights.support : Set P) :=
+  fun a ha b hb _ => w.chain a ha b hb
+
+namespace CarrierFamily
+
+variable {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} (family : CarrierFamily D)
+variable (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
+  (had : ∀ F : Finset P, IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P) → S F → D.admissible F)
+
+/-- Evaluation uses the actual support, which is always a nonempty chain. -/
+noncomputable def descendFun (w : SubcomplexWeights S) : Y :=
+  family.map w.val.weights.support w.val.support_nonempty
+    (had _ (orderWeights_support_isChain w.val) w.property)
+    (weightFaceCoordinates _ w.val (Finset.Subset.refl _))
+
+/-- Any admissible containing face can be used, even if its admissibility is
+given independently of the domain's hereditary predicate. -/
+theorem descendFun_eq_of_admissible (w : SubcomplexWeights S) (F : Finset P)
+    (hne : F.Nonempty) (hDF : D.admissible F) (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    family.descendFun S had w =
+      family.map F hne hDF (weightFaceCoordinates F w.val hw) := by
+  symm
+  have h := family.compatible w.val.support_nonempty hne
+    (had _ (orderWeights_support_isChain w.val) w.property) hDF hw
+    (weightFaceCoordinates _ w.val (Finset.Subset.refl _))
+  rwa [weightFaceCoordinates_natural] at h
+
+/-- Evaluation on any containing admissible finite chain gives the same
+point, including points on all proper faces. -/
+theorem descendFun_eq (w : SubcomplexWeights S) (F : Finset P)
+    (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F)
+    (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    family.descendFun S had w =
+      family.map F hne (had F hF hSF) (weightFaceCoordinates F w.val hw) := by
+  symm
+  have h := family.compatible w.val.support_nonempty hne
+    (had _ (orderWeights_support_isChain w.val) w.property) (had F hF hSF) hw
+    (weightFaceCoordinates _ w.val (Finset.Subset.refl _))
+  rwa [weightFaceCoordinates_natural] at h
+
+theorem descendFun_carried (w : SubcomplexWeights S) (F : Finset P)
+    (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F)
+    (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) : family.descendFun S had w ∈ D.carrier F := by
+  rw [family.descendFun_eq S had w F hF hne hSF hw]
+  exact family.carried _ _ _ _
+
+include hS in
+/-- Global continuity follows from genuine finite-chart finality on the
+literal hereditary subspace. -/
+theorem continuous_descendFun : Continuous (family.descendFun S had) := by
+  apply (continuous_subcomplex_iff_canonical S hS _).mpr
+  intro F hF hne hSF
+  let c := subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF
+  let f : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (F.card - 1 + 1)), OrderWeights P) :=
+    ⟨fun z => (c z).val,
+      continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF)⟩
+  have hf (z) : (f z).weights.support ⊆ F := by
+    change (orderWeightsOfChain (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) z).weights.support ⊆ F
+    exact (chainWeights_support (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) z).trans
+      (by rw [finiteChainOrder_range])
+  have hc := (family.map F hne (had F hF hSF)).continuous.comp
+    (continuous_weightFaceCoordinates F f hf)
+  apply hc.congr
+  intro z
+  exact (family.descendFun_eq S had (c z) F hF hne hSF (hf z)).symm
+
+/-- The actual continuous map descended from the coherent family. -/
+noncomputable def descend : C(SubcomplexWeights S, Y) :=
+  ⟨family.descendFun S had, family.continuous_descendFun S hS had⟩
+
+theorem descend_carried (w : SubcomplexWeights S) (F : Finset P)
+    (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F)
+    (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) : family.descend S hS had w ∈ D.carrier F :=
+  family.descendFun_carried S had w F hF hne hSF hw
+
+theorem descend_carried_of_admissible (w : SubcomplexWeights S) (F : Finset P)
+    (hne : F.Nonempty) (hDF : D.admissible F) (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    family.descend S hS had w ∈ D.carrier F := by
+  change family.descendFun S had w ∈ D.carrier F
+  rw [family.descendFun_eq_of_admissible S had w F hne hDF hw]
+  exact family.carried _ _ _ _
+
+end CarrierFamily
+
+namespace CarrierHomotopy
+
+variable {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} {f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D}
+  (H : CarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁)
+variable (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
+  (had : ∀ F : Finset P, IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P) → S F → D.admissible F)
+
+/-- The actual support selects the homotopy value, at every time. -/
+noncomputable def descendFun (t : unitInterval) (w : SubcomplexWeights S) : Y :=
+  H.hom w.val.weights.support w.val.support_nonempty
+    (had _ (orderWeights_support_isChain w.val) w.property)
+    (t, weightFaceCoordinates _ w.val (Finset.Subset.refl _))
+
+theorem descendFun_eq_of_admissible (t : unitInterval) (w : SubcomplexWeights S)
+    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hDF : D.admissible F)
+    (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    H.descendFun S had t w = H.hom F hne hDF (t, weightFaceCoordinates F w.val hw) := by
+  symm
+  have h := H.compatible w.val.support_nonempty hne
+    (had _ (orderWeights_support_isChain w.val) w.property) hDF hw t
+    (weightFaceCoordinates _ w.val (Finset.Subset.refl _))
+  rwa [weightFaceCoordinates_natural] at h
+
+theorem descendFun_eq (t : unitInterval) (w : SubcomplexWeights S) (F : Finset P)
+    (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F)
+    (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    H.descendFun S had t w =
+      H.hom F hne (had F hF hSF) (t, weightFaceCoordinates F w.val hw) := by
+  symm
+  have h := H.compatible w.val.support_nonempty hne
+    (had _ (orderWeights_support_isChain w.val) w.property) (had F hF hSF) hw t
+    (weightFaceCoordinates _ w.val (Finset.Subset.refl _))
+  rwa [weightFaceCoordinates_natural] at h
+
+include hS in
+theorem continuous_descendFun :
+    Continuous (fun p : unitInterval × SubcomplexWeights S => H.descendFun S had p.1 p.2) := by
+  apply (continuous_subcomplex_prod_iff_canonical S hS _).mpr
+  intro F hF hne hSF
+  let c := subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF
+  let f : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (F.card - 1 + 1)), OrderWeights P) :=
+    ⟨fun z => (c z).val,
+      continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF)⟩
+  have hf (z) : (f z).weights.support ⊆ F := by
+    change (orderWeightsOfChain (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) z).weights.support ⊆ F
+    exact (chainWeights_support (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) z).trans
+      (by rw [finiteChainOrder_range])
+  have hc := (H.hom F hne (had F hF hSF)).continuous.comp
+    (continuous_fst.prodMk ((continuous_weightFaceCoordinates F f hf).comp continuous_snd))
+  apply hc.congr
+  intro p
+  exact (H.descendFun_eq S had p.1 (c p.2) F hF hne hSF (hf p.2)).symm
+
+/-- Descent retains both exact endpoint maps. Product continuity follows from
+the proved locally compact parameter version of hereditary chart finality. -/
+noncomputable def descend :
+    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.descend S hS had) (f₁.descend S hS had) where
+  toFun p := H.descendFun S had p.1 p.2
+  continuous_toFun := H.continuous_descendFun S hS had
+  map_zero_left _w := (H.hom _ _ _).apply_zero _
+  map_one_left _w := (H.hom _ _ _).apply_one _
+
+theorem descend_carried (t : unitInterval) (w : SubcomplexWeights S) (F : Finset P)
+    (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F)
+    (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) : H.descend S hS had (t, w) ∈ D.carrier F := by
+  change H.descendFun S had t w ∈ D.carrier F
+  rw [H.descendFun_eq S had t w F hF hne hSF hw]
+  exact H.carried _ _ _ _ _
+
+theorem descend_carried_of_admissible (t : unitInterval) (w : SubcomplexWeights S)
+    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hDF : D.admissible F)
+    (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) : H.descend S hS had (t, w) ∈ D.carrier F := by
+  change H.descendFun S had t w ∈ D.carrier F
+  rw [H.descendFun_eq_of_admissible S had t w F hne hDF hw]
+  exact H.carried _ _ _ _ _
+
+end CarrierHomotopy
+
+/-- A continuous map obtained directly from contractibility and monotonicity
+data, through the proved all-dimensional coherent-family construction. -/
+noncomputable def FiniteCarrierData.descendedMap (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) :
+    C(SubcomplexWeights D.admissible, Y) :=
+  D.family.descend D.admissible (fun {_ _} hAB hB => D.hereditary hAB hB) (fun _ _ h => h)
+
+/-- The constructed coherent homotopy descends to a genuine global homotopy;
+there is no homotopy or extension supplied as an additional hypothesis. -/
+noncomputable def CarrierFamily.descendedHomotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y}
+    (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
+    (had : ∀ F : Finset P, IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P) → S F → D.admissible F) :
+    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.descend S hS had) (f₁.descend S hS had) :=
+  (f₀.homotopy f₁).descend S hS had
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+`bac5cab53eb6526e366e861d289253ec81aa89f0`, relocated without changing these
+mathematical objects. No extension or filler is assumed for the target.

+/-- A contractible target extends every map across a map having HEP. -/
+theorem exists_extension_of_hep
+    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} [ContractibleSpace Z]
+    (i : A ⟶ B) (hi : TopCat.HomotopyExtensionProperty i) (h : C(A, Z)) :
+    ∃ F : C(B, Z), ∀ a, F (i a) = h a := by
+  obtain ⟨z, ⟨L⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic Z
+  let H : C(I × A, Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ L.symm (p.1, h p.2), by fun_prop⟩
+  obtain ⟨K, _, hK⟩ := TopCat.homotopyExtensionProperty_continuous hi Z
+    (ContinuousMap.const B z) H (fun a ↦ L.symm.apply_zero (h a))
+  refine ⟨⟨fun b ↦ K (1, b), by fun_prop⟩, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
+  exact (hK 1 a).trans (L.symm.apply_one (h a))

+/-- Side data with both endpoint maps glued on the actual cylinder-boundary
+pushout. The domain is not replaced by an assumed boundary filler. -/
+def cylinderBoundaryData
+    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} (i : A ⟶ B) (f₀ f₁ : C(B, Z))
+    (H : C(I × A, Z))
+    (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ (i a))
+    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ (i a)) : TopCat.CylinderBoundary i ⟶ Z :=
+  pushout.desc
+    (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p ↦ H (p.2, p.1), by fun_prop⟩)
+    (TopCat.ofHom ⟨Sum.elim f₀ f₁, f₀.continuous.sumElim f₁.continuous⟩)
+    (by
+      ext a
+      cases a with
+      | inl a => exact h₀ a
+      | inr a => exact h₁ a)
+
+@[simp] theorem cylinderBoundaryData_side
+    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} (i : A ⟶ B) (f₀ f₁ : C(B, Z))
+    (H : C(I × A, Z)) (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ (i a))
+    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ (i a)) (a : A) (t : I) :
+    cylinderBoundaryData i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁
+      (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySide i (a, t)) = H (t, a) :=
+  by
+    have he : TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySide i ≫
+        cylinderBoundaryData i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ =
+        TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p : A × I ↦ H (p.2, p.1), by fun_prop⟩ :=
+      pushout.inl_desc _ _ _
+    simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
+      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
+      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom he (a, t)
+
+@[simp] theorem cylinderBoundaryData_cap_zero
+    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} (i : A ⟶ B) (f₀ f₁ : C(B, Z))
+    (H : C(I × A, Z)) (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ (i a))
+    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ (i a)) (b : B) :
+    cylinderBoundaryData i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁
+      (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inl b)) = f₀ b :=
+  by
+    have he : TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i ≫
+        cylinderBoundaryData i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ =
+        TopCat.ofHom ⟨Sum.elim f₀ f₁, f₀.continuous.sumElim f₁.continuous⟩ :=
+      pushout.inr_desc _ _ _
+    simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
+      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
+      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using
+      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom he (Sum.inl b)

+@[simp] theorem cylinderBoundaryData_cap_one
+    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} (i : A ⟶ B) (f₀ f₁ : C(B, Z))
+    (H : C(I × A, Z)) (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ (i a))
+    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ (i a)) (b : B) :
+    cylinderBoundaryData i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁
+      (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inr b)) = f₁ b :=
+  by
+    have he : TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i ≫
+        cylinderBoundaryData i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ =
+        TopCat.ofHom ⟨Sum.elim f₀ f₁, f₀.continuous.sumElim f₁.continuous⟩ :=

+    simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
+      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
+      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using
+      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom he (Sum.inr b)

+/-- Every prescribed boundary homotopy between two maps into a contractible
+space extends, retaining both complete endpoint maps and the exact side data. -/
+theorem exists_homotopy_extension_of_hep
+    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} [ContractibleSpace Z]
+    (i : A ⟶ B) (hi : TopCat.HomotopyExtensionProperty i)
+    (f₀ f₁ : C(B, Z)) (H : C(I × A, Z))
+    (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ (i a))
+    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ (i a)) :
+    ∃ K : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁, ∀ t a, K (t, i a) = H (t, a) := by

+  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_extension_of_hep
+    (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryMap i)

+  have hside (a : A) (t : I) : F (i a, t) = H (t, a) := by
+    have he := hF (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySide i (a, t))
+    have hm : TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryMap i
+        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySide i (a, t)) = (i a, t) := by
+      simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
+      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
+      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySide_map i) (a, t)
+    rw [hm] at he
+    exact he.trans (cylinderBoundaryData_side i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ a t)

+    have he := hF (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inl b))

+        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inl b)) = (b, 0) := by
+      simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
+      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
+      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps_map i) (Sum.inl b)
+    rw [hm] at he
+    exact he.trans (cylinderBoundaryData_cap_zero i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ b)
+  have hone (b : B) : F (b, 1) = f₁ b := by
+    have he := hF (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inr b))
+    have hm : TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryMap i
+        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inr b)) = (b, 1) := by
+      simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
+      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
+      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps_map i) (Sum.inr b)
+    rw [hm] at he
+    exact he.trans (cylinderBoundaryData_cap_one i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ b)
+  exact ⟨⟨⟨fun p ↦ F (p.2, p.1), by fun_prop⟩, hzero, hone⟩,
+    fun t a ↦ hside a t⟩
+
+/-- Two prescribed maps of the literal geometric simplex extend any homotopy
+on its literal boundary, with equality on the whole side. This also includes
+the empty boundary of the zero-dimensional simplex. -/
+theorem exists_simplex_boundary_homotopy_extension
+    {Z : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Z] [ContractibleSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
+    (f₀ f₁ : C(Convexity.StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z))
+    (H : C(I × Convexity.StdSimplex.boundary n, Z))
+    (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ a.1)
+    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ a.1) :
+    ∃ K : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁,
+      ∀ t (a : Convexity.StdSimplex.boundary n), K (t, a.1) = H (t, a) := by
+  let X : TopCat.{u} := TopCat.of PUnit.{u + 1}
+  let g₀ : C(X × Convexity.StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ f₀ p.2, by fun_prop⟩
+  let g₁ : C(X × Convexity.StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ f₁ p.2, by fun_prop⟩
+  let G : C(I × (X × Convexity.StdSimplex.boundary n), Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ H (p.1, p.2.2), by fun_prop⟩
+  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_homotopy_extension_of_hep (Z := TopCat.of Z)

+  refine ⟨⟨⟨fun p ↦ L (p.1, (PUnit.unit, p.2)), by fun_prop⟩,
+    fun a ↦ L.apply_zero (PUnit.unit, a),
+    fun a ↦ L.apply_one (PUnit.unit, a)⟩, ?_⟩
+  intro t a
+  exact hL t (PUnit.unit, a)
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+/-!
+# Finite carriers closed under a terminating reduction
+
+A reduction which fixes a point or strictly decreases a natural measure has
+finite ancestry from each finite set. Any invariant property of the starting
+points is preserved. This is a purely finite termination lemma; its geometric
+application must separately prove continuity and the carrier conditions.

+/-- Close a finite set under a deterministic, terminating reduction without
+introducing points outside a proved invariant property. -/
+theorem exists_finite_closed_ancestry {P : Type u} (step : P → P) (measure : P → ℕ)
+    (Q : P → Prop) (hstep : ∀ x, step x = x ∨ measure (step x) < measure x)
+    (hQ : ∀ x, Q x → Q (step x)) :
+    ∀ A : Finset P, (∀ x ∈ A, Q x) →
+      ∃ B : Finset P, A ⊆ B ∧ (∀ x ∈ B, Q x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ B, step x ∈ B := by
+  classical
+  have single : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : P, measure x = n → Q x →
+      ∃ B : Finset P, x ∈ B ∧ (∀ y ∈ B, Q y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, step y ∈ B := by
+    intro n
+    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
+    | ind n ih =>
+      intro x hn hx
+      rcases hstep x with hfix | hdec
+      · refine ⟨{x}, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
+        · intro y hy
+          simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy] using hx
+        · intro y hy
+          rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy, hfix]
+          simp
+      · obtain ⟨B, hfx, hBQ, hclosed⟩ :=
+          ih (measure (step x)) (by omega) (step x) rfl (hQ x hx)
+        refine ⟨insert x B, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
+        · intro y hy
+          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
+          · exact hx
+          · exact hBQ y hy
+        · intro y hy
+          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
+          · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hfx
+          · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hclosed y hy)
+  intro A
+  induction A using Finset.induction_on with
+  | empty =>
+    intro _
+    exact ⟨∅, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
+  | @insert x A hx ih =>
+    intro hA
+    obtain ⟨B, hAB, hBQ, hBclosed⟩ :=
+      ih (fun y hy => hA y (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hy))
+    obtain ⟨C, hxC, hCQ, hCclosed⟩ :=
+      single (measure x) x rfl (hA x (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
+    refine ⟨B ∪ C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · intro y hy
+      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
+      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hxC
+      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (hAB hy)
+    · intro y hy
+      exact (Finset.mem_union.mp hy).elim (hBQ y) (hCQ y)
+    · intro y hy
+      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hy with hy | hy
+      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (hBclosed y hy)
+      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (hCclosed y hy)
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinDeligne.GarsideWeights

+/-!
+# Finite barycentric deletion in the actual simple-chain space
+
+Mass is transferred from a vertex to its proved head-removal cone vertex.
+The coordinate formulas preserve nonnegativity, total weight, genuine chain
+support and simplicity. All maps carry the inherited weighted-realization
+topology. Finite iteration is the route to nullhomotopies; no contraction
+or higher-topology conclusion is assumed as data.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+open OAI.HarmonicArtin Topology
+open scoped BigOperators unitInterval
+
+namespace FiniteWeightTransfer
+attribute [local instance] Classical.decEq Classical.propDecidable
+variable {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] [Finite P]
+
+noncomputable def movedWeights (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P) : P →₀ ℝ := by
+  classical
+  exact Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (fun i =>
+    w.weights i + (if i = q then (t : ℝ) * w.weights p else 0) -
+      (if i = p then (t : ℝ) * w.weights p else 0))
+
+@[simp] theorem movedWeights_apply (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P) (i : P) :
+    movedWeights p q t w i =
+      w.weights i + (if i = q then (t : ℝ) * w.weights p else 0) -
+        (if i = p then (t : ℝ) * w.weights p else 0) := rfl
+
+theorem movedWeights_nonneg (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P) (i : P) :
+    0 ≤ movedWeights p q t w i := by
+  classical
+  rw [movedWeights_apply]
+  by_cases hp : i = p
+  · subst i
+    by_cases hq : p = q
+    · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte, add_sub_cancel_right]
+      exact w.nonneg q
+    · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
+      have h := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr t.property.2) (w.nonneg p)
+      nlinarith
+  · simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
+    split_ifs
+    · exact add_nonneg (w.nonneg i) (mul_nonneg t.property.1 (w.nonneg p))
+    · simpa only [add_zero] using w.nonneg i
+
+theorem movedWeights_total (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P) :
+    (movedWeights p q t w).sum (fun _ a => a) = 1 := by
+  classical
+  let : Fintype P := Fintype.ofFinite P
+  have hsum : (∑ i, w.weights i) = 1 := by
+    rw [← Finsupp.sum_fintype w.weights (fun _ a => a) (by intro; rfl)]
+    exact w.total
+  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by intro; rfl)]
+  simp only [movedWeights_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
+    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
+  linarith
+
+theorem movedWeights_support (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P)
+    {i : P} (hi : i ∈ (movedWeights p q t w).support) :
+    i ∈ w.weights.support ∨ i = q := by
+  classical
+  by_cases hq : i = q
+  · exact Or.inr hq
+  · left
+    by_contra hno
+    have hw : w.weights i = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hno
+    have hz : movedWeights p q t w i = 0 := by
+      rw [movedWeights_apply]
+      by_cases hp : i = p
+      · subst i
+        simp only [hw, mul_zero, ite_self, sub_zero, add_zero]
+      · simp only [hw, hq, hp, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, sub_zero]
+    exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) hz
+
+
+
+theorem movedWeights_zero (p q : P) (w : OrderWeights P) : movedWeights p q 0 w = w.weights := by
+  classical
+  ext i
+  simp [movedWeights_apply]
+
+theorem movedWeights_eq_of_notMem (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P)
+    (hp : p ∉ w.weights.support) : movedWeights p q t w = w.weights := by
+  classical
+  have hz := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hp
+  ext i
+  simp only [movedWeights_apply, hz, mul_zero, ite_self, add_zero, sub_zero]
+
+theorem movedWeights_one_source (p q : P) (hpq : p ≠ q) (w : OrderWeights P) :
+    movedWeights p q 1 w p = 0 := by
+  classical
+  simp [movedWeights_apply, hpq]
+
+noncomputable def moveOrderWeights (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P)
+    (hcone : p ∈ w.weights.support → ∀ i ∈ w.weights.support, i ≤ q) : OrderWeights P where
+  weights := movedWeights p q t w
+  nonneg := movedWeights_nonneg p q t w
+  total := movedWeights_total p q t w
+  chain := by
+    intro i hi j hj
+    by_cases hp : p ∈ w.weights.support
+    · rcases movedWeights_support p q t w hi with hiold | hiq
+      · rcases movedWeights_support p q t w hj with hjold | hjq
+        · exact w.chain i hiold j hjold
+        · exact Or.inl (hjq.symm ▸ hcone hp i hiold)
+      · rcases movedWeights_support p q t w hj with hjold | hjq
+        · exact Or.inr (hiq.symm ▸ hcone hp j hjold)
+        · exact Or.inl (le_of_eq (hiq.trans hjq.symm))
+    · rw [movedWeights_eq_of_notMem p q t w hp] at hi hj
+      exact w.chain i hi j hj
+
+theorem continuous_moveOrderWeights {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
+    (p q : P) (f : C(X, OrderWeights P))
+    (hcone : ∀ x, p ∈ (f x).weights.support → ∀ i ∈ (f x).weights.support, i ≤ q) :
+    Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => moveOrderWeights p q z.1 (f z.2) (hcone z.2)) := by
+  apply (FiniteWeightCoordinates.continuous_iff_coordinates _).mpr
+  intro i
+  have hwi : Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => (f z.2).weights i) :=
+    (weightEval_continuous i).comp (f.continuous.comp continuous_snd)
+  have hwp : Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => (f z.2).weights p) :=
+    (weightEval_continuous p).comp (f.continuous.comp continuous_snd)
+  have ht : Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => (z.1 : ℝ)) :=
+    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
+  change Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => movedWeights p q z.1 (f z.2) i)
+  simp only [movedWeights_apply]
+  split_ifs
+  · exact (hwi.add (ht.mul hwp)).sub (ht.mul hwp)
+  · exact (hwi.add (ht.mul hwp)).sub continuous_const
+  · exact (hwi.add continuous_const).sub (ht.mul hwp)
+  · exact (hwi.add continuous_const).sub continuous_const
+
+end FiniteWeightTransfer

+/-- In a positive carrier, a maximal-degree active vertex is the minimum

+theorem active_le_headStep {A : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)}
+    (hpos : ∀ u : A, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u.val)
+    (w : GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A) (p : A) (hp : p ∈ w.val.weights.support)
+    (hmax : ∀ i ∈ w.val.weights.support, degree M i.val.value ≤ degree M p.val.value)
+    (hne : p.val.value ≠ 1) (i : A) (hi : i ∈ w.val.weights.support) :
+    i.val ≤ headStep M B0 p.val ∧
+      SimpleRibbon M i.val.source (headStep M B0 p.val).source
+        (i.val.difference (headStep M B0 p.val)) := by
+  have hpi : p ≤ i := by
+    rcases w.val.chain p hp i hi with hpi | hip
+    · exact hpi
+    · by_contra hnot
+      have hlt : i.val < p.val := (lt_iff_le_not_ge).mpr ⟨hip, hnot⟩

+# The actual weak topology and interval carriers of Garside weights

+space has the proved admissible-chart finality and product finality of its
+actual subspace topology. A simple interval carrier is an actual subspace
+of this space. It is homeomorphic to the genuine order realization of that
+interval, which has a top vertex and therefore contracts.
+-/

+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false

+attribute [local instance] Classical.decEq Classical.propDecidable

+/-- The actual finite simple-chain predicate, with no topological fields. -/
+def garsideSupportPredicate (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) : Prop :=
+  ∀ u ∈ F, ∀ v ∈ F, u ≤ v → SimpleRibbon M u.source v.source (u.difference v)
+
+theorem garsideSupportPredicate_hereditary : SupportHereditary (garsideSupportPredicate M B0) := by
+  intro A B hAB hB u hu v hv huv
+  exact hB u (hAB hu) v (hAB hv) huv

+    GarsideWeights M B0 = SubcomplexWeights (garsideSupportPredicate M B0) := rfl

+  isClosed_subcomplexWeights (garsideSupportPredicate M B0) (garsideSupportPredicate_hereditary M B0)

+    (hx : garsideSupportPredicate M B0 (Finset.univ.image x))

+  subcomplexChart (garsideSupportPredicate M B0) (garsideSupportPredicate_hereditary M B0) x hx z
+
+theorem continuous_garside_iff {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : GarsideWeights M B0 → Y) :
+    Continuous f ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) →o IncomingVertex M B0)
+      (hx : garsideSupportPredicate M B0 (Finset.univ.image x)),
+      Continuous (fun z => f (garsideChart M B0 x hx z)) :=
+  continuous_subcomplex_iff (garsideSupportPredicate M B0) (garsideSupportPredicate_hereditary M B0) f

+    (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) (hne : F.Nonempty)

+map into the original universal cover, without assuming a comparison map.

+/-- The original fiber point of the actual tube labelled by an incoming vertex. -/

+    ComplementUniversalCover M J := (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J v).fiberPoint.val

+    (congrArg (tubeBasepoint M J) (incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber M J v))

+  monotone := garsideTubeCarrier_mono M J

+# Actual simple-chain weighted spaces and finite carriers
+
+These spaces have the actual subspace topology inside the genuine weighted
+order realization of incoming ribbon vertices. Supports are required to
+have simple connecting arrows. This is a hereditary geometric simplicial
+condition, not a contractibility field. Finite coordinate continuity and
+compact finite-carrier factorization use the verified realization topology.

+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false

+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+open Ribbon2 Homotopy5 Chamber3 OAI.HarmonicArtin Topology

+namespace FiniteWeightCoordinates

+variable {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]

+/-- The actual finite weighted realization embeds in its real coordinates. -/
+theorem isClosedEmbedding_coordinates [Finite P] :
+    IsClosedEmbedding (fun w : OrderWeights P => fun p => w.weights p) := by
+  apply (continuous_pi weightEval_continuous).isClosedEmbedding
+  intro u v h
+  apply OrderWeights.ext
+  exact DFunLike.ext' h
+
+/-- No single-chain carrier assumption is needed in a finite vertex set. -/
+theorem continuous_iff_coordinates [Finite P] {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
+    (f : X → OrderWeights P) :
+    Continuous f ↔ ∀ p, Continuous (fun x => (f x).weights p) := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h p
+    exact (weightEval_continuous p).comp h
+  · intro h
+    exact (isClosedEmbedding_coordinates (P := P)).isEmbedding.isInducing.continuous_iff.mpr
+      (continuous_pi h)
+
+end FiniteWeightCoordinates

+def garsideWeightsSet : Set (OrderWeights (IncomingVertex M B0)) :=
+  {w | ∀ u ∈ w.weights.support, ∀ v ∈ w.weights.support, u ≤ v →
+    SimpleRibbon M u.source v.source (u.difference v)}

+/-- The hereditary simple-chain subspace of the genuine incoming realization. -/
+abbrev GarsideWeights := ↥(garsideWeightsSet M B0)

+theorem GarsideWeights.simple (w : GarsideWeights M B0)

+    SimpleRibbon M u.source v.source (u.difference v) := w.property u hu v hv huv

+      u ≤ positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu ∧
+      SimpleRibbon M u.source (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu).source
+        (u.difference (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu)) ∧
+      (∀ q : IncomingVertex M B0, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 q → u ≤ q →
+        SimpleRibbon M u.source q.source (u.difference q) →
+        q ≤ positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu ∧
+          SimpleRibbon M q.source (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu).source
+            (q.difference (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu))) ∧
+      (u.value ≠ 1 → degree M (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu).value < degree M u.value) :=
+  Classical.choose_spec (exists_positive_headTail M B0 u hu)

+noncomputable def headStep (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : IncomingVertex M B0 := by
+  classical
+  exact if h : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u ∧ u.value ≠ 1

+theorem headStep_eq (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
+    (hu : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) (hne : u.value ≠ 1) :

+  classical
+  unfold headStep
+  rw [dite_eq_left ⟨hu, hne⟩]

+theorem headStep_eq_self_of_value_eq_one (u : IncomingVertex M B0) (hu : u.value = 1) :
+    headStep M B0 u = u := by
+  classical
+  simp only [headStep, hu, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, and_false, ↓reduceDIte]
+
+theorem headStep_positive (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
+    (hu : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) :
+    IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 (headStep M B0 u) := by
+  classical
+  by_cases hne : u.value ≠ 1
+  · rw [headStep_eq M B0 u hu hne]
+    exact (positiveHeadTail_spec M B0 u hu).1
+  · rw [headStep_eq_self_of_value_eq_one M B0 u (not_ne_iff.mp hne)]
+    exact hu
+
+theorem headStep_degree_lt (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
+    (hu : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) (hne : u.value ≠ 1) :
+    degree M (headStep M B0 u).value < degree M u.value := by
+  rw [headStep_eq M B0 u hu hne]
+  exact (positiveHeadTail_spec M B0 u hu).2.2.2.2 hne
+
+theorem headStep_measure (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    headStep M B0 u = u ∨
+      (degree M (headStep M B0 u).value).toNat < (degree M u.value).toNat := by
+  classical
+  by_cases hu : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u
+  · by_cases hne : u.value ≠ 1
+    · right
+      have hlt := headStep_degree_lt M B0 u hu hne
+      have hn := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ
+        (headStep_positive M B0 u hu).positive
+      omega
+    · exact Or.inl (headStep_eq_self_of_value_eq_one M B0 u (not_ne_iff.mp hne))
+  · left
+    simp only [headStep, hu, false_and, ↓reduceDIte]
+
+/-- Finite positive carriers have genuine finite head-closed enlargements,
+containing the actual identity vertex and no nonpositive vertices. -/
+theorem exists_finite_positive_head_closed (A : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0))
+    (hA : ∀ u ∈ A, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) :
+    ∃ B : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0), A ⊆ B ∧ incomingRoot M B0 ∈ B ∧
+      (∀ u ∈ B, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) ∧
+      ∀ u ∈ B, headStep M B0 u ∈ B := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨B, hAB, hBpos, hBclosed⟩ := exists_finite_closed_ancestry
+    (headStep M B0) (fun u => (degree M u.value).toNat)
+    (IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0) (headStep_measure M B0) (headStep_positive M B0)
+    (insert (incomingRoot M B0) A) (by
+      intro u hu
+      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hu with rfl | hu
+      · exact incomingRoot_positive M B0
+      · exact hA u hu)
+  exact ⟨B, Finset.Subset.trans (Finset.subset_insert _ _) hAB,
+    hAB (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _), hBpos, hBclosed⟩
+
+/-- Every simple neighbor in a positive region can be joined to the actual
+head-removal cone vertex. This is the finite vertex-deletion carrier law. -/
+theorem headStep_cone (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
+    (hu : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) (hne : u.value ≠ 1)
+    (q : IncomingVertex M B0) (hq : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 q)
+    (huq : u ≤ q) (hs : SimpleRibbon M u.source q.source (u.difference q)) :
+    q ≤ headStep M B0 u ∧
+      SimpleRibbon M q.source (headStep M B0 u).source (q.difference (headStep M B0 u)) := by
+  rw [headStep_eq M B0 u hu hne]
+  exact (positiveHeadTail_spec M B0 u hu).2.2.2.1 q hq huq hs
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinDeligne.GarsideShifts
+import ArtinAsphericity.DirectedCover
+
+/-!
+# Actual homotopy groups of the Garside weighted space
+
+A cube together with its basepoint factors through one actual contractible
+finite carrier. Injectivity of the unshifted inclusion identifies all lifted
+boundary points with the same lifted basepoint. The contractible carrier's
+based homotopy group is trivial, and its actual continuous inclusion maps
+that equality back. This is not an argument from a free nullhomotopy of a cube.
+
+The contractible-space homotopy-group theorem is the already accepted
+`ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.homotopyGroup_subsingleton_of_contractible`,
+whose TauCeti proof uses actual basepoint transport. No new supplier is used.
+All conclusions concern this actual weighted model; a comparison with an
+arrangement universal cover remains a separate mathematical requirement.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Ribbon2 Homotopy5 Chamber3 OAI.HarmonicArtin Topology
+open scoped unitInterval Topology.Homotopy
+
+variable {S : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix S) [Finite M.Group] (B0 : RibbonObject M)
+
+/-- The actual root vertex supplies a point, also for empty or full parabolics. -/
+noncomputable def garsideRootPoint : GarsideWeights M B0 :=
+  GarsideWeightsOn.include M B0 Set.univ
+    (GarsideWeightsOn.vertex M B0 ⟨incomingRoot M B0, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
+
+/-- Every actual based generalized loop is null in its genuine based homotopy
+group. The separate basepoint summand also handles an empty cube index type. -/
+theorem garside_genLoop_class_eq_const (N : Type*) [Finite N]
+    (x : GarsideWeights M B0) (f : GenLoop N (GarsideWeights M B0) x) :
+    (⟦f⟧ : HomotopyGroup N (GarsideWeights M B0) x) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ := by
+  classical
+  let f' : C(Unit ⊕ (I^N), GarsideWeights M B0) :=
+    ⟨Sum.elim (fun _ => x) f, continuous_const.sumElim f.val.continuous⟩
+  obtain ⟨n, B, _, _, _, hcontract, g, hg⟩ :=
+    GarsideWeights.compact_map_contractible_carrier M B0 f'
+  let Y := GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))
+  let j : C(Y, GarsideWeights M B0) := unshiftedCarrierMap M B0 n B
+  have hj : Function.Injective j := unshiftedCarrierMap_injective M B0 n B
+  have hpoint (p : Unit ⊕ (I^N)) : j (g p) = f' p :=
+    congrArg (fun F : C(Unit ⊕ (I^N), GarsideWeights M B0) => F p) hg
+  let y : Y := g (Sum.inl Unit.unit)
+  have hy : j y = x := hpoint (Sum.inl Unit.unit)
+  let F : GenLoop N Y y :=
+    ⟨⟨fun z => g (Sum.inr z), g.continuous.comp continuous_inr⟩, fun z hz => by
+      apply hj
+      exact (hpoint (Sum.inr z)).trans ((GenLoop.boundary f z hz).trans hy.symm)⟩
+  let : ContractibleSpace Y := hcontract
+  have hzero : (⟦F⟧ : HomotopyGroup N Y y) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ :=
+    (Asphericity5.homotopyGroup_subsingleton_of_contractible N y).elim _ _
+  have hmap : GenLoop.map j hy F = f := by
+    apply GenLoop.ext
+    intro z
+    rw [GenLoop.map_apply]
+    exact hpoint (Sum.inr z)
+  have hm := congrArg (HomotopyGroup.map (N := N) j hy) hzero
+  rw [HomotopyGroup.map_mk, HomotopyGroup.map_mk, hmap, GenLoop.map_const] at hm
+  exact hm
+
+/-- All finite-index homotopy groups of the actual Garside space vanish. -/
+theorem garside_homotopyGroup_subsingleton (N : Type*) [Finite N]
+    (x : GarsideWeights M B0) : Subsingleton (HomotopyGroup N (GarsideWeights M B0) x) := by
+  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
+  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ a b fun f g => ?_
+  exact (garside_genLoop_class_eq_const M B0 N x f).trans
+    (garside_genLoop_class_eq_const M B0 N x g).symm
+
+/-- Any two actual points lie in the image of one contractible finite carrier. -/
+theorem garside_joined (x y : GarsideWeights M B0) : Joined x y := by
+  let f : C(Bool, GarsideWeights M B0) :=
+    ⟨fun b => if b then x else y, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩
+  obtain ⟨n, B, _, _, _, hcontract, g, hg⟩ :=
+    GarsideWeights.compact_map_contractible_carrier M B0 f
+  let Y := GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))
+  let : ContractibleSpace Y := hcontract
+  let j : C(Y, GarsideWeights M B0) := unshiftedCarrierMap M B0 n B
+  have hx : j (g true) = x := congrArg (fun F : C(Bool, GarsideWeights M B0) => F true) hg
+  have hy : j (g false) = y := congrArg (fun F : C(Bool, GarsideWeights M B0) => F false) hg
+  rw [← hx, ← hy]
+  exact (PathConnectedSpace.joined (g true) (g false)).map j.continuous
+
+theorem garside_pathConnectedSpace : PathConnectedSpace (GarsideWeights M B0) :=
+  ⟨⟨garsideRootPoint M B0⟩, garside_joined M B0⟩
+
+/-- Asphericity of this actual weighted model, without asserting any comparison
+with the original universal cover or the original Theorem 1.8 target. -/
+theorem garside_isAspherical (x : GarsideWeights M B0) :
+    TauCeti.IsAspherical (GarsideWeights M B0) x := by
+  let : PathConnectedSpace (GarsideWeights M B0) := garside_pathConnectedSpace M B0
+  exact TauCeti.IsAspherical.mk inferInstance
+    (fun n => garside_homotopyGroup_subsingleton M B0 (Fin (n + 2)) x)
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinDeligneVendor.Topology.ArtinGroups.Realizations.FiniteWeightsCompact
+
+/-!
+# The actual weak topology of hereditary weighted subcomplexes
+
+A hereditary predicate on finite vertex sets cuts out a closed subspace of
+the genuine order realization. Its topology is determined by its admissible
+finite chain simplices. This is proved from finite closed carrier faces in
+each original chart, rather than assumed as a topology on a substitute space.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open OAI.HarmonicArtin Topology Convexity Simplicial CategoryTheory Opposite
+attribute [local instance] Classical.decEq Classical.propDecidable
+
+variable {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
+
+/-- A finite-face predicate closed under taking subfaces. -/
+def SupportHereditary (S : Finset P → Prop) : Prop :=
+  ∀ ⦃A B : Finset P⦄, A ⊆ B → S B → S A
+
+/-- The genuine subspace of the weighted order realization. -/
+abbrev SubcomplexWeights (S : Finset P → Prop) :=
+  {w : OrderWeights P // S w.weights.support}
+
+/-- A fixed carrier condition in the original weighted realization. -/
+def weightCarrierSet (F : Finset P) : Set (OrderWeights P) :=
+  {w | w.weights.support ⊆ F}
+
+theorem mem_weightCarrierSet_iff (F : Finset P) (w : OrderWeights P) :
+    w ∈ weightCarrierSet F ↔ ∀ p, p ∉ F → w.weights p = 0 := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hw p hp
+    exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (fun h => hp (hw h))
+  · intro hw p hp
+    by_contra hn
+    exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hp) (hw p hn)
+
+theorem isClosed_weightCarrierSet (F : Finset P) : IsClosed (weightCarrierSet F) := by
+  have he : weightCarrierSet F = ⋂ p, ⋂ (_ : p ∉ F), {w | w.weights p = 0} := by
+    ext w
+    simp only [mem_weightCarrierSet_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
+  rw [he]
+  exact isClosed_iInter fun p => isClosed_iInter fun _ =>
+    isClosed_eq (weightEval_continuous p) continuous_const
+
+/-- A bad finite support stays bad when all of its positive coordinates
+remain positive. This proves actual closedness of the subcomplex. -/
+theorem isClosed_subcomplexWeights (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S) :
+    IsClosed ({w | S w.weights.support} : Set (OrderWeights P)) := by
+  apply isOpen_compl_iff.mp
+  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
+  intro w hw
+  let U : Set (OrderWeights P) := ⋂ p ∈ w.weights.support, {v | 0 < v.weights p}
+  have hopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_biInter_finset fun p _ =>
+    isOpen_lt continuous_const (weightEval_continuous p)
+  have hwU : w ∈ U := by
+    apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
+    intro p
+    apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
+    intro hp
+    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (w.nonneg p) (Ne.symm (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hp))
+  apply Filter.mem_of_superset (hopen.mem_nhds hwU)
+  intro v hv
+  change ¬S v.weights.support
+  intro hSv
+  apply hw
+  apply hS ?_ hSv
+  intro p hp
+  have hpos := Set.mem_iInter.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp hv p) hp
+  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (ne_of_gt hpos)
+
+theorem weightInclusion_support_subset (F : Finset P) (w : OrderWeights (F : Set P)) :
+    (weightMap (weightInclusion (F : Set P)) w).weights.support ⊆ F := by
+  rw [weightMap_support_embedding _ Subtype.val_injective]
+  intro p hp
+  obtain ⟨q, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
+  exact q.property
+
+/-- Any admissible finite vertex set includes continuously into the actual
+hereditary subspace. It need not be a chain. -/
+noncomputable def subcomplexFiniteInclusion (S : Finset P → Prop)
+    (hS : SupportHereditary S) (F : Finset P) (hF : S F)
+    (w : OrderWeights (F : Set P)) : SubcomplexWeights S :=
+  ⟨weightMap (weightInclusion (F : Set P)) w,
+    hS (weightInclusion_support_subset F w) hF⟩
+
+theorem continuous_subcomplexFiniteInclusion (S : Finset P → Prop)
+    (hS : SupportHereditary S) (F : Finset P) (hF : S F) :
+    Continuous (subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hF) :=
+  (weightMap_continuous (weightInclusion (F : Set P))).subtype_mk _
+
+/-- An admissible chain simplex with the actual inherited target topology. -/
+noncomputable def subcomplexChart (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
+    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (hx : S (Finset.univ.image x))
+    (z : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) : SubcomplexWeights S :=
+  ⟨orderWeightsOfChain x z, hS (chainWeights_support x z) hx⟩
+
+theorem continuous_subcomplexChart (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
+    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (hx : S (Finset.univ.image x)) :
+    Continuous (subcomplexChart S hS x hx) :=
+  (chainWeightsChart_continuous x).subtype_mk _
+
+
+/-- Carrier faces are closed in each original simplex chart. -/
+def chainCarrierFace {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (F : Finset P) :
+    Set (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :=
+  {z | (orderWeightsOfChain x z).weights.support ⊆ F}
+
+theorem isClosed_chainCarrierFace {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (F : Finset P) :
+    IsClosed (chainCarrierFace x F) :=
+  (isClosed_weightCarrierSet F).preimage (chainWeightsChart_continuous x)
+
+/-- On a fixed finite carrier face the actual restriction is continuous. -/
+noncomputable def chainCarrierRestriction {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (F : Finset P) :
+    C(chainCarrierFace x F, OrderWeights (F : Set P)) := by
+  let g : C(chainCarrierFace x F, OrderWeights P) :=
+    ⟨fun z => orderWeightsOfChain x z.val,
+      (chainWeightsChart_continuous x).comp continuous_subtype_val⟩
+  exact ⟨fun z => weightRestrict (F : Set P) (g z) z.property,
+    weightRestrict_continuous_finite (F : Set P) F.finite_toSet g (fun z => z.property)⟩
+
+theorem chainCarrierRestriction_map {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (F : Finset P)
+    (z : chainCarrierFace x F) :
+    weightMap (weightInclusion (F : Set P)) (chainCarrierRestriction x F z) =
+      orderWeightsOfChain x z.val :=
+  weightRestrict_map (F : Set P) (orderWeightsOfChain x z.val) z.property
+
+theorem chain_range_isChain {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) :
+    IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑(Finset.univ.image x) : Set P) := by
+  intro a ha b hb _hab
+  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
+  obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
+  exact (le_total i j).imp (fun h => x.monotone h) (fun h => x.monotone h)
+
+theorem finiteChainOrder_range (F : Finset P) (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P))
+    (hne : F.Nonempty) : Finset.univ.image (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) = F := by
+  ext p
+  constructor
+  · intro hp
+    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
+    exact (finiteChainEnum F hF hne i).property
+  · intro hp
+    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(finiteChainEnum F hF hne).symm ⟨p, hp⟩,
+      Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
+    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((finiteChainEnum F hF hne).apply_symm_apply ⟨p, hp⟩)
+
+/-- The ordinary finite-face coordinates are continuous; no global
+coordinate-continuity criterion is being invoked for the weak realization. -/
+theorem continuous_carrierSimplex {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
+    (F : Finset P) (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty)
+    (g : C(X, OrderWeights P)) (hg : ∀ x, (g x).weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    Continuous (fun x => carrierSimplex F hF hne (g x) (hg x)) := by
+  rw [(StdSimplex.isEmbedding_toFun_comp_weights ℝ (Fin (F.card - 1 + 1))).continuous_iff]
+  change Continuous (fun x i => (g x).weights (finiteChainOrder F hF hne i))
+  exact continuous_pi fun i => (weightEval_continuous _).comp g.continuous
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000 in
+/-- Closedness can be tested on all admissible finite faces. The proof is
+a genuine finite closed-face gluing argument inside every original chart. -/
+theorem isClosed_image_of_finite_face_preimages (S : Finset P → Prop)
+    (hS : SupportHereditary S) (T : Set (SubcomplexWeights S))
+    (hT : ∀ (F : Finset P), IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P) → F.Nonempty →
+      ∀ hF : S F, IsClosed ((subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hF) ⁻¹' T)) :
+    IsClosed ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) '' T) := by
+  classical
+  rw [orderWeights_isClosed_iff]
+  intro n simplex
+  let x := nerveChain simplex
+  let L := Finset.univ.image x
+  let Families := L.powerset.filter (fun F => F.Nonempty ∧ S F)
+  let Piece (F : Finset P) : Set (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n.len + 1))) :=
+    if hF : S F then
+      Subtype.val '' ((chainCarrierRestriction x F) ⁻¹'
+        ((subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hF) ⁻¹' T))
+    else ∅
+  have hpiece (F : Finset P) (hFF : F ∈ Families) : IsClosed (Piece F) := by
+    obtain ⟨hFL, hne, hSF⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hFF
+    have hsub : F ⊆ L := Finset.mem_powerset.mp hFL
+    have hchain : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P) :=
+      fun a ha b hb hne => chain_range_isChain x (hsub ha) (hsub hb) hne
+    dsimp only [Piece]
+    rw [dite_eq_left hSF]
+    exact (isClosed_chainCarrierFace x F).isClosedMap_subtype_val _
+      ((hT F hchain hne hSF).preimage (chainCarrierRestriction x F).continuous)
+  have he : (fun z => orderWeightsOfChain x z) ⁻¹'
+        ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) '' T) =
+      ⋃ F ∈ Families, Piece F := by
+    ext z
+    constructor
+    · rintro ⟨w, hwT, hwz⟩
+      change w.val = orderWeightsOfChain x z at hwz
+      let F := (orderWeightsOfChain x z).weights.support
+      have hSF : S F := by
+        change S (orderWeightsOfChain x z).weights.support
+        rw [← hwz]
+        exact w.property
+      have hFF : F ∈ Families := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
+        ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (chainWeights_support x z),
+          (orderWeightsOfChain x z).support_nonempty, hSF⟩
+      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
+      refine ⟨F, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hFF, ?_⟩⟩
+      dsimp only [Piece]
+      rw [dite_eq_left hSF]
+      let zF : chainCarrierFace x F := ⟨z, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩
+      refine ⟨zF, ?_, rfl⟩
+      have hpoint : subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hSF (chainCarrierRestriction x F zF) = w := by
+        apply Subtype.ext
+        exact (chainCarrierRestriction_map x F zF).trans hwz.symm
+      change subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hSF (chainCarrierRestriction x F zF) ∈ T
+      rwa [hpoint]
+    · intro hz
+      obtain ⟨F, hFz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
+      obtain ⟨hFF, hzF⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hFz
+      have hSF : S F := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hFF).2.2
+      dsimp only [Piece] at hzF
+      rw [dite_eq_left hSF] at hzF
+      obtain ⟨zF, hzFT, hzFz⟩ := hzF
+      refine ⟨subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hSF (chainCarrierRestriction x F zF), hzFT, ?_⟩
+      exact (chainCarrierRestriction_map x F zF).trans
+        (congrArg (orderWeightsOfChain x) hzFz)
+  change IsClosed ((fun z => orderWeightsOfChain x z) ⁻¹' _)
+  rw [he]
+  exact isClosed_biUnion_finset hpiece

+# Actual finite joins of incoming ribbon vertices
+
+Concrete source powers of the cofinal loop give common lower bounds. Above
+such a lower vertex, the proved positive ribbon lcm constructs an actual join
+and its universal property. The join-semilattice instance and nonempty finite
+joins are derived from these actual constructions, not assumed as fields.

+chambers under arbitrary target loops is used or asserted.

+/-- A concrete actual incoming vertex, with the fixed target as its source. -/
+noncomputable def cofinalLowerVertex (B0 : RibbonObject M) (n : ℕ) : IncomingVertex M B0 :=
+  ⟨B0, cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ n, (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M B0 n).toReducedArrow⟩

+    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, n ≤ m → cofinalLowerVertex (M := M) B0 m ≤ u := by

+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := v.eventually_positive
+  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
+  intro m hnm
+  have hpos := hn m hnm
+  have he : u.value⁻¹ * cofinalLoop M u.source.indices ^ m =
+      cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ m * u.value⁻¹ :=
+    (u.reduced.isRibbon.inv M).cofinalLoop_pow_mul M m

+    (cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ m * u.value⁻¹)
+  simpa only [v, cofinalShift_value, he] using hpos

+    intro v hv m hm

+    · exact hk v hv m ((le_max_right _ _).trans hm)

+  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := v.eventually_cofinalLower_le
+  exact ⟨cofinalLowerVertex B0 (max n m), hn _ (le_max_left _ _), hm _ (le_max_right _ _)⟩

+  let m : IncomingVertex M B0 :=
+    ⟨U, d⁻¹ * a.value, .comp (.inverse hd.toReducedArrow) a.reduced⟩
+  have hmu : m.difference u = ru := by
+    change (d⁻¹ * a.value) * u.value⁻¹ = ru
+    calc
+      _ = d⁻¹ * (a.difference u) := by dsimp only [difference]; group
+      _ = ru := by rw [hdu]; group

+    change (d⁻¹ * a.value) * v.value⁻¹ = rv
+    calc
+      _ = d⁻¹ * (a.difference v) := by dsimp only [difference]; group
+      _ = rv := by rw [hdv]; group
+  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · change PositiveReducedArrow M U u.source (m.difference u)
+    rw [hmu]
+    exact hru
+  · change PositiveReducedArrow M U v.source (m.difference v)
+    rw [hmv]
+    exact hrv
+  · intro w hwu hwv
+    let s : IncomingVertex M B0 := w ⊔ a
+    have has : a ≤ s := le_sup_right

+    have hpu : RibbonPrefix M (a.difference s) (a.difference u) :=
+      ⟨s.difference u, hsu.positive, (difference_mul a s u).symm⟩
+    have hpv : RibbonPrefix M (a.difference s) (a.difference v) :=
+      ⟨s.difference v, hsv.positive, (difference_mul a s v).symm⟩
+    obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := hgreatest s.source (a.difference s) has hpu hpv
+    have hsm : s.difference m = t := by
+      change s.value * (d⁻¹ * a.value)⁻¹ = t
+      rw [hdt]

+      change PositiveReducedArrow M s.source U (s.difference m)

+
+/-- Existence of actual global binary meets. -/
+theorem exists_meet (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    ∃ m : IncomingVertex M B0, m ≤ u ∧ m ≤ v ∧
+      ∀ w : IncomingVertex M B0, w ≤ u → w ≤ v → w ≤ m := by
+  obtain ⟨a, hau, hav⟩ := exists_common_lower u v
+  exact exists_meet_of_common_lower u v a hau hav

+noncomputable def binaryMeet (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) : IncomingVertex M B0 :=
+  Classical.choose (exists_meet u v)

+theorem binaryMeet_le_left (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) : binaryMeet u v ≤ u :=
+  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_meet u v)).1
+
+theorem binaryMeet_le_right (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) : binaryMeet u v ≤ v :=
+  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_meet u v)).2.1
+
+theorem le_binaryMeet {u v w : IncomingVertex M B0} (hwu : w ≤ u) (hwv : w ≤ v) :
+    w ≤ binaryMeet u v := (Classical.choose_spec (exists_meet u v)).2.2 w hwu hwv

+theorem binaryMeet_eq_of_glb {u v m : IncomingVertex M B0} (hmu : m ≤ u) (hmv : m ≤ v)
+    (hgreatest : ∀ w : IncomingVertex M B0, w ≤ u → w ≤ v → w ≤ m) : binaryMeet u v = m :=
+  le_antisymm (hgreatest _ (binaryMeet_le_left u v) (binaryMeet_le_right u v))
+    (le_binaryMeet hmu hmv)

+theorem binaryMeet_isGLB (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) : IsGLB {u, v} (binaryMeet u v) := by
+  constructor
+  · intro w hw
+    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hw with h | h
+    · subst w
+      exact binaryMeet_le_left u v
+    · have he : w = v := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h
+      subst w
+      exact binaryMeet_le_right u v
+  · intro w hw
+    exact le_binaryMeet (hw (Set.mem_insert u {v}))
+      (hw (Set.mem_insert_of_mem u (Set.mem_singleton v)))
+

+noncomputable instance semilatticeInf : SemilatticeInf (IncomingVertex M B0) :=
+  SemilatticeInf.ofIsGLB binaryMeet binaryMeet_isGLB
+
+/-- Both actual ribbon universal properties provide the incoming lattice. -/
+noncomputable instance lattice : Lattice (IncomingVertex M B0) where
+  __ := semilatticeSup
+  __ := semilatticeInf
+
+@[simp] theorem binaryMeet_eq_inf (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) : binaryMeet u v = u ⊓ v := rfl
+
+noncomputable def finiteMeet (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    IncomingVertex M B0 := F.inf' hF id
+
+theorem finiteMeet_isGLB (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    IsGLB (F : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)) (finiteMeet F hF) := Finset.isGLB_inf' hF
+

+    {u : IncomingVertex M B0} (hu : u ∈ F) : finiteMeet F hF ≤ u := Finset.inf'_le id hu

+    {u : IncomingVertex M B0} (hu : ∀ v ∈ F, u ≤ v) : u ≤ finiteMeet F hF :=
+  Finset.le_inf' hF id hu

+  le_finiteMeet F hF (fun _ hu => finiteMeet_le G hG (hFG hu))
+
+theorem finiteMeet_le_finiteJoin (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :

+

+noncomputable def packetInterval (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    Set (IncomingVertex M B0) := Set.Icc (finiteMeet F hF) (finiteJoin F hF)

+theorem mem_packetInterval_iff (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    u ∈ packetInterval F hF ↔ finiteMeet F hF ≤ u ∧ u ≤ finiteJoin F hF := Iff.rfl
+
+theorem subset_packetInterval (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    (F : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)) ⊆ packetInterval F hF := by
+  intro u hu
+  exact ⟨finiteMeet_le F hF hu, le_finiteJoin F hF hu⟩
+
+theorem packetInterval_nonempty (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    (packetInterval F hF).Nonempty :=
+  ⟨finiteMeet F hF, le_rfl, finiteMeet_le_finiteJoin F hF⟩
+
+/-- This carrier is monotone in packet inclusion in both interval endpoints. -/
+theorem packetInterval_mono {F G : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)} (hFG : F ⊆ G)
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hG : G.Nonempty) : packetInterval F hF ⊆ packetInterval G hG := by
+  intro u hu
+  exact ⟨(finiteMeet_antitone hFG hF hG).trans hu.1,
+    hu.2.trans (finiteJoin_mono hFG hF hG)⟩
+
+/-- A packet in a simple interval has its entire meet/join interval there. -/
+theorem packetInterval_subset_Icc (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (a b : IncomingVertex M B0) (ha : ∀ v ∈ F, a ≤ v) (hb : ∀ v ∈ F, v ≤ b) :
+    packetInterval F hF ⊆ Set.Icc a b := by
+  intro u hu
+  exact ⟨(le_finiteMeet F hF ha).trans hu.1, hu.2.trans (finiteJoin_le F hF hb)⟩
+
+/-- Meet/join endpoint bounds and the simple total factor are derived from
+any actual simple interval containing the packet. -/
+theorem finiteMeetJoin_simple_interval (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (a b : IncomingVertex M B0) (ha : ∀ v ∈ F, a ≤ v) (hb : ∀ v ∈ F, v ≤ b)
+    (hs : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b)) :
+    a ≤ finiteMeet F hF ∧ finiteMeet F hF ≤ finiteJoin F hF ∧ finiteJoin F hF ≤ b ∧
+      SimpleRibbon M (finiteMeet F hF).source (finiteJoin F hF).source
+        ((finiteMeet F hF).difference (finiteJoin F hF)) := by
+  have ham := le_finiteMeet F hF ha
+  have hmj := finiteMeet_le_finiteJoin F hF
+  have hjb := finiteJoin_le F hF hb

+theorem packetInterval_simple {F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)} (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    {a b : IncomingVertex M B0} (ha : ∀ v ∈ F, a ≤ v) (hb : ∀ v ∈ F, v ≤ b)
+    (hs : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b))
+    {u v : IncomingVertex M B0} (hu : u ∈ packetInterval F hF)
+    (hv : v ∈ packetInterval F hF) (huv : u ≤ v) :
+    SimpleRibbon M u.source v.source (u.difference v) := by
+  have hsub := packetInterval_subset_Icc F hF a b ha hb
+  exact simple_difference_of_interval hs (hsub hu).1 huv (hsub hv).2
+
+/-- The order geodesics in such a carrier are genuine chamber geodesics. -/
+theorem packetInterval_chamberBetween {F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)} (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    {a b : IncomingVertex M B0} (ha : ∀ v ∈ F, a ≤ v) (hb : ∀ v ∈ F, v ≤ b)
+    (hs : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b))
+    {u v w : IncomingVertex M B0} (hu : u ∈ packetInterval F hF)
+    (hw : w ∈ packetInterval F hF) (huv : u ≤ v) (hvw : v ≤ w) :
+    ChamberBetween u.chamber v.chamber w.chamber :=
+  incoming_chamberBetween M huv hvw (packetInterval_simple hF ha hb hs hu hw (huv.trans hvw))
+
+end IncomingVertex
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinHomotopy.RibbonGcd
+import ArtinChambers.RibbonDeckLabels
+
+/-!
+# The actual ordered incoming ribbon vertices
+
+A vertex is an actual signed generated ribbon from a varying standard
+parabolic into the fixed target. The order records a genuine positive
+generated factor on the left. Exponent degree proves antisymmetry and gives
+an integer height strictly increasing along strict order.
+
+The chamber uses the actual inverse Coxeter projection as its transported
+facet representative. Right multiplication by any actual target loop is an
+order automorphism. Concrete cofinal loops clear every finite set of vertices
+to actual positive generated ribbons. No topological conclusion or abstract
+label-injectivity hypothesis is part of these definitions.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Ribbon2 Homotopy5 Chamber3
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group]
+
+/-- Signed incoming vertices in the actual generated ribbon groupoid. -/
+structure IncomingVertex (B0 : RibbonObject M) where
+  source : RibbonObject M
+  value : Artin.Group M
+  reduced : ReducedArrow M source B0 value
+
+namespace IncomingVertex
+
+variable {M} {B0 : RibbonObject M}
+
+@[ext] theorem ext {u v : IncomingVertex M B0}
+    (hs : u.source = v.source) (hv : u.value = v.value) : u = v := by
+  cases u
+  cases v
+  cases hs
+  cases hv
+  rfl
+
+/-- A fixed actual incoming label determines its source by genuine positive
+parabolic conjugation, rather than by an injectivity field. -/
+theorem source_eq_of_value_eq {u v : IncomingVertex M B0} (h : u.value = v.value) :
+    u.source = v.source := by
+  have hu := u.reduced.isRibbon.inv M
+  have hv := v.reduced.isRibbon.inv M
+  rw [h] at hu
+  exact congrArg (fun J : Set I => (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))
+    (isRibbon_target_indices_unique M hu hv)
+
+theorem ext_value {u v : IncomingVertex M B0} (h : u.value = v.value) : u = v :=
+  ext (source_eq_of_value_eq h) h
+
+/-- The unique actual factor from the first incoming label to the second. -/
+def difference (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) : Artin.Group M := u.value * v.value⁻¹
+
+theorem difference_reduced (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    ReducedArrow M u.source v.source (difference u v) :=
+  .comp u.reduced (.inverse v.reduced)
+
+@[simp] theorem difference_self (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : difference u u = 1 :=
+  mul_inv_cancel _
+
+theorem difference_mul (u v w : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    difference u v * difference v w = difference u w := by
+  unfold difference
+  group
+
+theorem difference_eq_one_iff (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) : difference u v = 1 ↔ u = v := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    exact ext_value (mul_inv_eq_one.mp h)
+  · rintro rfl
+    exact difference_self _
+
+instance partialOrder : PartialOrder (IncomingVertex M B0) where
+  le u v := PositiveReducedArrow M u.source v.source (difference u v)
+  le_refl u := by
+    rw [difference_self]
+    exact .identity u.source
+  le_trans u v w huv hvw := by
+    have h := PositiveReducedArrow.comp huv hvw
+    simpa only [difference_mul] using h
+  le_antisymm u v huv hvu := by
+    have hn := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ huv.positive
+    have hn' := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hvu.positive
+    have hz : degree M (difference u v) = 0 := by
+      simp only [difference, degree_mul, degree_inv] at hn hn' ⊢
+      omega
+    exact (difference_eq_one_iff u v).mp
+      ((degree_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ huv.positive).mp hz)
+
+theorem le_iff (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    u ≤ v ↔ PositiveReducedArrow M u.source v.source (u.value * v.value⁻¹) := Iff.rfl
+
+/-- Height increases when a positive factor is removed from an incoming label. -/
+def height (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : ℤ := -degree M u.value
+
+theorem height_monotone : Monotone (height : IncomingVertex M B0 → ℤ) := by
+  intro u v huv
+  have hn := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ huv.positive
+  simp only [difference, degree_mul, degree_inv] at hn
+  dsimp only [height]
+  omega
+
+theorem height_strictMono : StrictMono (height : IncomingVertex M B0 → ℤ) := by
+  intro u v huv
+  have hn := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ huv.le.positive
+  have hne : difference u v ≠ 1 := by
+    intro h
+    exact huv.ne ((difference_eq_one_iff u v).mp h)
+  have hz : degree M (difference u v) ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    exact hne ((degree_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ huv.le.positive).mp h)
+  simp only [difference, degree_mul, degree_inv] at hn hz
+  dsimp only [height]
+  omega
+
+theorem height_lt {u v : IncomingVertex M B0} (h : u < v) : height u < height v :=
+  height_strictMono h
+
+/-- The inverse projection is the actual representative sending the source
+parabolic to the fixed target parabolic. -/
+noncomputable def rawFacetLabel (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : RawFacetLabel M B0.indices where
+  indices := u.source.indices
+  representative := (Artin.projection M u.value)⁻¹
+  parabolic_conjugacy := conjugacy_symm M (isRibbon_projection_transporter M u.reduced.isRibbon)
+
+/-- The actual restricted-arrangement chamber of an incoming vertex. -/
+noncomputable def chamber (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : ActualChamber M B0.indices :=
+  actualChamberOfRawLabel M B0.indices u.rawFacetLabel
+
+@[simp] theorem chamber_indices (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    actualChamberIndices M B0.indices u.chamber = u.source.indices :=
+  actualChamberIndices_rawLabel M B0.indices u.rawFacetLabel
+
+/-- The corresponding literal source-index chamber fiber. -/
+noncomputable def chamberFiber (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : ChamberFiber M B0.indices u.source :=
+  ⟨u.chamber, u.chamber_indices⟩
+
+/-- The incoming chamber definition agrees with actual signed fiber transport. -/
+theorem fiberTarget_chamber (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    (fiberTarget M B0.indices (Artin.projection M (difference u v))
+      (isRibbon_projection_transporter M (difference_reduced u v).isRibbon) u.chamberFiber).val =
+        v.chamber := by
+  let w := Artin.projection M (difference u v)
+  have hw := isRibbon_projection_transporter M (difference_reduced u v).isRibbon
+  have hchosen : actualChamberOfRawLabel M B0.indices
+      (chamberRawLabel M B0.indices u.chamber) =

+    chamberRawLabel_chamber M B0.indices _
+  have hreplace := rightTransportRawLabel_independent M B0.indices hchosen
+    v.source.indices w
+    (by simpa only [chamberRawLabel_indices, chamber_indices] using hw) hw
+  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M B0.indices
+    (fiberTargetLabel M B0.indices w hw u.chamberFiber) = v.chamber
+  refine hreplace.trans ?_
+  apply (actualChamberOfRawLabel_eq_iff M B0.indices _ v.rawFacetLabel).mpr
+  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
+  change (((Artin.projection M u.value)⁻¹ * w)⁻¹ *
+    (Artin.projection M v.value)⁻¹) ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M v.source.indices
+  have he : (Artin.projection M u.value)⁻¹ * w = (Artin.projection M v.value)⁻¹ := by
+    simp only [w, difference, map_mul, map_inv]
+    group
+  rw [he, inv_mul_cancel]
+  exact Subgroup.one_mem _
+
+/-- Right multiplication by a genuine target loop preserves all actual
+incoming labels and sources. -/
+def rightMul (b : Artin.Group M) (hb : ReducedArrow M B0 B0 b)
+    (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : IncomingVertex M B0 :=
+  ⟨u.source, u.value * b, .comp u.reduced hb⟩
+
+@[simp] theorem rightMul_source (b : Artin.Group M) (hb : ReducedArrow M B0 B0 b)
+    (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : (rightMul b hb u).source = u.source := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem rightMul_value (b : Artin.Group M) (hb : ReducedArrow M B0 B0 b)
+    (u : IncomingVertex M B0) : (rightMul b hb u).value = u.value * b := rfl
+
+/-- Every signed target loop acts by an actual order automorphism. -/
+def rightMulOrderIso (b : Artin.Group M) (hb : ReducedArrow M B0 B0 b) :
+    IncomingVertex M B0 ≃o IncomingVertex M B0 where
+  toFun := rightMul b hb
+  invFun := rightMul b⁻¹ (.inverse hb)
+  left_inv u := ext_value (by simp only [rightMul_value]; group)
+  right_inv u := ext_value (by simp only [rightMul_value]; group)
+  map_rel_iff' := by
+    intro u v
+    change PositiveReducedArrow M u.source v.source
+      ((u.value * b) * (v.value * b)⁻¹) ↔
+        PositiveReducedArrow M u.source v.source (u.value * v.value⁻¹)
+    have he : (u.value * b) * (v.value * b)⁻¹ = u.value * v.value⁻¹ := by group
+    rw [he]
+
+/-- Concrete cofinal right shifts, including their actual signed inverses. -/
+noncomputable def cofinalShift (n : ℕ) : IncomingVertex M B0 ≃o IncomingVertex M B0 :=
+  rightMulOrderIso (cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ n)
+    (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M B0 n).toReducedArrow
+
+@[simp] theorem cofinalShift_source (n : ℕ) (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    (cofinalShift (M := M) (B0 := B0) n u).source = u.source := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem cofinalShift_value (n : ℕ) (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    (cofinalShift (M := M) (B0 := B0) n u).value = u.value * cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ n := rfl
+
+/-- Every signed incoming vertex becomes positive after sufficiently large
+actual cofinal shifts; the conclusion retains positive ribbon generation. -/
+theorem eventually_positive (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, n ≤ m →
+      PositiveReducedArrow M u.source B0 ((cofinalShift m u).value) := by
+  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, hpa⟩ := u.reduced.positive_fraction M
+  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
+  intro m hnm
+  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
+  have he : (cofinalShift (n + k) u).value = a * cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ k := by
+    rw [cofinalShift_value, hpa, pow_add]
+    group
+  rw [he]
+  exact .comp ha (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M B0 k)
+
+/-- Every finite family of actual signed incoming vertices can be cleared
+simultaneously by the same concrete cofinal right shift. -/
+theorem finite_eventually_positive (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) :
+    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ u ∈ F, ∀ m : ℕ, n ≤ m →
+      PositiveReducedArrow M u.source B0 ((cofinalShift m u).value) := by
+  classical
+  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
+  | empty => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
+  | @insert u F _ ih =>
+    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := u.eventually_positive
+    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
+    refine ⟨max n k, ?_⟩
+    intro v hv m hm
+    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hv with rfl | hv
+    · exact hn m ((le_max_left _ _).trans hm)
+    · exact hk v hv m ((le_max_right _ _).trans hm)
+
+end IncomingVertex
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinDeligne.LiftedTubes
+import ArtinDeligne.CanonicalCarriers
+
+/-!
+# Actual lifted canonical cells
+
+The realized finite canonical cells lie in specified actual chamber tubes.
+Intersecting their projection preimages with the genuine tube sheets gives
+open contractible cells in the original universal cover. Their charts are
+restrictions of the actual tube sections, and they cover the total space.
+Uniqueness of lifts on a connected base proves whole-cell containment in
+another tube sheet from one common point; no covering classification or
+contractibility of the total space is assumed.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Theorem18 Chamber3 Asphericity5 Sequence4 Topology
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] (J : Set I)
+
+/-- Endpoint projection followed by the section recovers every actual sheet point. -/
+theorem liftedTubeSection_projection_eq (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
+    (z : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hz : z ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A) :
+    liftedTubeSection M J A
+      ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J z,
+        liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J A hz⟩ = z :=
+  congrArg Subtype.val ((liftedTubeHomeomorph M J A).apply_symm_apply ⟨z, hz⟩)
+
+/-- The section restricted to any actual base subspace contained in its tube. -/

+# A genuine partition of unity on the actual lifted canonical cover

+A finite partition on the original complement is split among its actual open,
+disjoint sheets. The resulting function on a sheet is the original function
+composed with endpoint projection, and is zero off that sheet. Closed supports
+remain inside the lifted canonical cells. Local finiteness uses finite base
+types and one possible sheet per base type near each point, without assuming
+a metric, paracompactness or countability on the universal cover.

+local authoring using the already pinned mathlib partition/support APIs.

+  toFun i := ⟨weight p W ρ i, continuous_weight p hp T W ho hd hc ρ hT i⟩

+import ArtinDeligne.LiftedCanonicalCover

+/-!
+# Actual components of arbitrary lifted-tube intersections
+
+A nonempty sheet family and a point of its intersection determine a real
+sign piece downstairs. Covering uniqueness identifies the sheet sections
+on that entire contractible piece. This gives an actual homeomorphism to
+the connected component upstairs, with no contractibility assumption on
+the total universal cover.
+-/

+set_option autoImplicit false

+noncomputable section

+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+open Theorem18 Chamber3 Asphericity5 Sequence4 Topology

+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] (J : Set I)
+
+def liftedTubeIntersection (F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)) :
+    Set (ComplementUniversalCover M J) := ⋂ A ∈ F, liftedTubeSheet M J A
+
+theorem mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff (F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J))
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) :
+    q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J F ↔ ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A := by
+  simp only [liftedTubeIntersection, Set.mem_iInter]
+
+def liftedTubeChambers (F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)) : Set (ActualChamber M J) :=
+  (fun A => A.chamber) '' F
+
+theorem liftedTubeChambers_nonempty {F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)} (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    (liftedTubeChambers M J F).Nonempty := hF.image _
+
+def liftedTubeProjectionPoint (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) :
+    ComplexComplement (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J) :=
+  actualComplementHomeomorph M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q)
+
+def liftedTubeRealSigns (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) : RelativeRoot M J → Bool :=
+  fun h => decide (0 < actualForms M J h (liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J q).val.1)
+
+/-- The literal base sign piece in the original complement topology. -/
+def liftedTubeBasePiece (F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) :
+    Set (Complement M J) :=
+  actualComplementHomeomorph M J ⁻¹'
+    tubeIntersectionPiece (liftedTubeChambers M J F) (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q)
+
+def liftedTubeBasePieceHomeomorph (F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J))
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) : liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q ≃ₜ
+      tubeIntersectionPiece (liftedTubeChambers M J F) (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q) :=
+  (actualComplementHomeomorph M J).subtype (fun _ => Iff.rfl)

+theorem projectionPoint_mem_tubeIntersection {F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)}

+    liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J q ∈ tubeIntersection (liftedTubeChambers M J F) := by
+  rintro C ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
+  exact liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J A
+    ((mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J F q).mp hq A hA)

+    {q : ComplementUniversalCover M J} (hq : q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J F) :
+    complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q ∈ liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q := by

+  intro h hd
+  have hn := tubeIntersection_real_ne_zero (projectionPoint_mem_tubeIntersection M J hq) hd
+  change (liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J q).val.1 ∈
+    signHalfSpace (actualForms M J h)

+theorem restrictedTubeSection_eq_on_basePiece {F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)}
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) {q : ComplementUniversalCover M J}

+  intro B hB
+  rw [restrictedTubeSection_eq_on_basePiece M J hF hq A B hA hB]

+/-- The actual chosen section image is connected and contains the common

+      connectedComponentIn (liftedTubeIntersection M J F) q := by
+  let := contractibleSpace_liftedTubeBasePiece M J hF hq

+    rintro y ⟨z, rfl⟩
+    exact restrictedTubeSection_basePiece_mem_intersection M J hF hq A hA z

+      ComplexComplement (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J) :=
+    liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J

+    (continuous_complementUniversalCoverProjection M J)

+  change f z ∈ tubeIntersectionPiece (liftedTubeChambers M J F) (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q)
