+/-!
+# Actual path labels of the lifted chamber tubes
+
+The universal-cover fiber consists of actual path-homotopy classes from the
+fixed standard complement point. The actual fully faithful interval/complement
+functor and the actual ribbon covering identify these with signed incoming
+ribbon vertices. An outgoing path has the inverse of the incoming Artin label;
+categorical composition, rather than an opposite fundamental-group convention,
+controls all formulas here.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open CategoryTheory Ribbon2 Homotopy5 Chamber3 Theorem18 Sequence4 Asphericity5
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group]
+
+namespace IncomingVertex
+
+/-- Transport only the fixed actual target object, preserving the actual label. -/
+def rebaseEquiv {B C : RibbonObject M} (h : B = C) : IncomingVertex M B ≃ IncomingVertex M C where
+  toFun u := ⟨u.source, u.value, h ▸ u.reduced⟩
+  invFun u := ⟨u.source, u.value, h.symm ▸ u.reduced⟩
+  left_inv _ := ext_value rfl
+  right_inv _ := ext_value rfl
+
+/-- Invert actual signed ribbons to give outgoing arrows in the pre-existing
+actual reduced ribbon groupoid. No paths or vertex groups are replaced. -/
+def outgoingEquiv (B : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M) :
+    IncomingVertex M B.val ≃ Outgoing (ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M) B where
+  toFun u := ⟨actualRibbonObject M u.source,
+    ⟨⟨u.value⁻¹, u.reduced.isRibbon.inv M⟩, .inverse u.reduced⟩⟩
+  invFun p := ⟨p.1.val, p.2.val.val⁻¹, .inverse p.2.property⟩
+  left_inv u := ext_value (inv_inv u.value)
+  right_inv := by
+    rintro ⟨⟨X, hX⟩, ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hr⟩⟩
+    dsimp only
+    refine Sigma.ext (Subtype.ext rfl) ?_
+    apply heq_of_eq
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    exact Subtype.ext (inv_inv p)
+
+end IncomingVertex

+

+    Σ C : ActualChamber M J,
+      Path.Homotopic.Quotient (standardComplementPoint M J) (tubeBasepoint M J C) where
+  toFun A := ⟨A.chamber, liftedTubePathClass M J A⟩
+  invFun p := ⟨p.1, (universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses
+    (standardComplementPoint M J) (tubeBasepoint M J p.1)).symm p.2⟩
+  left_inv := by
+    rintro ⟨C, e⟩
+    change (⟨C, (universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses _ _).symm

+    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
+  right_inv := by
+    rintro ⟨C, q⟩
+    apply Sigma.ext rfl
+    exact heq_of_eq ((universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses _ _).apply_symm_apply q)

+/-- Actual geometric path classes are actual interval arrows via the proved
+fully faithful functor, at the literal canonical chamber basepoints. -/
+def rootedPathIntervalEquiv :
+    (Σ C : ActualChamber M J,
+      Path.Homotopic.Quotient (standardComplementPoint M J) (tubeBasepoint M J C)) ≃
+    Σ C : ActualChamber M J,
+      intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶ intervalObject C :=

+      (X := intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J)) (Y := intervalObject C)).symm
+
+def chamberIntervalObjectEquiv : ActualChamber M J ≃
+    IntervalGroupoid (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J) where
+  toFun := intervalObject
+  invFun := intervalChamber
+  left_inv := intervalChamber_intervalObject
+  right_inv := intervalObject_intervalChamber
+
+def rootedIntervalOutgoingEquiv :
+    (Σ C : ActualChamber M J,
+      intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶ intervalObject C) ≃
+    Outgoing (IntervalGroupoid (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J))
+      (intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J)) :=
+  Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft (chamberIntervalObjectEquiv M J)
+
+theorem standardRibbonObject_indices :
+    ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).obj (intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J))).val =
+      (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M) := by
+  change (⟨actualChamberIndices M J (standardActualChamber M J)⟩ : RibbonObject M) = ⟨J⟩
+  rw [standardActualChamber_indices]
+
+/-- The actual unique outgoing lift identifies the fixed-root incoming labels. -/
+def rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv :
+    Outgoing (IntervalGroupoid (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J))
+      (intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J)) ≃ IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M) :=
+  (Chamber3.outgoingEquiv (intervalRibbonFunctor M J) (intervalRibbonFunctor_isCovering M J)
+    (intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J))).trans
+      ((IncomingVertex.outgoingEquiv M _).symm.trans
+        (IncomingVertex.rebaseEquiv M (standardRibbonObject_indices M J)))
+
+/-- Genuine open-sheet indices and actual signed incoming ribbon vertices. -/
+def liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming : LiftedTubeIndex M J ≃
+    IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M) :=
+  (((liftedTubePathEquiv M J).trans (rootedPathIntervalEquiv M J)).trans
+    (rootedIntervalOutgoingEquiv M J)).trans (rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv M J)
+
+/-- The actual interval arrow represented by an actual sheet's original path. -/
+def liftedTubeIntervalArrow (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶ intervalObject A.chamber :=
+  (actualIntervalComplementEquivalence M J).fullyFaithfulFunctor.preimage
+    (liftedTubePathClass M J A)
+
+@[simp] theorem map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    (actualIntervalForward M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A) = liftedTubePathClass M J A :=
+  (actualIntervalComplementEquivalence M J).fullyFaithfulFunctor.map_preimage _
+
+@[simp] theorem rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv_value (C : ActualChamber M J)
+    (δ : intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶ intervalObject C) :
+    (rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv M J ⟨intervalObject C, δ⟩).value =
+      ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).val.val⁻¹ := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv_source (C : ActualChamber M J)
+    (δ : intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶ intervalObject C) :
+    (rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv M J ⟨intervalObject C, δ⟩).source =

+    (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).value =

+@[simp] theorem liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_source (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :

+  let w := Artin.projection M β.val.val
+  have hrib : IsRibbon M ⟨actualChamberIndices M J (standardActualChamber M J)⟩

+  have hwJ : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M (actualChamberIndices M J C)).map
+      (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom = Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
+    simpa only [standardActualChamber_indices] using hw
+  have hchosen : actualChamberOfRawLabel M J
+      (chamberRawLabel M J (standardActualChamber M J)) =
+        actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (standardRawFacetLabel M J) :=
+    chamberRawLabel_chamber M J _
+  have hreplace := rightTransportRawLabel_independent M J hchosen
+    (actualChamberIndices M J C) w
+    (by simpa only [chamberRawLabel_indices] using hw)
+    hwJ
+  have hend := congrArg Subtype.val (ribbonLiftInterval_endpoint_all M J δ)
+  rw [hβ, ribbonLiftEndpoint_projection] at hend
+  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M J
+    (fiberTargetLabel M J
+      (X := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J (standardActualChamber M J)⟩)
+      (Y := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩) w hw (distinguishedRibbonIndex M J

+  have hlabel : u.rawFacetLabel =

+    apply rawFacetLabel_ext M J
+    · change u.source.indices = _

+      rfl
+    · change (Artin.projection M u.value)⁻¹ = 1 * w
+      rw [huv, map_inv, inv_inv, one_mul]
+  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M J u.rawFacetLabel = C
+  rw [hlabel]
+  exact hreplace.symm.trans hend
+
+/-- The signed endpoint formula identifies the incoming vertex's actual

+theorem rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv_chamber (C : ActualChamber M J)
+    (δ : intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶ intervalObject C) :
+    (rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv M J ⟨intervalObject C, δ⟩).chamber = C :=
+  incoming_chamber_of_interval_map M J C δ ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ) rfl

+    (rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv_source M J C δ) (rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv_value M J C δ)

+@[simp] theorem liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_chamber (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).chamber = A.chamber :=
+  rootedRibbonIncomingEquiv_chamber M J A.chamber (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A)

+/-- The actual sheet index associated to an incoming vertex. -/
+def incomingLiftedTubeIndex (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) : LiftedTubeIndex M J :=
+  (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J).symm u
+
+@[simp] theorem incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber
+    (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :
+    (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u).chamber = u.chamber := by
+  have h := liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_chamber M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u)

+/-- These are the original open sheets, merely labelled by their actual ribbons. -/
+def incomingLiftedTubeSheet (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :
+    Set (ComplementUniversalCover M J) := liftedTubeSheet M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u)

+theorem incomingLiftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage
+    (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :
+    incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u ⊆
+      complementUniversalCoverProjection M J ⁻¹' actualTubeSet M J u.chamber := by
+  simpa only [incomingLiftedTubeSheet, incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber] using
+    liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u)
+
+/-- Actual universal-cover fiber transport by composition of the original
+path classes. The endpoint is the specified actual canonical chamber point. -/
+def transportLiftedTubeIndex (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) (D : ActualChamber M J)
+    (γ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (tubeBasepoint M J A.chamber) (tubeBasepoint M J D)) :
+    LiftedTubeIndex M J :=
+  (liftedTubePathEquiv M J).symm ⟨D, (liftedTubePathClass M J A).trans γ⟩

+/-- Equality of the actual transported fiber point is exactly the literal
+path-composition equation, with no independently chosen path labels. -/
+theorem transportLiftedTubeIndex_eq_iff (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
+    (γ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (tubeBasepoint M J A.chamber) (tubeBasepoint M J B.chamber)) :
+    transportLiftedTubeIndex M J A B.chamber γ = B ↔
+      (liftedTubePathClass M J A).trans γ = liftedTubePathClass M J B := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have he := congrArg (liftedTubePathEquiv M J) h
+    rw [transportLiftedTubeIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at he
+    exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj he).2
+  · intro h
+    apply (liftedTubePathEquiv M J).injective
+    rw [transportLiftedTubeIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
+    exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq h)
+
+/-- The exact pair gauge, for every signed interval arrow. Outgoing paths
+have inverse incoming labels, giving `p_A = label(δ) * p_B` in traversal order. -/
+theorem liftedTubePathClass_comp_iff (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
+    (δ : intervalObject A.chamber ⟶ intervalObject B.chamber) :
+    (show FundamentalGroupoid.mk (standardComplementPoint M J) ⟶
+        FundamentalGroupoid.mk (tubeBasepoint M J B.chamber) from
+      liftedTubePathClass M J A ≫ (actualIntervalForward M J).map δ) =
+        liftedTubePathClass M J B ↔
+      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).value =
+        ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).val.val *
+          (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B).value := by
+  rw [liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_value, liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_value]
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have hδ : liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A ≫ δ = liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B := by
+      apply (actualIntervalComplementEquivalence M J).fullyFaithfulFunctor.map_injective
+      rw [actualIntervalComplementEquivalence_functor, Functor.map_comp,
+        map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow, map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow]
+      exact h
+    have hv := congrArg (fun k : intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶
+      intervalObject B.chamber => ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map k).val.val) hδ
+    rw [Functor.map_comp] at hv
+    change ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A)).val.val *
+      ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).val.val =
+        ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B)).val.val at hv
+    rw [← hv]
+    group
+  · intro h
+    have hv := congrArg Inv.inv h
+    simp only [inv_inv, mul_inv_rev] at hv
+    have hδ : liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A ≫ δ = liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B := by
+      apply (intervalRibbonFunctor_isCovering M J).faithful.map_injective
+      apply Subtype.ext
+      apply Subtype.ext
+      rw [Functor.map_comp]
+      change ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A)).val.val *
+        ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).val.val =
+          ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B)).val.val
+      rw [hv]
+      group
+    rw [← map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A, ← map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B,
+      ← Functor.map_comp, hδ]
+
+/-- An actual simple positive incoming factor is precisely the canonical
+positive chamber connector in the literal universal-cover path gauge. -/
+theorem liftedTubePathClass_comp_positive (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
+    (hs : SimpleRibbon M (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).source
+      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B).source
+      ((liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B))) :
+    (show FundamentalGroupoid.mk (standardComplementPoint M J) ⟶
+        FundamentalGroupoid.mk (tubeBasepoint M J B.chamber) from
+      liftedTubePathClass M J A ≫
+        (actualIntervalForward M J).map (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)) =
+      liftedTubePathClass M J B := by
+  have hr := incoming_relativeTransport M hs
+  rw [liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_chamber, liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_chamber] at hr
+  have hv : ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)).val.val =
+      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B) := by
+    rw [intervalRibbonFunctor_positive, intervalRibbonPositive_value, hr]
+    exact (SimpleRibbon.eq_simpleLift M hs).symm
+  apply (liftedTubePathClass_comp_iff M J A B (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)).mpr
+  rw [hv]
+  dsimp only [IncomingVertex.difference]
+  group
+
+theorem transportLiftedTubeIndex_positive (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
+    (hs : SimpleRibbon M (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).source
+      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B).source
+      ((liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B))) :
+    transportLiftedTubeIndex M J A B.chamber
+      ((actualIntervalForward M J).map (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)) = B :=
+  (transportLiftedTubeIndex_eq_iff M J A B _).mpr (liftedTubePathClass_comp_positive M J A B hs)
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinAsphericity.UniversalCoverGeometry
+import ArtinChambers.ActualTubes
+import ArtinChambers.ForwardEquivariance
+
+/-!
+# Actual universal-cover sheets over the contractible chamber tubes
+
+These are subsets of the original based-path universal cover, with its accepted
+coinduced topology. A sheet is indexed by an actual point in the fiber over the
+canonical chamber basepoint. The endpoint projection identifies each sheet
+homeomorphically with its actual tube; its inverse is the chosen-basepoint
+section. These open sheets cover the actual universal cover.
+
+Supplier inspection (2026-11-14): GitHub code searches for
+`existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts` in mathlib and `proj_injOn_sheet` in TauCeti
+were followed by reading the pinned declarations and proofs. This file reuses
+only already accepted sources: TauCeti commit
+`62bbc0596dc3539d488232e4e924a338548ea0a9`, UniversalCover/Basic.lean
+(`sheet`, `isOpen_sheet`, `proj_surjOn_sheet`, `proj_injOn_sheet`,
+`sheet_exhaustive`, `pairwise_disjoint_sheet`), plus its accepted Path.lean
+`IsSimplyConnected.isPathHomotopyTrivial`; mathlib commit
+`65d730f7150f21fdfa32f3e73a3f549c1f96a0e9` supplies
+`Equiv.toHomeomorphOfContinuousOpen`. No new source cohort is imported.
+The alternative mathlib lifting theorem requires a simply connected, locally
+path connected source and proves a unique continuous lift; it was inspected
+but is unnecessary because the accepted genuine sheet construction suffices.
+No contractibility of the total cover or nerve comparison is assumed.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Theorem18 Chamber3 Asphericity5 Sequence4 Topology
+
+section General
+
+variable {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (x₀ x : X)
+
+/-- The actual endpoint fiber consists precisely of the original path classes. -/
+def universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses :
+    {z : TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀ // z.proj = x} ≃ Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x where
+  toFun z := z.property ▸ z.val.path
+  invFun q := ⟨⟨x, q⟩, rfl⟩
+  left_inv := by
+    rintro ⟨⟨y, q⟩, hy⟩
+    cases hy
+    rfl
+  right_inv _ := rfl
+
+variable {x₀ x}
+
+/-- The original class defining a sheet belongs to it. -/
+theorem universalCover_mk_mem_sheet (U : Set X) (hx : x ∈ U)
+    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
+    (⟨x, q⟩ : TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀) ∈ TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet U hx q := by
+  induction q using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with
+  | mk p =>
+    simpa only [TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath_ofPath] using
+      (TauCeti.UniversalCover.mem_sheet_self hx p)
+
+theorem universalCover_fiberPoint_mem_sheet (U : Set X) (hx : x ∈ U)
+    (e : {z : TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀ // z.proj = x}) :
+    e.val ∈ TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet U hx
+      (universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses x₀ x e) := by
+  rcases e with ⟨⟨y, q⟩, hy⟩
+  cases hy
+  exact universalCover_mk_mem_sheet U hx q
+
+/-- Endpoint projection restricted to one actual universal-cover sheet. -/
+def universalCoverSheetProjection (U : Set X) (hx : x ∈ U)
+    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
+    C(TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet U hx q, U) where
+  toFun z := ⟨z.val.proj, TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet_subset_proj_preimage U hx q z.property⟩
+  continuous_toFun :=
+    ((TauCeti.UniversalCover.continuous_proj x₀).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
+
+/-- Over a path connected and path-homotopy-trivial open set, the actual sheet
+projection is a homeomorphism. The stronger simply connected tube hypothesis
+will discharge both geometric premises in the application below. -/
+def universalCoverSheetHomeomorph [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
+    [TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U)
+    (hconn : IsPathConnected U) (htriv : IsPathHomotopyTrivial U) (hx : x ∈ U)
+    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
+    TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet U hx q ≃ₜ U := by
+  let f := universalCoverSheetProjection U hx q
+  have hbij : Function.Bijective f := by
+    constructor
+    · intro a b hab
+      apply Subtype.ext
+      exact TauCeti.UniversalCover.proj_injOn_sheet htriv hx q a.property b.property
+        (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
+    · intro y
+      obtain ⟨z, hz, he⟩ := TauCeti.UniversalCover.proj_surjOn_sheet hconn hx q y.property
+      exact ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, Subtype.ext he⟩
+  have hopen : IsOpenMap f :=
+    ((TauCeti.UniversalCover.isOpenMap_proj x₀).domRestrict
+      (TauCeti.UniversalCover.isOpen_sheet U hU hx q)).subtype_mk _
+  exact (Equiv.ofBijective f hbij).toHomeomorphOfContinuousOpen f.continuous hopen
+
+@[simp]
+theorem universalCoverSheetHomeomorph_apply [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
+    [TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U)
+    (hconn : IsPathConnected U) (htriv : IsPathHomotopyTrivial U) (hx : x ∈ U)
+    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) (z : TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet U hx q) :
+    (universalCoverSheetHomeomorph U hU hconn htriv hx q z).val = z.val.proj := rfl
+
+end General
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] (J : Set I)
+
+/-- The existing canonical chamber basepoint in the original complement. -/
+def tubeBasepoint (C : ActualChamber M J) : Complement M J :=
+  actualChamberBasepoint M J (actualChamberPointFamily M J) C
+
+theorem tubeBasepoint_mem (C : ActualChamber M J) :
+    tubeBasepoint M J C ∈ actualTubeSet M J C :=
+  actualChamberBasepoint_mem_tube M J (actualChamberPointFamily M J) C C
+
+/-- The canonical basepoint as an actual point of its tube. -/
+def tubeBasepointInTube (C : ActualChamber M J) : actualTubeSet M J C :=
+  ⟨tubeBasepoint M J C, tubeBasepoint_mem M J C⟩
+
+omit [Finite M.Group] in
+theorem isSimplyConnected_actualTube (C : ActualChamber M J) :
+    IsSimplyConnected (actualTubeSet M J C) := by
+  change SimplyConnectedSpace ↥(actualTubeSet M J C)
+  infer_instance
+
+/-- An actual chamber together with an actual fiber point over its canonical point. -/
+structure LiftedTubeIndex where
+  chamber : ActualChamber M J
+  fiberPoint : {z : ComplementUniversalCover M J //
+    complementUniversalCoverProjection M J z = tubeBasepoint M J chamber}
+
+/-- The original path-homotopy class carried by the fiber point. -/
+def liftedTubePathClass (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    Path.Homotopic.Quotient (standardComplementPoint M J) (tubeBasepoint M J A.chamber) :=
+  universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses (standardComplementPoint M J)
+    (tubeBasepoint M J A.chamber) A.fiberPoint
+
+/-- The actual open sheet in the original universal cover. -/
+def liftedTubeSheet (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) : Set (ComplementUniversalCover M J) :=
+  TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet (actualTubeSet M J A.chamber)
+    (tubeBasepoint_mem M J A.chamber) (liftedTubePathClass M J A)
+
+theorem isOpen_liftedTubeSheet (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) : IsOpen (liftedTubeSheet M J A) :=
+  TauCeti.UniversalCover.isOpen_sheet (actualTubeSet M J A.chamber)
+    (isOpen_actualTubeSet M J A.chamber) (tubeBasepoint_mem M J A.chamber)
+    (liftedTubePathClass M J A)
+
+theorem liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    liftedTubeSheet M J A ⊆
+      complementUniversalCoverProjection M J ⁻¹' actualTubeSet M J A.chamber :=
+  TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet_subset_proj_preimage _ _ _
+
+theorem fiberPoint_mem_liftedTubeSheet (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    A.fiberPoint.val ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A :=
+  universalCover_fiberPoint_mem_sheet _ _ A.fiberPoint
+
+/-- The inverse endpoint projection identifies the original tube with its actual sheet. -/
+def liftedTubeHomeomorph (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    actualTubeSet M J A.chamber ≃ₜ liftedTubeSheet M J A :=
+  (universalCoverSheetHomeomorph (actualTubeSet M J A.chamber)
+    (isOpen_actualTubeSet M J A.chamber)
+    (isSimplyConnected_actualTube M J A.chamber).isPathConnected
+    (isSimplyConnected_actualTube M J A.chamber).isPathHomotopyTrivial
+    (tubeBasepoint_mem M J A.chamber) (liftedTubePathClass M J A)).symm
+
+/-- A genuine continuous section into the actual universal-cover total space. -/
+def liftedTubeSection (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    C(actualTubeSet M J A.chamber, ComplementUniversalCover M J) where
+  toFun y := (liftedTubeHomeomorph M J A y).val
+  continuous_toFun := continuous_subtype_val.comp (liftedTubeHomeomorph M J A).continuous
+
+theorem liftedTubeSection_projection (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
+    (y : actualTubeSet M J A.chamber) :
+    complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (liftedTubeSection M J A y) = y.val :=
+  congrArg Subtype.val ((liftedTubeHomeomorph M J A).symm_apply_apply y)
+
+theorem liftedTubeSection_basepoint (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    liftedTubeSection M J A (tubeBasepointInTube M J A.chamber) = A.fiberPoint.val := by
+  have he : liftedTubeHomeomorph M J A (tubeBasepointInTube M J A.chamber) =
+      ⟨A.fiberPoint.val, fiberPoint_mem_liftedTubeSheet M J A⟩ := by
+    -- Use the endpoint projection, the inverse of this displayed homeomorphism.
+    apply (liftedTubeHomeomorph M J A).symm.injective

+def liftedTubeOpen (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) :
+    TopologicalSpace.Opens (ComplementUniversalCover M J) :=
+  ⟨liftedTubeSheet M J A, isOpen_liftedTubeSheet M J A⟩

+# Sign-separated barycentric interpolation in the actual complement
+

+uses active signed coefficients, choosing the largest height among the
+negative coefficients. After subtracting that height, all terms are
+nonnegative and at least one positive term is strict.

+The resulting centered real-pair interpolation is quadratic in its weights.
+It stays in the actual complexified complement whenever opposite vertex
+signs have strictly separated heights. No gallery separation theorem or
+asphericity is assumed or asserted here. For incoming ribbon vertices, the
+intended geometric height is **minus** the actual degree, so height increases
+along a positive source-to-target arrow.

+maxima in mathlib; no external GitHub proof of this construction is imported.

+variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

+/-- Only heights across opposite signs must be strictly separated. Repeated
+vertices of the same sign may have equal heights. -/
+def NegativeBeforePositive (a d : ι → ℝ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ i j, a i < 0 → 0 < a j → d i < d j

+def PositiveBeforeNegative (a d : ι → ℝ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ i j, 0 < a i → a j < 0 → d i < d j
+
+def SignHeightSeparated (a d : ι → ℝ) : Prop :=
+  NegativeBeforePositive a d ∨ PositiveBeforeNegative a d

+private theorem exists_pos_and_neg_of_sum_zero (b : ι → ℝ)
+    (hsum : ∑ i, b i = 0) (hne : ∃ i, b i ≠ 0) :
+    (∃ i, 0 < b i) ∧ ∃ i, b i < 0 := by
+  constructor
+  · by_contra h
+    have hnonpos (i : ι) : b i ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt (fun hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩)
+    have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hnonpos i)).1 hsum
+    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
+    exact hi (hz i (Finset.mem_univ i))
+  · by_contra h
+    have hnonneg (i : ι) : 0 ≤ b i := le_of_not_gt (fun hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩)
+    have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hnonneg i)).1 hsum
+    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
+    exact hi (hz i (Finset.mem_univ i))
+
+/-- A zero total of nontrivial signed coefficients has strictly positive
+height-weighted total when negative heights precede positive heights. -/
+theorem sum_height_mul_pos (b d : ι → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ i, b i = 0)
+    (hne : ∃ i, b i ≠ 0) (hsep : NegativeBeforePositive b d) :
+    0 < ∑ i, d i * b i := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩⟩ := exists_pos_and_neg_of_sum_zero b hsum hne

+    by_cases hi : b i < 0

+  by_contra hn

+  have ha := le_of_not_gt hn

+theorem weighted_height_sum_ne_zero (w a d : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)

+    (∑ i, w i * d i * a i) ≠ 0 := by

+  · exact ne_of_lt (weighted_height_sum_neg w a d hw hwone ha hzero hsep)

+  · exact realInterpolation_aggregate f w c

+section Continuity
+

+
+theorem continuous_meanHeight (d : ι → ℝ) : Continuous (fun w : ι → ℝ => meanHeight w d) := by
+  apply continuous_finsetSum
+  intro i hi

+

+    Continuous (fun w : ι → ℝ => realInterpolation w c) := by

+  apply continuous_finsetSum
+  intro i hi

+
+theorem continuous_signInterpolation (d : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → E) :
+    Continuous (fun w : ι → ℝ => signInterpolation w d c) :=
+  (continuous_realInterpolation c).prodMk (continuous_imaginaryInterpolation d c)
+
+end Continuity
+
+end Vector
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+/-!
+# Numerable carrier homotopies in the original space
+

+coherent parameterized face family is evaluated on the positive support;
+continuity uses one finite closed-support window near each original point.

+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false

+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+open OAI.HarmonicArtin Topology Convexity

+attribute [local instance] Classical.decEq Classical.propDecidable

+/-- The original common-intersection parameter space of a finite face. -/

+  {x | ∀ i ∈ F, x ∈ W i}
+
+omit [TopologicalSpace X] [LinearOrder ι] in
+theorem coverFaceParameter_antitone (W : ι → Set X) : Antitone (coverFaceParameter W) :=
+  fun _ _ h _ hx i hi ↦ hx i (h hi)
+
+/-- Ordinary simplex weights on a finite subset of a linearly ordered index set. -/
+def numerableSimplexWeights (F : Finset ι) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F) : OrderWeights F where
+  weights := z.weights
+  nonneg := z.nonneg
+  total := z.total
+  chain := fun p _ q _ ↦ le_total p q

+    (hF : IsNerveFace W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F) : CoverWeights W :=
+  ⟨weightMap (weightInclusion (F : Set ι)) (numerableSimplexWeights F z), by
+    apply hF.mono
+    rw [weightMap_support_embedding _ Subtype.val_injective]
+    intro i hi
+    obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
+    exact j.property⟩
+
+omit [TopologicalSpace X] in
+theorem numerableFaceChart_support_subset (W : ι → Set X) (F : Finset ι)
+    (hF : IsNerveFace W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F) :
+    (numerableFaceChart W F hF z).val.weights.support ⊆ F := by
+  rw [numerableFaceChart, weightMap_support_embedding _ Subtype.val_injective]
+  intro i hi
+  obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
+  exact j.property
+
+omit [TopologicalSpace X] in
+theorem numerableFaceChart_apply_mem (W : ι → Set X) (F : Finset ι)
+    (hF : IsNerveFace W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F) (i : F) :
+    (numerableFaceChart W F hF z).val.weights i.val = z.weights i :=
+  weightMap_apply_embedding (weightInclusion (F : Set ι)) Subtype.val_injective _ i
+
+omit [TopologicalSpace X] in
+theorem numerableFaceChart_apply_not_mem (W : ι → Set X) (F : Finset ι)
+    (hF : IsNerveFace W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F) {i : ι} (hi : i ∉ F) :
+    (numerableFaceChart W F hF z).val.weights i = 0 :=
+  Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp fun h ↦ hi (numerableFaceChart_support_subset W F hF z h)
+
+omit [TopologicalSpace X] in
+theorem continuous_numerableFaceChart (W : ι → Set X) (F : Finset ι)
+    (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : IsNerveFace W F) : Continuous (numerableFaceChart W F hF) := by
+  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
+  apply continuous_of_finite_chain_carrier _ F
+    (fun a _ b _ _ ↦ le_total a b) hne
+    (numerableFaceChart_support_subset W F hF)
+  intro i
+  by_cases hi : i ∈ F
+  · simpa only [numerableFaceChart_apply_mem W F hF _ ⟨i, hi⟩] using
+      (StdSimplex.continuous_weights_apply ℝ (⟨i, hi⟩ : F))
+  · simpa only [numerableFaceChart_apply_not_mem W F hF _ hi] using
+      (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : StdSimplex ℝ F ↦ (0 : ℝ))
+
+/-- The chart retains every original partition coefficient, also when its
+finite support window is larger than the positive support. -/
+theorem numerableFaceChart_finiteChart (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (F : Finset ι) (hF : IsNerveFace W F)
+    (x : chartDomain ρ F) :
+    numerableFaceChart W F hF (finiteChart ρ F x) = numerableCoverClassifier W ρ hρ x.val := by
+  classical
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  apply OrderWeights.ext
+  ext i
+  change (numerableFaceChart W F hF (finiteChart ρ F x)).val.weights i =
+    (partitionWeightsValue ρ x.val).weights i
+  rw [partitionWeightsValue_apply]
+  by_cases hi : i ∈ F
+  · exact numerableFaceChart_apply_mem W F hF _ ⟨i, hi⟩
+  · rw [numerableFaceChart_apply_not_mem W F hF _ hi]
+    symm
+    by_contra hn
+    exact hi (x.property ((ρ.mem_finsupport x.val).mpr hn))

+/-- The genuine zero-coordinate insertion between arbitrary finite faces. -/
+def numerableFaceInclusion {A B : Finset ι} (h : A ⊆ B) : A → B :=
+  fun a ↦ ⟨a.val, h a.property⟩
+
+omit [TopologicalSpace X] in
+theorem numerableFaceChart_map (W : ι → Set X) {A B : Finset ι}
+    (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hA : IsNerveFace W A) (hB : IsNerveFace W B)
+    (z : StdSimplex ℝ A) :
+    numerableFaceChart W B hB (z.map (numerableFaceInclusion hAB)) =
+      numerableFaceChart W A hA z := by
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  apply OrderWeights.ext
+  change (z.map (numerableFaceInclusion hAB)).weights.mapDomain (Subtype.val : B → ι) =
+    z.weights.mapDomain (Subtype.val : A → ι)
+  rw [StdSimplex.weights_map, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
+  rfl

+    coverFaceParameter W B → coverFaceParameter W A :=
+  fun x ↦ ⟨x.val, coverFaceParameter_antitone W h x.property⟩
+
+omit [LinearOrder ι] in
+theorem isOpen_coverFaceParameter (W : ι → Set X) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i))
+    (F : Finset ι) : IsOpen (coverFaceParameter W F) := by
+  have he : coverFaceParameter W F = ⋂ i ∈ F, W i := by
+    ext x
+    simp only [coverFaceParameter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
+  rw [he]
+  exact isOpen_biInter_finset fun i _ ↦ hW i
+
+omit [LinearOrder ι] in
+/-- The actual point lies in every cover member of its positive support. -/
+theorem partition_mem_coverFaceParameter (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (x : X) : x ∈ coverFaceParameter W (ρ.finsupport x) := by
+  intro i hi
+  exact hρ i ((ρ.mem_fintsupport_iff x i).mp ((ρ.finsupport_subset_fintsupport x) hi))
+
+/-- Continuous finite-face tracks are intermediate gluing data. In the carrier
+theorem they will be constructed by parameterized face induction. -/
+abbrev NumerableFaceTracks (W : ι → Set X) :=
+  ∀ (F : Finset ι), F.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W F →
+    C(I × (coverFaceParameter W F × StdSimplex ℝ F), X)
+
+def NumerableFaceTracks.Compatible (W : ι → Set X) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W) : Prop :=
+  ∀ {A B : Finset ι} (hneA : A.Nonempty) (hneB : B.Nonempty)
+    (hA : IsNerveFace W A) (hB : IsNerveFace W B) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
+    (t : I) (x : coverFaceParameter W B) (z : StdSimplex ℝ A),
+    H B hneB hB (t, (x, z.map (numerableFaceInclusion hAB))) =
+      H A hneA hA (t, (coverFaceRestrict W hAB x, z))
+
+/-- Evaluate on precisely the original positive partition support. -/
+noncomputable def partitionTrackValue (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W) (p : I × X) : X :=
+  H (ρ.finsupport p.2) (partition_finsupport_nonempty ρ p.2)
+    (partition_support_isNerveFace W ρ hρ p.2)
+    (p.1, (⟨p.2, partition_mem_coverFaceParameter W ρ hρ p.2⟩,
+      finiteChart ρ (ρ.finsupport p.2) ⟨p.2, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩))

+/-- Exact face coherence permits any larger finite support window at the
+same actual point, including the closed-support window. -/
+theorem partitionTrackValue_eq_finite (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W)
+    (hH : NumerableFaceTracks.Compatible W H) (F : Finset ι) (hne : F.Nonempty)
+    (hF : IsNerveFace W F) (t : I) (x : coverFaceParameter W F)
+    (hx : ρ.finsupport x.val ⊆ F) :
+    partitionTrackValue W ρ hρ H (t, x.val) =
+      H F hne hF (t, (x, finiteChart ρ F ⟨x.val, hx⟩)) := by
+  have h := hH (partition_finsupport_nonempty ρ x.val) hne
+    (partition_support_isNerveFace W ρ hρ x.val) hF hx t x
+    (finiteChart ρ (ρ.finsupport x.val) ⟨x.val, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩)
+  change H F hne hF
+    (t, (x, (finiteChart ρ (ρ.finsupport x.val) ⟨x.val, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩).map

+  rw [finiteChart_map_inclusion] at h
+  exact h.symm
+
+/-- Local continuity comes from one finite closed-support chart and its
+actual common-intersection parameter space. -/
+theorem continuous_partitionTrackValue (W : ι → Set X) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i))
+    (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W)
+    (hH : NumerableFaceTracks.Compatible W H) : Continuous (partitionTrackValue W ρ hρ H) := by
+  classical
+  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
+  intro p₀
+  let F := ρ.fintsupport p₀.2
+  have hne : F.Nonempty :=
+    (partition_finsupport_nonempty ρ p₀.2).mono (ρ.finsupport_subset_fintsupport p₀.2)
+  have hpF : p₀.2 ∈ coverFaceParameter W F := by
+    intro i hi
+    exact hρ i ((ρ.mem_fintsupport_iff p₀.2 i).mp hi)
+  have hF : IsNerveFace W F := ⟨p₀.2, hpF⟩
+  let V : Set X := coverFaceParameter W F ∩ chartDomain ρ F
+  have hV : V ∈ 𝓝 p₀.2 :=
+    Filter.inter_mem ((isOpen_coverFaceParameter W hW F).mem_nhds hpF)
+      (chartDomain_mem_nhds ρ p₀.2)
+  let U : Set (I × X) := Prod.snd ⁻¹' V
+  have hU : U ∈ 𝓝 p₀ := continuous_snd.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hV
+  let g : U → I × (coverFaceParameter W F × StdSimplex ℝ F) := fun q ↦
+    (q.val.1, (⟨q.val.2, q.property.1⟩,
+      finiteChart ρ F ⟨q.val.2, q.property.2⟩))
+  have hg : Continuous g := by
+    refine (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val).prodMk ?_
+    refine ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _).prodMk ?_
+    exact (finiteChart ρ F).continuous.comp
+      ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)
+  have hc : Continuous (U.domRestrict (partitionTrackValue W ρ hρ H)) := by
+    apply ((H F hne hF).continuous.comp hg).congr
+    intro q
+    exact (partitionTrackValue_eq_finite W ρ hρ H hH F hne hF q.val.1
+      ⟨q.val.2, q.property.1⟩ q.property.2).symm
+  exact (continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mpr hc).continuousAt hU
+
+/-- Gluing already constructed coherent local tracks gives the genuine
+global homotopy. The carrier theorem below constructs those tracks. -/
+noncomputable def numerableFaceTracksHomotopy (W : ι → Set X)
+    (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W)
+    (r : C(CoverWeights W, X)) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W)
+    (hH : NumerableFaceTracks.Compatible W H)
+    (h₀ : ∀ F hne hF (x : coverFaceParameter W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F),
+      H F hne hF (0, (x, z)) = r (numerableFaceChart W F hF z))
+    (h₁ : ∀ F hne hF (x : coverFaceParameter W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F),
+      H F hne hF (1, (x, z)) = x.val) :
+    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (r.comp (numerableCoverClassifier W ρ hρ)) (ContinuousMap.id X) where
+  toFun := partitionTrackValue W ρ hρ H
+  continuous_toFun := continuous_partitionTrackValue W hW ρ hρ H hH
+  map_zero_left x := by
+    dsimp only [partitionTrackValue]
+    rw [h₀]
+    exact congrArg r (numerableFaceChart_finiteChart W ρ hρ (ρ.finsupport x)
+      (partition_support_isNerveFace W ρ hρ x) ⟨x, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩)
+  map_one_left x := by
+    dsimp only [partitionTrackValue]
+    exact h₁ _ _ _ _ _
+
+/-- Monotone contractible carriers construct the actual numerable comparison
+homotopy. The local face homotopies are produced by parameterized HEP and are
+not input data. The original common-intersection spaces need not be contractible. -/
+noncomputable def numerableCarrierHomotopy (W : ι → Set X)
+    (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W)
+    (C : Finset ι → Set X)
+    (hC : ∀ F, F.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W F → ContractibleSpace (C F))
+    (hmono : ∀ {A B}, A ⊆ B → A.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W B → C A ⊆ C B)
+    (hinter : ∀ F, F.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W F → coverFaceParameter W F ⊆ C F)
+    (r : C(CoverWeights W, X))
+    (hr : ∀ F, F.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W F → ∀ w : CoverWeights W,
+      w.val.weights.support ⊆ F → r w ∈ C F) :
+    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (r.comp (numerableCoverClassifier W ρ hρ)) (ContinuousMap.id X) := by
+  let D : FiniteCarrierData ι X :=
+    { admissible := IsNerveFace W
+      hereditary := fun h hF ↦ hF.mono h
+      carrier := C
+      contractible := hC
+      monotone := hmono }
+  let R := coverFaceParameter W
+  let hR : Antitone R := coverFaceParameter_antitone W
+  let f₀ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR :=
+    { map := fun F hne hF ↦
+        ⟨fun p ↦ r (numerableFaceChart W F hF p.2),
+          r.continuous.comp ((continuous_numerableFaceChart W F hne hF).comp continuous_snd)⟩
+      carried := fun F hne hF _x z ↦
+        hr F hne hF _ (numerableFaceChart_support_subset W F hF z)
+      compatible := fun _ _ ha hb hAB _ z ↦
+        congrArg r (numerableFaceChart_map W hAB ha hb z) }
+  let f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR :=
+    { map := fun _ _ _ ↦ ⟨fun p ↦ p.1.val, continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst⟩
+      carried := fun F hne hF x _ ↦ hinter F hne hF x.property
+      compatible := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ↦ rfl }
+  let H := f₀.homotopy f₁
+  refine numerableFaceTracksHomotopy W hW ρ hρ r
+    (fun F hne hF ↦ (H.hom F hne hF).toContinuousMap) ?_ ?_ ?_
+  · intro A B hA hB ha hb hAB t x z
+    exact H.compatible hA hB ha hb hAB t x z
+  · intro F hne hF x z
+    exact (H.hom F hne hF).apply_zero (x, z)
+  · intro F hne hF x z
+    exact (H.hom F hne hF).apply_one (x, z)
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinDeligneVendor.Topology.ArtinGroups.Realizations.FiniteWeightsCompact
+import ArtinHomotopyVendor.Topology.Realization.POUNerveClassifier

+/-!
+# Original partition coefficients as genuine weak finite weights
+
+Local finite closed support, rather than coordinatewise continuity alone,
+proves continuity into the weak order-weight topology. The common-intersection
+condition is proved from subordination. No comparison or asphericity is part
+of the hypotheses or conclusion of this construction.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open OAI.HarmonicArtin Topology.NumerableConnectorCover Convexity
+open scoped Topology
+
+universe u v
+
+variable {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type v} [LinearOrder ι]
+
+noncomputable def partitionChain (F : Finset ι) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    Fin (finiteFaceDim F + 1) →o ι :=
+  (F.orderEmbOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)).toOrderHom
+
+/-- The original finite partition chart, mapped into the genuine weight space. -/
+noncomputable def finitePartitionWeights (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (F : Finset ι) (hF : F.Nonempty) (x : chartDomain ρ F) : OrderWeights ι :=
+  orderWeightsOfChain (partitionChain F hF)
+    ((finiteChart ρ F x).map (F.orderIsoOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)).symm)
+
+theorem finitePartitionWeights_apply (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (F : Finset ι) (hF : F.Nonempty) (x : chartDomain ρ F) (i : ι) :
+    (finitePartitionWeights ρ F hF x).weights i = ρ i x.val := by
+  classical
+  change chainWeights (partitionChain F hF)
+    ((finiteChart ρ F x).map (F.orderIsoOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)).symm) i = _
+  rw [chainWeights_apply]
+  by_cases hi : i ∈ F
+  · let e := F.orderIsoOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)
+    let j : F := ⟨i, hi⟩
+    let k := e.symm j
+    have hk : partitionChain F hF k = i :=
+      congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply j)
+    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
+    · rw [ite_eq_left hk, StdSimplex.weights_map]
+      change Finsupp.mapDomain e.symm (finiteChart ρ F x).weights (e.symm j) = _
+      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective e.symm.injective]
+      rfl
+    · intro l _ hl
+      have hli : partitionChain F hF l ≠ i := by
+        intro he
+        apply hl
+        exact (F.orderEmbOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)).injective (he.trans hk.symm)
+      exact ite_eq_right hli
+    · intro hn
+      exact False.elim (hn (Finset.mem_univ k))
+  · have hρ : ρ i x.val = 0 := by
+      by_contra hn
+      exact hi (x.property ((ρ.mem_finsupport x.val).mpr hn))
+    rw [hρ]
+    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+    intro k _
+    have hk : partitionChain F hF k ≠ i := by
+      intro he
+      apply hi
+      exact he ▸ F.orderEmbOfFin_mem (finiteFace_card F hF) k
+    exact ite_eq_right hk
+
+theorem continuous_finitePartitionWeights (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (F : Finset ι) (hF : F.Nonempty) : Continuous (finitePartitionWeights ρ F hF) :=
+  (chainWeightsChart_continuous (partitionChain F hF)).comp
+    ((StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ (F.orderIsoOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)).symm).comp
+      (finiteChart ρ F).continuous)
+
+/-- Pointwise weights use precisely the original positive partition support. -/
+noncomputable def partitionWeightsValue (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (x : X) :
+    OrderWeights ι :=
+  finitePartitionWeights ρ (ρ.finsupport x) (partition_finsupport_nonempty ρ x)
+    ⟨x, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩
+
+@[simp] theorem partitionWeightsValue_apply (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (x : X) (i : ι) :
+    (partitionWeightsValue ρ x).weights i = ρ i x :=
+  finitePartitionWeights_apply ρ _ _ _ i
+
+theorem partitionWeightsValue_eq_finite (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (F : Finset ι) (hF : F.Nonempty) (x : chartDomain ρ F) :
+    partitionWeightsValue ρ x.val = finitePartitionWeights ρ F hF x := by
+  apply OrderWeights.ext
+  ext i
+  rw [partitionWeightsValue_apply, finitePartitionWeights_apply]
+
+theorem continuousOn_partitionWeightsValue (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (F : Finset ι) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    ContinuousOn (partitionWeightsValue ρ) (chartDomain ρ F) := by
+  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
+  have he : (chartDomain ρ F).domRestrict (partitionWeightsValue ρ) =
+      finitePartitionWeights ρ F hF := by
+    funext x
+    exact partitionWeightsValue_eq_finite ρ F hF x
+  rw [he]
+  exact continuous_finitePartitionWeights ρ F hF
+
+/-- A fixed finite closed-support window controls all nearby values. -/
+theorem continuous_partitionWeightsValue (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) :
+    Continuous (partitionWeightsValue ρ) := by
+  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
+  intro x
+  have hs : (ρ.fintsupport x).Nonempty :=
+    (partition_finsupport_nonempty ρ x).mono (ρ.finsupport_subset_fintsupport x)
+  exact (continuousOn_partitionWeightsValue ρ _ hs).continuousAt (chartDomain_mem_nhds ρ x)
+
+/-- Literal finite weights with a genuine common point of their cover members. -/
+abbrev CoverWeights (W : ι → Set X) :=
+  {w : OrderWeights ι // IsNerveFace W w.weights.support}
+
+theorem partitionWeightsValue_support (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (x : X) :
+    (partitionWeightsValue ρ x).weights.support = ρ.finsupport x := by
+  ext i
+  simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, partitionWeightsValue_apply, ρ.mem_finsupport,
+    Function.mem_support]
+
+theorem partitionWeightsValue_isNerveFace (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (x : X) :
+    IsNerveFace W (partitionWeightsValue ρ x).weights.support := by
+  rw [partitionWeightsValue_support]
+  exact partition_support_isNerveFace W ρ hρ x
+
+/-- The original partition map into the common-intersection weight subspace. -/
+noncomputable def numerableCoverClassifier (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
+    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) : C(X, CoverWeights W) where
+  toFun x := ⟨partitionWeightsValue ρ x, partitionWeightsValue_isNerveFace W ρ hρ x⟩
+  continuous_toFun := (continuous_partitionWeightsValue ρ).subtype_mk _
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinDeligne.CanonicalPacketCarriers
+import ArtinDeligne.CanonicalGarsideMap
+import ArtinDeligne.GarsideTubeCarriers
+
+/-!
+# The actual Garside return respects canonical packet carriers
+
+The interval between packet labels has the correct real signs on every
+hyperplane where its admissible upper chambers disagree. Actual sheet gauges
+and the proved component criterion therefore put every interval vertex in
+the literal packet carrier. Component monotonicity then controls every
+small-chain return carrier and the constructed continuous return map.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Ribbon2 Homotopy5 Chamber3 Theorem18 Asphericity5 Topology OAI.HarmonicArtin
+open Topology.NumerableConnectorCover
+attribute [local instance] Classical.decEq Classical.propDecidable
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] (J : Set I)
+
+/-- The already defined actual lattice interval of packet labels. -/
+abbrev canonicalPacketVertexInterval (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :=
+  IncomingVertex.packetInterval (canonicalPacketLabels M J F) (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)
+
+theorem common_mem_packetUpperIntersection (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
+    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
+    q ∈ canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F :=
+  liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetUpperIntersection M J F hF.choose hF.choose_spec
+    (hq hF.choose hF.choose_spec)
+
+theorem common_mem_packetUpperTubeIntersection (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
+    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
+    q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F) := by
+  rw [← canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_eq]
+  exact common_mem_packetUpperIntersection M J F hF q hq
+
+/-- Every interval vertex precedes every actual admissible upper label,
+inside the one actual simple sheet interval through a common lift. -/
+theorem packet_interval_upper_simple (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
+    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
+    {v u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
+    (hv : v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF)
+    (hu : u ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F) :
+    sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ v ∧ v ≤ u ∧
+      SimpleRibbon M v.source u.source (v.difference u) ∧
+      ChamberBetween (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber v.chamber u.chamber := by
+  have hlabels : ∀ l ∈ canonicalPacketLabels M J F,
+      sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ l := by
+    intro l hl
+    obtain ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hl
+    exact (canonicalIncomingLabel_phase_bounds M J A q (hq A hAF)).1
+  have hlower : sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ v :=
+    (IncomingVertex.le_finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+      (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF) hlabels).trans hv.1
+  have hupper : v ≤ u := hv.2.trans
+    (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin_le (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
+      (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF) (by
+        intro l hl
+        obtain ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hl
+        exact (hu A hAF).1))
+  have hqu : q ∈ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u :=
+    (hu hF.choose hF.choose_spec).2.2 (hq hF.choose hF.choose_spec)
+  have hub := (sheet_mem_implies_interval M J q u hqu).2
+  have hsu := IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval (sheetInterval_simple M J q)
+    le_rfl (hlower.trans hupper) hub
+  exact ⟨hlower, hupper,
+    IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval (sheetInterval_simple M J q) hlower hupper hub,
+    incoming_chamberBetween M hlower hupper hsu⟩
+
+/-- The lower chamber records the exact real signs of the common point
+on every form where those real evaluations are nonzero. -/
+theorem sheetLowerVertex_signs_real (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
+    {R : RelativeRoot M J}
+    (hr : actualForms M J R (liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J q).val.1 ≠ 0) :
+    (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R = liftedTubeRealSigns M J q R := by
+  rw [sheetLowerVertex_chamber]
+  exact tubeLowerChamber_signs_real (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)
+    (liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J q) hr
+
+/-- Every interval vertex has the common point's real signs at every
+actual disagreement among the full admissible upper family. -/
+theorem packet_interval_signs (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
+    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
+    {v : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
+    (hv : v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) (R : RelativeRoot M J)
+    (hd : tubeDisagreement (liftedTubeChambers M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F)) R) :
+    v.chamber.signs R = liftedTubeRealSigns M J q R := by
+  have hqI := common_mem_packetUpperTubeIntersection M J F hF q hq
+  have hreal := tubeIntersection_real_ne_zero (projectionPoint_mem_tubeIntersection M J hqI) hd
+  have hsign := sheetLowerVertex_signs_real M J q hreal
+  obtain ⟨C, hC, D, hD, hCD⟩ := hd
+  obtain ⟨A, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, hAC⟩ := hC
+  obtain ⟨B, ⟨u', hu', rfl⟩, hBD⟩ := hD
+  have hCu : u.chamber = C := (incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber M J u).symm.trans hAC
+  have hDu : u'.chamber = D := (incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber M J u').symm.trans hBD
+  subst C
+  subst D
+  have hbet := (packet_interval_upper_simple M J F hF q hq hv hu).2.2.2
+  have hbet' := (packet_interval_upper_simple M J F hF q hq hv hu').2.2.2
+  have he : v.chamber.signs R = (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R := by
+    by_cases hs : (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R = u.chamber.signs R
+    · exact hbet R hs
+    · have hs' : (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R = u'.chamber.signs R := by
+        cases ha : (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R <;>
+          cases hb : u.chamber.signs R <;> cases hc : u'.chamber.signs R <;> simp_all
+      exact hbet' R hs'
+  exact he.trans hsign
+
+
+/-- The projected actual vertex lies in the exact real sign component
+selected by the common overlap point. -/
+theorem packet_interval_vertex_basePiece (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
+    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
+    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
+    {v : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
+    (hv : v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
+    complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (incomingVertexPoint M J v) ∈
+      liftedTubeBasePiece M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F) q := by
+  change actualComplementHomeomorph M J
+      (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (incomingVertexPoint M J v)) ∈
+    tubeIntersectionPiece (liftedTubeChambers M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F))
+      (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q)
+  rw [incomingVertexPoint_projection]
+  change chamberBasepoint (actualChamberPointFamily M J) v.chamber ∈
+    tubeIntersectionPiece (liftedTubeChambers M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F))
+      (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q)
+  constructor
+  · intro C _hC
+    exact chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet (actualChamberPointFamily M J) v.chamber C
+  · intro R hd
+    have hs := packet_interval_signs M J F hF q hq hv R hd
+    change (actualChamberPointFamily M J v.chamber).val ∈
+      signHalfSpace (actualForms M J R) (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q R)
+    rw [← hs]
+    exact (actualChamberPointFamily M J v.chamber).property R
+
+/-- Actual packet interval vertices belong to the literal packet carrier,
+including its chosen component upstairs, rather than just all projected tubes. -/
+theorem incomingVertexPoint_mem_canonicalPacketCarrier
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
+    {v : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
+    (hv : v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
+    incomingVertexPoint M J v ∈ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  have hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty :=
+    ⟨q, (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mpr hq⟩
+  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq_component_of_mem_cell M J F hF hover
+    hF.choose hF.choose_spec q (hq hF.choose hF.choose_spec), canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_eq]
+  let u := canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF
+  have hu : u ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F :=
+    canonicalPacketJoin_mem_admissible M J F hF q hq
+  have hUF : (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F).Nonempty :=
+    ⟨incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩⟩
+  have hqI := common_mem_packetUpperTubeIntersection M J F hF q hq
+  apply (mem_liftedTubeIntersectionComponent_iff M J hUF hqI
+    (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u) ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ _).mpr
+  exact ⟨incomingVertexPoint_mem_upperSheet M J
+      (packet_interval_upper_simple M J F hF q hq hv hu).2.2.1,
+    packet_interval_vertex_basePiece M J F hF q hq hv⟩
+
+/-- Packet admissible upper labels are simple upper labels of every
+finite collection of vertices in the packet interval. -/
+theorem packetUpper_subset_simpleUpper
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
+    (s : Finset (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)))
+    (hs : ∀ v ∈ s, v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
+    canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F ⊆ simpleUpperSet M J s := by
+  intro u hu v hv
+  have h := packet_interval_upper_simple M J F hF q hq (hs v hv) hu
+  exact ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩
+
+/-- The actual simple-upper intersection is contained in the packet upper
+intersection; this includes all sheets, rather than just projected tubes. -/
+theorem simpleUpperIntersection_subset_packetUpperIntersection
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
+    (s : Finset (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)))
+    (hs : ∀ v ∈ s, v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
+    simpleUpperIntersection M J s ⊆ canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F := by
+  intro z hz
+  rw [canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_eq]
+  apply (mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J _ _).mpr
+  rintro A ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
+  exact (mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J _ _).mp hz _
+    ⟨u, packetUpper_subset_simpleUpper M J F hF q hq s hs hu, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The selected component for any small chain in a packet interval lies
+in the literal canonical packet carrier. -/
+theorem garsideTubeCarrier_subset_canonicalPacketCarrier
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
+    (s : Finset (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)))
+    (hne : s.Nonempty) (hs : garsideTubeAdmissible M J s)
+    (hpacket : ∀ v ∈ s, v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
+    garsideTubeCarrier M J s ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  have hanchor := incomingVertexPoint_mem_canonicalPacketCarrier M J F hF q hq
+    (hpacket _ (finiteMeet_mem_of_garsideTubeAdmissible M J hne hs))
+  rw [garsideTubeCarrier_eq M J s hne, canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF]
+  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF] at hanchor
+  rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hanchor]
+  exact connectedComponentIn_mono _
+    (simpleUpperIntersection_subset_packetUpperIntersection M J F hF q hq s hpacket)
+
+/-- The constructed continuous return takes the entire actual Garside
+interval carrier into the corresponding actual component upstairs. -/
+theorem actualGarsideReturn_mem_canonicalPacketCarrier
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty)
+    (w : GarsideWeights M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))
+    (hw : w ∈ canonicalGarsideCarrier M J F) :
+    actualGarsideReturn M J w ∈ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hover
+  have hq' := (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mp hq
+  have hne := w.val.support_nonempty
+  have hc : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑w.val.weights.support :
+      Set (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))) :=
+    fun a ha b hb _hne => w.val.chain a ha b hb
+  rw [canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq M J F hF] at hw
+  exact garsideTubeCarrier_subset_canonicalPacketCarrier M J F hF q hq'
+    w.val.weights.support hne ⟨hc, w.property⟩ hw
+    (actualGarsideReturn_carried M J w w.val.weights.support hc hne w.property
+      (Finset.Subset.refl _))
+
+/-- The return composed with the canonical continuous forward map obeys
+all nonempty canonical nerve-face carriers, including proper containing faces. -/
+theorem canonicalGarsideMap_return_carried (w : ActualCoverWeights M J)
+    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
+    actualGarsideReturn M J (canonicalGarsideMap M J w) ∈ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := canonicalNerveFace_commonPoint M J F hface
+  exact actualGarsideReturn_mem_canonicalPacketCarrier M J F hF
+    ⟨q, (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mpr hq⟩ _
+    (canonicalGarsideMap_carried M J w F hF hface hw)
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+module
+
+public import ArtinDeligne.ContractibleExtension
+
+/-! Actual parameterized simplex extensions into contractible spaces.
+The parameter is arbitrary; none of the conclusions is a field of the data. -/
+@[expose] public section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open scoped unitInterval
+open Convexity Topology
+
+universe u v
+
+/-- Arbitrary continuous boundary data over any parameter space extends into a
+contractible target. Source and target universes are independent. -/
+theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_extension
+    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z]
+    [ContractibleSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
+    (h : C(X × StdSimplex.boundary n, Z)) :
+    ∃ F : C(X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z),
+      ∀ x (b : StdSimplex.boundary n), F (x, b.val) = h (x, b) := by
+  obtain ⟨z, ⟨L⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic Z
+  let H : C((X × StdSimplex.boundary n) × I, Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ L.symm (p.2, h p.1), by fun_prop⟩
+  obtain ⟨K, _, hK⟩ := StdSimplex.simplexBoundary_homotopy_extension n
+    (ContinuousMap.const _ z) H (fun x b ↦ L.symm.apply_zero (h (x, b)))
+  refine ⟨⟨fun p ↦ K (p, 1), by fun_prop⟩, fun x b ↦ ?_⟩
+  exact (hK x b 1).trans (L.symm.apply_one (h (x, b)))
+
+/-- The whole parameterized side homotopy extends while retaining both complete
+endpoint maps. This statement permits an arbitrary parameter topology. -/
+theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_homotopy_extension_same_universe
+    {X Z : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z]
+    [ContractibleSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
+    (f₀ f₁ : C(X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z))
+    (H : C(I × (X × StdSimplex.boundary n), Z))
+    (h₀ : ∀ x b, H (0, (x, b)) = f₀ (x, b.val))
+    (h₁ : ∀ x b, H (1, (x, b)) = f₁ (x, b.val)) :
+    ∃ K : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁,
+      ∀ t x (b : StdSimplex.boundary n), K (t, (x, b.val)) = H (t, (x, b)) := by
+  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_homotopy_extension_of_hep (Z := TopCat.of Z)
+    (TopCat.parameterizedSimplexBoundaryInclusion (TopCat.of X) n)
+    (TopCat.homotopyExtensionProperty_simplexBoundary (TopCat.of X) n)
+    f₀ f₁ H (fun a ↦ h₀ a.1 a.2) (fun a ↦ h₁ a.1 a.2)
+  exact ⟨K, fun t x b ↦ hK t (x, b)⟩
+
+
+/-- Universe-independent parameterized endpoint-relative extension. The lifts
+only reconcile the categorical universe and are removed from the conclusion. -/
+theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_homotopy_extension
+    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z]
+    [ContractibleSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
+    (f₀ f₁ : C(X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z))
+    (H : C(I × (X × StdSimplex.boundary n), Z))
+    (h₀ : ∀ x b, H (0, (x, b)) = f₀ (x, b.val))
+    (h₁ : ∀ x b, H (1, (x, b)) = f₁ (x, b.val)) :
+    ∃ K : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁,
+      ∀ t x (b : StdSimplex.boundary n), K (t, (x, b.val)) = H (t, (x, b)) := by
+  let _ : ContractibleSpace (ULift.{u} Z) :=
+    (Homeomorph.ulift : ULift.{u} Z ≃ₜ Z).contractibleSpace
+  let g₀ : C(ULift.{v} X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), ULift.{u} Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ ULift.up (f₀ (p.1.down, p.2)), by fun_prop⟩
+  let g₁ : C(ULift.{v} X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), ULift.{u} Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ ULift.up (f₁ (p.1.down, p.2)), by fun_prop⟩
+  let B : C(I × (ULift.{v} X × StdSimplex.boundary n), ULift.{u} Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ ULift.up (H (p.1, (p.2.1.down, p.2.2))), by fun_prop⟩
+  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_parameterized_simplex_homotopy_extension_same_universe n
+    g₀ g₁ B (fun x b ↦ congrArg ULift.up (h₀ x.down b))
+    (fun x b ↦ congrArg ULift.up (h₁ x.down b))
+  let L : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁ :=
+    ⟨⟨fun p ↦ (K (p.1, (ULift.up p.2.1, p.2.2))).down, by fun_prop⟩,
+      fun x ↦ congrArg ULift.down (K.apply_zero (ULift.up x.1, x.2)),
+      fun x ↦ congrArg ULift.down (K.apply_one (ULift.up x.1, x.2))⟩
+  exact ⟨L, fun t x b ↦ congrArg ULift.down (hK t (ULift.up x) b)⟩
+
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+module
+
+public import ArtinDeligneVendor.Topology.Realization.SimplexFaceGluing
+public import Mathlib.Topology.Maps.Proper.Basic
+
+/-! Arbitrary-parameter boundary-track gluing along the genuine finite simplex
+face cover. Properness establishes the required product quotient property. -/
+
+@[expose] public section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Convexity Topology
+open scoped unitInterval
+
+universe u v
+
+/-- The finite compact face cover remains a genuine quotient after product
+with an arbitrary parameter space. Properness, not an unrestricted claim
+about products of quotient maps, proves this assertion. -/
+theorem isQuotientMap_parameterized_simplexFaceCylinderCover
+    (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] (d : ℕ) :
+    IsQuotientMap (Prod.map (id : X → X) (StdSimplex.simplexFaceCylinderCover d)) := by
+  have hp := (isProperMap_id (X := X)).prodMap (StdSimplex.simplexFaceCylinderCover d).continuous.isProperMap
+  exact hp.isClosedMap.isQuotientMap hp.continuous
+    (Function.surjective_id.prodMap (StdSimplex.simplexFaceCylinderCover_surjective d))
+
+/-- Actual face tracks glue continuously with their whole arbitrary parameter
+and time coordinates, under equality on geometric overlaps. -/
+theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_boundary_track
+    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z] (d : ℕ)
+    (H : Fin (d + 2) → C(X × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I), Z))
+    (hcompat : ∀ (i j : Fin (d + 2)) (p : X)
+      (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (t : I),
+      x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove → H i (p, (x, t)) = H j (p, (y, t))) :
+    ∃ B : C(X × (StdSimplex.boundary (d + 1) × I), Z),
+      ∀ (i : Fin (d + 2)) (p : X) (x : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (t : I),
+        B (p, (StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace d i x, t)) = H i (p, (x, t)) := by
+  let G₀ : C(Fin (d + 2) × (X × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I)), Z) :=
+    ⟨fun p ↦ H p.1 p.2, continuous_prod_of_discrete_left.mpr (fun i ↦ (H i).continuous)⟩
+  let G : C(X × (Fin (d + 2) × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I)), Z) :=
+    G₀.comp ⟨fun p ↦ (p.2.1, (p.1, p.2.2)), by fun_prop⟩
+  let q : C(X × (Fin (d + 2) × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I)),
+      X × (StdSimplex.boundary (d + 1) × I)) :=
+    ⟨Prod.map id (StdSimplex.simplexFaceCylinderCover d),
+      continuous_id.prodMap (StdSimplex.simplexFaceCylinderCover d).continuous⟩
+  have hG : Function.FactorsThrough G q := by
+    rintro ⟨p, i, x, t⟩ ⟨r, j, y, s⟩ h
+    have hpr : p = r := congrArg Prod.fst h
+    subst r
+    have hts : t = s := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.2.2) h
+    subst s
+    exact hcompat i j p x y t (congrArg (fun z ↦ z.2.1.val) h)
+  let hq : IsQuotientMap q := isQuotientMap_parameterized_simplexFaceCylinderCover X d
+  let B := hq.lift G hG
+  refine ⟨B, fun i p x t ↦ ?_⟩
+  exact ContinuousMap.congr_fun (hq.lift_comp G hG) (p, i, x, t)
+
+
+/-- The same genuine gluing theorem in the conventional homotopy product
+parenthesization. No restriction is imposed on the parameter space. -/
+theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_boundary_track_assoc
+    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z] (d : ℕ)
+    (H : Fin (d + 2) → C((X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) × I, Z))
+    (hcompat : ∀ (i j : Fin (d + 2)) (p : X)
+      (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (t : I),
+      x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove → H i ((p, x), t) = H j ((p, y), t)) :
+    ∃ B : C((X × StdSimplex.boundary (d + 1)) × I, Z),
+      ∀ (i : Fin (d + 2)) (p : X) (x : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (t : I),
+        B ((p, StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace d i x), t) = H i ((p, x), t) := by
+  let H' : Fin (d + 2) → C(X × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I), Z) :=
+    fun i => ⟨fun p => H i ((p.1, p.2.1), p.2.2), by fun_prop⟩
+  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_parameterized_simplex_boundary_track d H' hcompat
+  refine ⟨⟨fun p => B (p.1.1, (p.1.2, p.2)), by fun_prop⟩, ?_⟩
+  exact hB
+
+end ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5

+import ArtinDeligne.GarsideShifts
+
+/-!
+# Finite actual simple-chain carriers below any incoming vertex
+
+Changing target along an actual signed incoming ribbon preserves its source
+and every pairwise ribbon difference. It therefore gives actual order and
+weighted-subspace isomorphisms, with no claim that an arbitrary target loop
+fixes chambers. Relative head removal stays below its chosen target and uses
+the nonnegative relative degree, not a global cofinal-loop degree.
+
+A finite starting family must already lie in the required predicate Q;
+upward closure inside the target downset then preserves Q during finite head
+closure. Contractibility is derived from the proved positive head folds.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5
+
+open Ribbon2 Homotopy5 Chamber3 OAI.HarmonicArtin Topology
+
+variable {I : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group]
+variable {B0 : RibbonObject M}
+
+/-- Retarget every genuine signed incoming arrow along the inverse of `u`. -/
+def incomingRetarget (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    IncomingVertex M B0 ≃o IncomingVertex M u.source where
+  toFun v := ⟨v.source, v.value * u.value⁻¹, .comp v.reduced (.inverse u.reduced)⟩
+  invFun w := ⟨w.source, w.value * u.value, .comp w.reduced u.reduced⟩
+  left_inv v := IncomingVertex.ext_value (by change (v.value * u.value⁻¹) * u.value = v.value; group)
+  right_inv w := IncomingVertex.ext_value (by change (w.value * u.value) * u.value⁻¹ = w.value; group)
+  map_rel_iff' := by
+    intro v w
+    change PositiveReducedArrow M v.source w.source
+      ((v.value * u.value⁻¹) * (w.value * u.value⁻¹)⁻¹) ↔
+        PositiveReducedArrow M v.source w.source (v.value * w.value⁻¹)
+    have he : (v.value * u.value⁻¹) * (w.value * u.value⁻¹)⁻¹ = v.value * w.value⁻¹ := by group
+    rw [he]

+@[simp] theorem incomingRetarget_source (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :
+    (incomingRetarget M u v).source = v.source := rfl

+@[simp] theorem incomingRetarget_value (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :
